title: Selling by Voice: How Vocal Arousal Drives Sales in Live Streaming Commerce
affiliations: , Renmin University of China,  and University of Connecticut - School of Business

detail.title: Selling by Voice: How Vocal Arousal Drives Sales in Live Streaming Commerce
detail.abstract: Live-streaming e-commerce (LSE) synchronizes real-time demand generation and service delivery, allowing sellers to shape consumer behavior through interactive demonstrations and persuasive communication. While prior studies emphasize visual and textual cues, little is known about how streamers’ vocal characteristics influence purchases. This study examines how vocal arousal, the excitement conveyed in a streamer’s voice, affects sales, and how this effect varies with product type and streamer popularity. We use a two-study mixed-method design. Study 1 analyzes large-scale field data from Taobao Live, linking streamer audio to product-level sales. Using speech emotion recognition to quantify vocal arousal from thousands of clips, we estimate its effect on sales while accounting for product attributes and streamer popularity. Study 2, a controlled experiment, manipulates vocal arousal, product type, and popularity with constant verbal content to establish causality and reveal underlying mechanisms. Results show that vocal arousal significantly increases sales, but the effect is context-dependent. It is stronger for experience goods and high-popularity streamers, and largest when popular streamers sell experience goods. Experimental evidence confirms these patterns and shows that arousal operates through two complementary mechanisms derived from the Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM): enhancing perceived argument quality (central route) and emotional appeal (peripheral route). Product type primarily moderates the peripheral route, whereas popularity moderates the central route. This research advances operations and live-commerce literature by identifying vocal arousal as a scalable, low-cost operational lever that can be trained and optimized. It integrates real-time persuasion with selling context and extends ELM to the auditory dimension of service operations, showing that “sounding excited” can meaningfully improve sales performance in live commerce.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨直播电商中主播声音兴奋度对销售的影响，发现声音兴奋度能显著提升销量，但效果受产品类型和主播人气调节。通过大规模实地数据和实验验证，揭示了声音兴奋度通过增强论证质量和情感吸引力两条路径影响购买决策。
AI.research_question: 主播声音兴奋度如何影响直播电商的销售表现？这种影响如何受到产品类型和主播人气的调节？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注视觉和文本线索，对主播声音特征在直播电商中的作用了解甚少。直播电商实时同步需求生成和服务交付，主播可通过互动演示和说服性沟通塑造消费者行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精细加工可能性模型(ELM) - 中央路径(论证质量)和外围路径(情感吸引力)
AI.method: 混合方法设计：研究1分析淘宝直播的大规模实地数据，使用语音情感识别技术量化声音兴奋度；研究2进行受控实验，操纵声音兴奋度、产品类型和主播人气。
AI.findings: 声音兴奋度显著增加销量，但效果具有情境依赖性：对体验型产品和人气主播效果更强；人气主播销售体验型产品时效果最大。声音兴奋度通过增强感知论证质量和情感吸引力两条互补机制发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ELM理论扩展到服务运营的听觉维度；识别声音兴奋度作为可扩展、低成本的操作杠杆；整合实时说服与销售情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为直播电商运营提供可训练和优化的声音兴奋度管理策略；帮助主播和平台根据产品类型和主播人气优化声音表达策略。

title: From Leveling-Down to Slackening-Down: The Economics of Fairness Regulation in Diagnostic AI
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Information Systems and Tsinghua University, School of Economics and Management

detail.title: From Leveling-Down to Slackening-Down: The Economics of Fairness Regulation in Diagnostic AI
detail.abstract: As diagnostic artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into healthcare, concerns about algorithmic bias have grown more urgent. Policymakers have responded by introducing fairness regulations designed to promote equity, enhance patient outcomes, and protect minority patients. These regulations are often thought to reduce accuracy among majority populations through the well-documented leveling-down effect, while simultaneously benefiting minority groups by narrowing performance disparities. In this study, we challenge this assumption by examining the economic implications of fairness regulations in diagnostic AI, with a particular focus on their impact on the welfare of minority groups. We develop a game-theoretic model of a healthcare provider that employs diagnostic AI under fairness constraints, capturing the provider’s effort to improve algorithmic performance, healthcare pricing, and patient choice. Our analysis analytically demonstrates the leveling-down effect, whereby stricter fairness standards can reduce accuracy for majority groups and, in turn, lead to lower healthcare prices. Additionally, we identify a novel mechanism, namely the slackening-down effect, which results from these reduced prices. Through this mechanism, the provider’s weakened incentives to enhance diagnostic AI performance ultimately diminish algorithmic accuracy for minority groups as well. Consequently, when fairness regulations are already highly stringent, further tightening may inadvertently harm the welfare of minority patients. At the same time, our results reveal conditions under which greater fairness can enhance both equity and efficiency. Our findings provide important implications for healthcare providers navigating fairness policies and for policymakers seeking to design regulations that are both socially beneficial and economically sustainable.

AI.tldr: 该研究挑战了公平性监管必然有利于少数群体的假设，通过博弈论模型发现，过于严格的公平性标准可能通过"松弛效应"降低少数群体的诊断准确性，反而损害其福利。
AI.research_question: 公平性监管在诊断AI中对少数群体福利的经济影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着诊断AI在医疗中的普及，算法偏见问题日益突出，政策制定者引入公平性监管来促进公平，但这些监管是否真正有利于少数群体需要深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分析医疗提供者在公平约束下使用诊断AI时的努力、定价和患者选择行为。
AI.method: 开发博弈论模型，分析医疗提供者在公平约束下的决策行为及其对算法性能和患者福利的影响。
AI.findings: 1）确认了拉平效应：更严格的公平标准会降低多数群体的准确性并导致医疗价格下降；2）发现了松弛效应：价格下降削弱了提供者改进AI性能的激励，最终也降低了少数群体的准确性；3）当公平监管已经很严格时，进一步收紧可能损害少数患者福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"松弛效应"这一新机制，揭示了公平性监管可能通过价格机制间接损害少数群体利益的意外后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗提供者应对公平政策提供指导，为政策制定者设计既社会有益又经济可持续的监管提供依据。

title: Impact of AI-driven product selection and quality disclosure on consumer purchase intention of the live streaming platform supply
affiliations: Qufu Normal University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Qufu Normal University

detail.title: Impact of AI-driven product selection and quality disclosure on consumer purchase intention of the live streaming platform supply
detail.abstract: To meet consumers expectations for experiential shopping during live streaming platform supply, an increasing number of manufacturers are considering the precision of their quality information disclosure. Low-precision and high-precision quality information disclosures have emerged as the two most prominent methods. Meanwhile, advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have led live streaming platforms to consider adopting AI-driven product selection. This study employs a Stackelberg game model within a dual-channel supply chain, where the manufacturer acts as the leader and the platform as the follower. We analyze key factors such as consumer risk aversion, trust advantage in the physical direct sales channel, and consumers purchase intention by AI-driven product selection in the live streaming resale channel. By comparing profitability under different scenarios, we determine the manufacturers optimal disclosure strategy and the platforms decision on AI-driven product selection adoption. The results are as follows: (1) Even with negligible cost, low-precision disclosure does not always benefit manufacturers, as consumer trust in the physical channel may encourage higher precision. (2) The platform should adopt AI when low-precision disclosure coincides with high purchase intention enhancement, or when high-precision disclosure is paired with non-moderate intention enhancement. (3) AI-driven product selection adoption improves the effectiveness of manufacturers disclosure and alleviates cost pressures related to high-precision efforts. Consumer surplus analysis and numerical simulations further support the robustness of these conclusions.

AI.tldr: 研究直播平台供应链中制造商的质���信息披露策略和平台AI选品决策，发现在消费者信任实体渠道时，制造商应选择高精度披露；平台应在特定条件下采用AI选品，AI能提升信息披露效果并缓解高精度披露成本压力。
AI.research_question: 制造商在直播平台供应链中应选择何种质量信息披露精度策略？平台何时应该采用AI驱动的产品选择？
AI.motivation: 满足消费者对直播购物体验的期望，制造商需要精确披露质量信息，同时AI技术的发展让平台考虑采用AI选品，需要研究两者在双渠道供应链中的最优决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stackelberg博弈模型，制造商作为领导者，平台作为跟随者，在双渠道供应链中分析决策问题。
AI.method: 采用Stackelberg博弈模型，分析消费者风险规避、实体直销渠道信任优势、直播转售渠道AI选品购买意愿等关键因素，比较不同情景下的盈利能力。
AI.findings: 1. 即使成本可忽略，低精度披露不一定对制造商有利；2. 平台应在特定条件下采用AI选品；3. AI选品能提升信息披露效果并缓解高精度披露成本压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了双渠道供应链中质量信息披露策略和AI技术采用决策的理论研究，为直播电商环境下的企业决策提供理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造商制定质量信息披露策略和平台AI选品决策提供具体指导，帮助企业优化供应链管理，提升消费者体验和盈利能力。

title: Technofeudalism's Impact on Geopolitics: Platforms, Power, and the Rewiring of the International System
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Technofeudalism's Impact on Geopolitics: Platforms, Power, and the Rewiring of the International System
detail.abstract: This paper examines how the rise of "technofeudalism",a term popularized by Yanis Varoufakis to describe a political-economic order dominated by digital platforms exercising quasi-sovereign power,reshapes geopolitics. It argues that platform-controlled infrastructures (cloud, chips, app stores, AI models, payment rails, logistics, and standards) now function as instruments of statecraft, coercion, and strategic autonomy. The paper develops an analytical framework that integrates technofeudal rents, data colonialism, and digital sovereignty, then applies it to four arenas: (1) the U.S.-China technology conflict (semiconductors, AI compute, and standards), (2) European regulatory statecraft (DMA/DSA and 5G security), (3) payment and connectivity weaponization (SWIFT, card networks, Starlink), and (4) the Global South's strategic choices (Digital Public Infrastructure vs. platform dependency; CBDCs). The discussion highlights feedback loops between corporate governance and national power, showing how "platform mercantilism" and "infrastructure coercion" redistribute geopolitical leverage. The conclusion outlines policy options to prevent a race to dependency and to anchor digital markets in public law and open standards.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了"技术封建主义"（数字平台行使准主权权力的政治经济秩序）如何重塑地缘政治，分析了平台控制的基础设施如何成为国家治理、胁迫和战略自主的工具，并提出了整合技术封建租金、数据殖民主义和数字主权的分析框架。
AI.research_question: 技术封建主义的兴起如何重塑地缘政治格局？
AI.motivation: 数字平台通过控制关键基础设施（云服务、芯片、应用商店、AI模型、支付系统等）获得了准主权权力，这种"技术封建主义"正在改变传统的地缘政治动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了技术封建租金理论、数据殖民主义理论和数字主权理论的分析框架。
AI.method: 开发分析框架并应用于四个领域：美中技术冲突、欧洲监管治国、支付和连接武器化、全球南方的战略选择。
AI.findings: 平台控制的基础设施已成为国家治理、胁迫和战略自主的工具，企业治理与国家权力之间存在反馈循环，"平台重商主义"和"基础设施胁迫"正在重新分配地缘政治影响力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合技术封建主义、数据殖民主义和数字主权的分析框架，揭示了平台基础设施作为地缘政治工具的新作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了防止依赖性竞赛、将数字市场锚定在公共法和开放标准中的政策选项建议。

Robin Halpern: Managing Investor Relations at Coca-Cola

In September 2025, Robin Halpern was reviewing The Coca-Cola Company's (Coca-Cola's) Q3 earnings data. As the company's vice president and head of investor relations (IR), she held a key role in communicating Coca-Cola's financial performance to various stakeholders, including financial analysts, individual investors, and the company's employees. To do so, she needed to transform the latest figures on the company's revenue, profit, and growth into a story that would resonate with each of these different groups.

Halpern brought extensive experience to this work. She joined Coca-Cola in January 2020 and went on to navigate several periods of significant financial uncertainty, from the COVID-19 pandemic to a number of unusual, complex events, including unprecedented inflation and geopolitical conflict. Each earnings release had its own unique challenges. Audience communication preferences were constantly evolving, sell-side analysts were covering an ever-increasing number of companies, and competition for audiences' limited attention spans was intensifying across all channels.

How should Halpern prepare Coca-Cola's latest earnings release? What narrative should she recommend for investors? How should she work with her colleagues to communicate with Coca-Cola's diverse—and ever-evolving—stakeholder groups?

The Coca-Cola Company

Coca-Cola was first served in 1886 in Atlanta, Georgia, and the product went on to become the basis for a multinational beverage company. By 2024, the company was selling beverages across more than 200 different brands, including Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fairlife, Simply, and Fanta. For 2024, it reported $47.1 billion in net operating revenues, a 3% year-over-year increase, and it had an estimated $268 billion market capitalization. Sparkling soft drinks represented 69% of the company's volume in 2024. Energy drinks, coffees and teas, waters and other hydration products, juices, dairy, and plant-based beverages made up most of the remaining 31%. The company's value share within the nonalcoholic ready-to-drink (NARTD) beverage sector had increased, while its comparable earnings per share (non-GAAP) increased 7% year over year (including a 9% currency headwind). In its Q4 2024 earnings press release, the company projected that its organic revenues (non-GAAP) would grow between 5% and 6% over the coming year.

AI.tldr: 该案例研究探讨了可口可乐公司投资者关系副总裁Robin Halpern如何将公司财务数据转化为针对不同利益相关者的有效沟通策略，包括财务分析师、个人投资者和员工。
AI.research_question: 投资者关系负责人如何将财务数据转化为针对不同利益相关者的有效沟通策略？
AI.motivation: 在竞争激烈的市场环境中，企业需要有效地向多元化利益相关者传达财务业绩，但不同群体的信息需求和沟通偏好存在差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论、财务沟通理论、叙事经济学

title: A Study On The Impact Of Google Ads On Lead Generation For Service-Based Businesses in Chennai
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Study On The Impact Of Google Ads On Lead Generation For Service-Based Businesses in Chennai
detail.abstract: Generating leads for service-based companies depends largely on Google Ads, but achieving the same quality and consistency has become difficult for most. When a campaign spends more or less than planned, it often causes the campaign to miss its goals. If keywords are not targeted well, it's more likely that the traffic you get won't help you close deals. Ads set at the wrong times are not seen as much when customers are the most likely to make a purchase. These issues not only consume extra money from the advertising budget but also reduce how much the business earns in return. The objective of the study is to analyse the impact of Google ads on lead generation for service-based businesses in Chennai. The study has covered the impact of Google Ads on lead generation for servicebased businesses in Chennai. The analysis is based only on the opinion and perception of the business owners and marketing managers of the service based companies. The total number of sample drawn for the study is 120 respondents. Sampling unit is in Chennai. Questionnaire has been framed and used to collect the data in order to analyse the objectives of the study. Descriptive research design and Convenience sampling techniques have been used for the study. Simple percentage analysis and Chi square analysis have been applied to reach the findings in the study. It is found that there is some significant relationship between the industry type and ad budget allocation. It is suggested that the organization should look at campaign data regularly and change its budget plan as needed, depending on how the leads respond. It is concluded that the quality leads obtained from using Google Ads by service businesses in Chennai depend mainly on setting a fitting budget, picking the correct keywords and optimizing ad display times. If these elements are dealt with effectively, a company can achieve more effective leads and enjoy a greater marketing return on investment.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了Google广告对金奈服务型企业潜在客户生成的影响，发现广告预算分配、关键词选择和广告展示时间优化是影响潜在客户质量的关键因素。
AI.research_question: Google广告对金奈服务型企业潜在客户生成的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 服务型企业依赖Google广告生成潜在客户，但大多数企业难以保持广告质量和一致性。预算偏差、关键词定位不准和广告时间设置不当等问题不仅消耗额外广告预算，还降低业务回报。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字营销理论、广告效果评估理论、潜在客户生成理论
AI.method: 采用描述性研究设计和便利抽样技术，通过问卷调查收集120名金奈服务型企业所有者和营销经理的意见和看法，使用简单百分比分析和卡方分析进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 行业类型与广告预算分配存在显著关系；Google广告产生的潜在客户质量主要取决于设定合适的预算、选择正确的关键词和优化广告展示时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对服务型企业Google广告效果影响因素的理解，特别是预算分配、关键词策略和时间优化的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议企业定期查看广告活动数据并根据潜在客户响应调整预算计划；通过有效管理预算、关键词和时间优化，企业可以获得更有效的潜在客户和更高的营销投资回报率。

title: Ethnogenesis of the Ukrainian People: An Analysis in the Context of the Celtic Theory of the Origin of RUS'
affiliations: Mukachevo State Agrarian College

detail.title: Ethnogenesis of the Ukrainian People: An Analysis in the Context of the Celtic Theory of the Origin of RUS'

keywords: Celtic Theory of the Origin of Rus’

contentFormat.other: Conference proceedings paper published in the materials of the International Scientific Conference.

detail.abstract: According to Leonid Zalyzniak`s concept of the ethnogenesis of Ukrainians, the overwhelming majority of European peoples living within the sphere of the cultural and historical influence of the Roman Empire were formed in the Early Middle Ages (5th–7th centuries) – including the French, English, Serbs, Croats, Poles, Ukrainians and others. Moreover, in Zalyzniak`s view, imperial peoples (Rome, England, Spain, Kyivan Rus`) engendered in their subordinate provinces so-called «daughter ethnoses» (Romance, English, Spanish, and Rus` groups), whose histories began within the corresponding empires. From this it follows that the Ruthenians/Ukrainians are not a part of the Russian ethnos; on the contrary, they became one of the factors in the formation of the Finno-Muscovite (Russian) ethnos.A further significant argument in favour of the early formation of the Ukrainian ethnos is provided by the linguistic research of Kostiantyn Tyshchenko. The scholar demonstrated that the Ukrainian language developed under the influence of ancient peoples who left a discernible imprint on its structure and lexicon. Tyshchenko identified ten historical «witnesses» of the Ukrainian language that reflect these processes.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于Zalyzniak的民族起源理论和Tyshchenko的语言学研究，论证乌克兰民族在中世纪早期形成，并非俄罗斯民族的一部分，而是芬兰-莫斯科民族形成的因素之一。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰民族何时形成及其与俄罗斯民族的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 澄清乌克兰民族的历史起源，反驳乌克兰是俄罗斯民族一部分的观点，确立乌克兰民族的独立历史地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: Leonid Zalyzniak的民族起源理论：帝国民族在附属省份产生"子民族"；Kostiantyn Tyshchenko的语言学分析：通过语言结构反映民族形成历史。
AI.method: 理论分析和语言学证据分析，通过历史民族形成理论和语言发展轨迹来论证。
AI.findings: 乌克兰民族在5-7世纪早期中世纪形成，是基辅罗斯帝国的"子民族"，而非俄罗斯民族的一部分；乌克兰语言发展受到古代民族影响，有十个历史"见证者"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了乌克兰民族起源的新理论框架，挑战了传统的民族关系认知，确立了乌克兰民族的独立历史地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰民族认同提供学术支持，有助于理解东欧民族关系的复杂性，对民族政策和历史教育具有参考价值。

detail.title: Factor Identification of Intention to Use Cybernetic Avatars using the Extended UTAUT2 Model

declarations.ethicsApproval: All study participants provided informed consent, and the study design was approved by the appropriate ethics review board. The name of the research ethics review committee is GLOCOM Research Ethics Review Committee, and the approval number is GE23006.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number JP23H00856 and JST Moonshot R&D Grant Number JPMJMS2215.

detail.abstract: As the cybernetic avatar (CA) technology expands beyond extended reality (XR) settings, understanding its acceptance is crucial. This study examines the behavioral intention (BI) to use CA using an extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2 (UTAUT2) that incorporates technophobia (TP). We conducted an online survey of 6,739 adults in Japan, South Korea, the United States, and Germany and analyzed it using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM). Results show that performance expectancy (PE), effort expectancy (EE), social influence (SI), hedonic motivation (HM), price value (PV), and facilitating conditions (FC) are positively associated with BI, whereas TP is negatively associated; SI exhibits the largest association overall. Crosscountry analyses indicate that SI and FC are especially salient in Japan, highlighting the value of cultivating social awareness in households, workplaces, and communities and of building accessible environments for adoption. This study advances this theory by integrating psychological resistance into models of emerging technology adoption and positioning CA as a distinct object of acceptance beyond XR. Practically, interventions that leverage SI (e.g., endorsements and community norms) and reduce anxiety (e.g., literacy building, onboarding design) may foster broader CA uptake.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过扩展UTAUT2模型纳入技术恐惧，调查了日本、韩国、美国和德国6,739名成年人对控制论化身技术的使用意愿。结果显示绩效期望、努力期望、社会影响、享乐动机、价格价值和促进条件正向影响使用意愿，技术恐惧负向影响，其中社会影响作用最大。跨文化分析显示日本特别重视社会影响和促进条件。
AI.research_question: 控制论化身技术的使用意愿受哪些因素影响？技术恐惧在技术接受模型中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 随着控制论化身技术扩展到扩展现实之外，理解其接受度至关重要。需要整合心理抵抗因素来完善新兴技术采纳模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的统一技术接受与使用理论2(UTAUT2)，加入了技术恐惧作为新变量。
AI.method: 对日本、韩国、美国和德国的6,739名成年人进行在线调查，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型(PLS-SEM)分析数据。
AI.findings: 绩效期望、努力期望、社会影响、享乐动机、价格价值和促进条件正向影响使用意愿，技术恐惧负向影响；社会影响作用最大；日本特别重视社会影响和促进条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过整合心理抵抗因素推进了新兴技术采纳理论，将控制论化身定位为超越扩展现实的独特接受对象。
AI.practical_contributions: 利用社会影响的干预措施和减少焦虑的策略可以促进控制论化身的广泛采用。

title: Influence of Personalized Marketing on Compulsive Buying among Young People in Kazakhstan
affiliations: Nazarbayev Intellectual School of Physics and Mathematics in Aktobe

detail.title: Influence of Personalized Marketing on Compulsive Buying among Young People in Kazakhstan
detail.abstract: This research aims to analyze the relationship between the personalized marketing strategies used on social media and the spread of compulsive buying behavior among young adults in Kazakhstan. By examining qualitative data from the interviews and quantitative data from the survey, certain patterns were found related to personalized advertisements and psychosocial attitudes. Additionally, the research attempts to provide possible solutions and recommendations regarding the issue, which might be useful for active social media users and concerned parents and friends.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析哈萨克斯坦年轻人中社交媒体个性化营销策略与强迫性购买行为传播之间的关系，通过访谈和问卷调查发现个性化广告与心理社会态度相关的模式，并提出对社交媒体用户和家长的解决方案建议。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体个性化营销策略与哈萨克斯坦年轻人强迫性购买行为传播之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 分析社交媒体个性化营销对年轻人强迫性购买行为的影响，为社交媒体用户、家长和朋友提供解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 个性化营销理论、强迫性购买行为理论、心理社会态度理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：定性访谈和定量问卷调查
AI.findings: 发现个性化广告与心理社会态度相关的特定模式，表明个性化营销策略与强迫性购买行为传播存在关联
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了个性化营销对强迫性购买行为影响的理论理解，特别是在哈萨克斯坦年轻人群体的背景下
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交媒体用户、家长和朋友提供实用的解决方案和建议，帮助识别和应对强迫性购买行为

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了人工智能和机器学习在数据建模和决策科学中的应用，特别是在处理实时大数据集时提高准确性的方法。重点研究了人工神经网络和进化算法在药物开发研究中的组合应用，准确率达到88-90%。论文还讨论了该方法在服务和制造部门的扩展应用，以及使用无监督学习算法进行详细研究。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能和机器学习方法提高大数据分析在决策科学中的准确性？特别是人工神经网络和进化算法在药物开发和其他行业中的应用效果如何？
AI.motivation: 随着大数据时代的到来，传统的数据建模方法在处理实时大数据集时面临准确性挑战。人工智能和机器学习方法能够提供更窄的概率估计区间和更低的假阴性和假阳性率，为商业智能和风险评估提供更可靠的分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人工神经网络、进化算法、人工自适应系统理论、贝叶斯框架和梯度下降算法。这些理论框架共同构成了处理复杂非线性变量和优化分类器性能的基础。
AI.method: 采用人工神经网络与进化算法相结合的方法，使用交叉验证协议，处理包含31个变量的数据集。在扩展研究中使用无监督学习算法处理150+变量的动态数学模型。
AI.findings: 人工神经网络与进化算法组合在药物开发研究中达到88-90%的准确率，优于逻辑回归分类器。该方法能够有效预测药物疗效，提高临床试验的内部效度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人工自适应系统方法论，将神经网络与进化算法结合，为处理复杂非线性问题提供了新的理论框架。扩展了贝叶斯框架中梯度下降算法的应用，提高了分类器性能。
AI.practical_contributions: 该方法可应用于药物开发、制造缺陷检测、组织流程优化、消费者行为分析、投资项目风险评估等多个领域。在预测性维护中，结合ARIMA和ANN的预测六西格玛框架能够提前数周或数月发出维护警报，提高设备整体效能。

title: Digital Tools in Teaching Chinese Language and Culture: Implementing Culturological and Person-Activity Approaches in Higher Education

detail.title: Digital Tools in Teaching Chinese Language and Culture: Implementing Culturological and Person-Activity Approaches in Higher Education

keywords: Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language

detail.abstract: This article explores the integration of digital tools into teaching Chinese language and culture through the dual framework of the culturological and person-activity approaches. It argues that modern higher education demands a shift from reproductive methods to student-centered learning focused on developing intercultural communicative competence. The study posits that digital resources, when methodically applied, transcend their auxiliary role to become a crucial element in creating an immersive and personalized learning environment. The paper provides a theoretical justification for this integration and offers a practical classification of digital tools based on their target competencies. A detailed model lesson on the "Chinese Tea Ceremony" is presented to illustrate the three-phase implementation of these approaches-from activation and motivation, through content comprehension, to reflection and creative project work. The conclusion emphasizes that this methodology transforms the classroom into a dynamic, communicative space where students can "experience" culture rather than just learn about it, thereby effectively fostering a holistic foreign language communicative competence necessary for real-world dialogue with the Chinese linguaculture.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在文化学和个人活动双重框架下将数字工具整合到汉语语言文化教学中。研究认为现代高等教育需要从复制性方法转向以学生为中心的学习，重点发展跨文化交际能力。数字资源经过系统应用后，从辅助角色转变为创建沉浸式和个性化学习环境的关键要素。
AI.research_question: 如何通过文化学和个人活动双重框架将数字工具有效整合到汉语语言文化教学中，以培养学生的跨文化交际能力？
AI.motivation: 现代高等教育需要从传统的复制性教学方法转向以学生为中心的学习模式，重点发展学生的跨文化交际能力，以适应全球化背景下的教育需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化学方法和个人活动方法双重理论框架
AI.method: 提供理论论证和数字工具分类，并通过"中国茶道"示范课程展示三阶段实施模型（激活与动机、内容理解、反思与创意项目）
AI.findings: 数字工具经过系统应用后，能够超越辅助角色，成为创建沉浸式和个性化学习环境的关键要素，将课堂转变为动态的交际空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字工具在语言文化教学中的整合提供了理论依据，提出了基于目标能力的数字工具分类方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的教学实施模型和三阶段教学方法，通过"中国茶道"示范课程展示了如何让学生"体验"文化而不仅仅是学习文化知识。

title: Developing Intercultural Competence Via the Linguacultural Component in Chinese Language Teaching (The Case of MGIMO)

detail.title: Developing Intercultural Competence Via the Linguacultural Component in Chinese Language Teaching (The Case of MGIMO)
detail.abstract: In the modern world, knowledge of a foreign language is not only knowledge of grammar and vocabulary. This is, first of all, the development of the culture and mentality of the people who speak this language. This is especially true for those who are going to build a career in international economics and business. Intercultural competence is the ability to understand and respect the cultural characteristics of other countries, adapt to them and interact effectively [Khosainova, 2018, pp. 519-521]. Particular attention is paid to the fact that the study of a language is inextricably linked with the knowledge of the culture of the country that speaks this language [Sorokin, 2022b, p. 664]. For students of the Faculty of Economics of MGIMO, this is especially important, since in their future professional activities it will be necessary to negotiate, conclude deals and find a common language with representatives of China in international business. For modern graduates of Russian universities, knowledge of Chinese grammar and vocabulary alone is not enough for successful communication with foreign partners. It is also necessary to understand the cultural norms, traditions, foundations and mentality of Chinese society, which helps to avoid misunderstandings and conflicts. The development of intercultural competence contributes to the formation of students' adaptability and flexibility in communication, which is a valuable professional skill [Obukhova, 2023, p. 146]. A characteristic feature of teaching Chinese at MGIMO is the presence of a linguistic and cultural component, which helps students not only to learn the language, but to better understand Chinese culture, traditions and features of the social behavior of native speakers. It considers the linguistic and cultural component as an integrated part of training aimed at introducing students to the cultural, historical and social context of China. Within the framework of teaching the Chinese language, linguistic and cultural studies include the study of traditional holidays, lifestyle, cultural symbols, etiquette, features of business communication and the historical development of the country. The development of cultural material in the teaching process, in particular during the preparation of curricula, lesson materials and teaching aids (including textbooks, textbooks, monographs and other scientific and methodological works created at the Department of Chinese, Vietnamese, Burmese, Thai, Lao and Khmer Languages of MGIMO) helps students to see the language in a living socio-cultural context, which increases motivation to learn and improves general language competence. Examples of this are the scientific publications of the staff of the department [Maslovets, 2020], [Aleksakhin, 2019], [Barsky, 2024].

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了在MGIMO经济学院汉语教学中融入语言文化成分的重要性，强调跨文化能力对国际商务专业学生的必要性，以及如何通过文化教学提升学生的语言学习和专业适应能力。
AI.research_question: 如何在MGIMO经济学院的汉语教学中有效融入语言文化成分，以培养学生的跨文化能力？
AI.motivation: 现代国际商务环境中，仅掌握汉语语法和词汇不足以成功沟通，需要理解中国文化、传统和思维方式，避免误解和冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨文化能力理论、语言文化教学理论、文化适应理论
AI.method: 通过课程设计、教材开发（包括教科书、专著等）和课堂教学，系统融入中国传统节日、生活方式、文化符号、礼仪、商务沟通特点等内容。
AI.findings: 语言文化成分的融入能帮助学生将语言置于真实的社会文化背景中，提高学习动机和整体语言能力，培养适应性和沟通灵活性。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了语言教学中文化成分整合的理论框架，为跨文化能力培养提供了具体实施路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MGIMO及其他高校的汉语教学提供了可操作的教学模式和方法，帮助学生在国际商务环境中更有效地与中国伙伴沟通。

title: The Great Convergence: How Technology Diffusion is Accelerating Poverty Reduction in Emerging Economies (2000-2050)

detail.title: The Great Convergence: How Technology Diffusion is Accelerating Poverty Reduction in Emerging Economies (2000-2050)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founder and CEO of HHeuristics, a research and insights company. This affiliation did not influence the design, analysis, or interpretation of the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study as it relies solely on publicly available secondary data and does not involve human participants or private data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Emerging economies have experienced a dramatic convergence in living standards since 2000, fueled in large part by the rapid diffusion of technology. This paper examines how the spread of digital infrastructure and innovations – from mobile phones and broadband internet to fintech, agritech, edtech, e-commerce, and artificial intelligence – is transforming livelihoods and accelerating the reduction of extreme poverty across the developing world, with a particular focus on Africa. We synthesize extensive literature and data on technology adoption and poverty outcomes between 2000 and 2023, finding that technological optimization and diffusion have become key drivers of inclusive growth and economic inclusion. We also develop forward-looking projections through 2050, which suggest that under optimistic scenarios of sustained tech-driven growth, global extreme poverty could fall below 2% – effectively a historic eradication – with Africa’s poverty rate declining from ~29% today to under 7%, or even below 2% if high growth is maintained. The paper is structured in formal academic format with sections on literature review, theoretical framework, methodology, historical trends, regional case studies, technological mechanisms, empirical evidence, projections, risks, and policy and private sector implications. Our analysis reveals multiple pathways through which technology diffusion reduces poverty: improving market efficiency and incomes (e.g. via mobile connectivity in agriculture), expanding financial inclusion (mobile money and fintech), increasing access to education and services (edtech and e-health), and creating new economic opportunities (e-commerce and digital jobs). At the same time, we acknowledge the risks of a “digital divide” and skill-biased technical change that could exacerbate inequities if not managed. We conclude with recommendations for policymakers – such as investing in digital infrastructure, education, and inclusive innovation – and for private sector actors to ensure that the next decades of technological progress foster broad-based prosperity. This “Great Convergence” of technology and development, if harnessed effectively, could enable emerging economies to leapfrog past traditional barriers and achieve unprecedented reductions in extreme poverty by 2050, making significant strides toward the Sustainable Development Goals.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2000-2023年技术扩散对新兴经济体减贫的影响，并预测到2050年。研究发现技术优化和扩散是包容性增长的关键驱动力，通过改善市场效率、扩大金融包容性、增加教育服务获取和创造新经济机会等途径减少贫困。乐观情景下，2050年全球极端贫困率可降至2%以下。
AI.research_question: 数字技术和创新（移动通信、金融科技、农业科技等）如何影响新兴经济体的减贫进程？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体自2000年以来经历了生活水平的显著趋同，主要驱动力是技术的快速扩散，需要系统分析技术对减贫的具体影响机制和未来潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术扩散理论、包容性增长理论、数字鸿沟理论、技能偏向型技术变革理论
AI.method: 文献综述与数据综合分析（2000-2023年技术采用与贫困结果数据），区域案例研究，未来预测模型（至2050年）
AI.findings: 技术扩散通过多种途径减少贫困：改善市场效率和收入、扩大金融包容性、增加教育和服务获取、创造新经济机会。乐观情景下2050年全球极端贫困率可降至2%以下，非洲贫困率从29%降至7%甚至2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对技术扩散减贫机制的理解，提出了"大趋同"概念，整合了技术扩散理论与包容性发展理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供数字基础设施投资、教育和包容性创新建议，为私营部门提供确保技术促进广泛繁荣的指导，支持可持续发展目标的实现

title: Beyond Creation and Redemption: Principal Trading by Bond ETFs
affiliations: University of Waterloo, Cornell University - Samuel Curtis Johnson Graduate School of Management, Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Finance Department and Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Finance Department

detail.title: Beyond Creation and Redemption: Principal Trading by Bond ETFs
detail.abstract: We investigate principal trading in corporate bond ETFs. While rare in equity ETFs, we show that principal trading by bond ETF managers is widespread, occurring on 35% of trading days, more often than either creations or redemptions. Adjusted for ETF size, volumes of principal trading and creation/redemption are comparable. Because bond ETFs hold more issues and face maturities, redemptions, and credit migrations, we show how principal trading allows passive bond ETF managers to more effectively align bond holdings and reduce tracking error. Principal trading also increases portfolio alpha for active ETFs by 25 basis points.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现债券ETF中做市商交易普遍存在，占交易日的35%，频率超过申购赎回。这种交易方式有助于被动债券ETF更好地管理投资组合和降低跟踪误差，同时使主动ETF的阿尔法收益提高25个基点。
AI.research_question: 债券ETF中的做市商交易如何影响ETF管理和绩效？
AI.motivation: 与股票ETF不同，债券ETF中做市商交易现象普遍但研究较少，需要了解其对ETF管理和绩效的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ETF做市机制理论、债券投资组合管理理论和跟踪误差理论。
AI.method: 实证分析债券ETF的交易数据，比较做市商交易与申购赎回的频率和规模。
AI.findings: 做市商交易在债券ETF中普遍存在（35%交易日），频率超过申购赎回；有助于被动ETF降低跟踪误差，使主动ETF阿尔法收益提高25个基点。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了ETF做市理论在债券市场的应用，揭示了做市商交易在债券ETF管理中的独特作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为债券ETF管理者提供了通过做市商交易优化投资组合管理的新策略，有助于提高ETF绩效和降低跟踪误差。

title: Good Energy Governance: Integrating Technology Governance and Dynamic Capabilities for Sustainable Growth

detail.title: Good Energy Governance: Integrating Technology Governance and Dynamic Capabilities for Sustainable Growth
detail.abstract: The shift to sustainable energy is being understood increasingly as a governance issue, as opposed to a technological or financial issue. GEG (Good Energy Governance) supplies an integrated paradigm that merges concepts from various streams of ethical governance, systems of innovation, and dynamic capabilities to design organizations that learn, adapt, and innovate over time. This research outlines a multi-layered conceptual framework for GEG and investigates one of the foundational elements of dynamic capability in the public sector and its corresponding influence on policy formulation and organization performance. Focusing on Indonesia for its energy transition and ASEAN for its regional energy cooperation, the paper underscores the strategic importance of foresight and adaptive learning in combination with cross-border cooperation to transform systems of energy for resilience, inclusivity, and sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了良好能源治理(GEG)的多层次概念框架，重点研究公共部门动态能力对政策制定和组织绩效的影响，以印尼和东盟为案例，强调前瞻性和适应性学习结合跨境合作对能源系统转型的重要性。
AI.research_question: 公共部门的动态能力如何影响能源治理政策制定和组织绩效？
AI.motivation: 能源转型日益被视为治理问题而非技术或金融问题，需要整合伦理治理、创新系统和动态能力来设计能够学习、适应和创新的组织。
AI.theoretical_framework: 良好能源治理(GEG)框架，整合了伦理治理、创新系统和动态能力理论。
AI.method: 概念框架构建与案例研究，聚焦印尼能源转型和东盟区域能源合作。
AI.findings: 前瞻性和适应性学习与跨境合作相结合对能源系统转型具有战略重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合伦理治理、创新系统和动态能力的多层次GEG概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共部门在能源转型中如何通过动态能力提升政策制定和组织绩效提供了实践指导。

title: Out-of-Stock, Out-of-Store? Estimating Cross-Store Fulfillment via Inferring Customer Journeys
affiliations: McGill University - Desautels Faculty of Management, McGill University - Desautels Faculty of Management, McGill University - Desautels Faculty of Management and McGill University - Desautels Faculty of Management

detail.title: Out-of-Stock, Out-of-Store? Estimating Cross-Store Fulfillment via Inferring Customer Journeys
detail.abstract:
In this age of omnichannel retailing, many brick-and-mortar retailers use in-store "endless aisle" technology that provides real-time visibility into network-wide inventory. When a requested product is unavailable in-store, this system enables fulfillment from another store, potentially mitigating lost sales. Despite the growing adoption of such cross-store fulfillment, little is known about its actual effectiveness in saving sales under stockout conditions and its revenue impact on retailers. Prior academic work has focused mainly on how customers respond to stockouts through in-store substitutions. Using detailed product request logs, transaction data, and inventory records from a large footwear retail chain equipped with endless aisle technology, we are the first to study the extent to which customers facing stockouts accept cross-store fulfillment, the factors driving this behavior, and the value of this capability to the retailer. 

We adopt a two-stage empirical approach. In the first stage, we model the incidence of stockouts to account for potential endogeneity. In the second stage, we estimate a multinomial regression model of customer decision-making, incorporating a control-function correction (a two-stage residual inclusion approach). Using data from two large North American states, we find that stockouts affect over 25% of product requests and reduce purchase probability by about 35 percentage points. However, the cross-store fulfillment strategy is able to recover more than one-fifth (about 21.4%) of potential stockout-induced lost sales for the retailer, with substantial heterogeneity across stores, products, and customers. 

Our analysis provides the first empirical measurement of cross-store fulfillment as a lever for mitigating stockout-driven revenue risk in brick-and-mortar retail. Heterogeneity in cross-store fulfillment rates enables retailers to proactively reposition inventory during shortages. Using an illustrative optimization model calibrated to our partner retailer's data, we show that proactive transshipment accounting for cross-store fulfillment increases revenue by nearly 4%. Moreover, accounting for store-level heterogeneity alone captures almost all the gains, offering a simple and effective approach for retailers to enhance profitability.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了实体零售商采用"无尽货架"技术进行跨店配送对缺货情况下销售损失的影响。研究发现缺货影响25%以上的产品请求，但跨店配送能挽回约21.4%的潜在销售损失，通过主动转运库存可增加近4%的收入。
AI.research_question: 面对缺货时，顾客接受跨店配送的程度如何？哪些因素驱动这种行为？这种能力对零售商的价值是什么？
AI.motivation: 在全渠道零售时代，实体零售商广泛采用"无尽货架"技术提供全网库存可见性，但缺乏关于跨店配送在缺货情况下实际有效性和收入影响的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用两阶段实证方法：第一阶段建模缺货发生率以解决潜在内生性问题，第二阶段使用多项回归模型分析顾客决策行为，并采用控制函数校正。
AI.method: 使用大型鞋类零售链的详细产品请求日志、交易数据和库存记录，采用两阶段残差包含方法进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 缺货影响超过25%的产品请求，使购买概率降低约35个百分点；跨店配送策略能为零售商挽回约21.4%的潜在缺货销售损失；跨店配送率存在显著的店铺、产品和顾客异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证测量跨店配送作为缓解实体零售缺货驱动收入风险的工具；揭示了跨店配送行为的异质性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 零售商可在缺货期间主动重新定位库存；考虑跨店配送的主动转运可增加近4%的收入；仅考虑店铺层面异质性就能获得几乎全部收益，为零售商提供了简单有效的盈利提升方法。

title: An Evolving AI Supply Chain
affiliations: Augur

detail.title: An Evolving AI Supply Chain
detail.abstract: This paper identifies key areas of change and uncertainty across the frontier AI supply chain by examining five interconnected segments: data, compute, hardware, critical minerals, and capital. Key dynamics highlighted include increasing scarcity and cost of high-quality data, the rise of national "cloud sovereignty" initiatives, increasing investment by AI model developers in designing custom chips for training and inference, the importance of critical minerals for hardware manufacturing and energy production, and new cross-segment strategic investments by model developers and hardware companies. The paper depicts a supply chain with high concentration in some segments, but which is becoming increasingly multi-polar and contested over time.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析AI供应链的五个关键环节（数据、算力、硬件、关键矿物、资本），揭示了前沿AI供应链的变化趋势和不确定性，指出供应链在部分环节高度集中但整体呈现多极化和竞争加剧的趋势。
AI.research_question: 前沿AI供应链的关键变化领域和不确定性是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解AI供应链的演变动态和潜在风险，为政策制定和产业决策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链分析框架，重点关注五个相互关联的环节：数据、算力、硬件、关键矿物和资本。
AI.method: 通过对AI供应链五个关键环节的深入分析，识别变化趋势和不确定性因素。
AI.findings: 高质量数据日益稀缺和昂贵；国家"云主权"倡议兴起；AI模型开发者加大定制芯片投资；关键矿物对硬件制造和能源生产至关重要；模型开发者和硬件公司进行跨环节战略投资；供应链部分环节高度集中但整体呈现多极化和竞争加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了AI供应链的多环节分析框架，揭示了供应链结构从集中向多极化转变的动态过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、产业参与者和投资者提供了AI供应链风险识别和战略决策的参考依据。

title: The Hidden Costs of Domestic Violence Against Women: Spillovers on Children's Socioemotional Development
affiliations: and Federal University of Ceara

detail.title: The Hidden Costs of Domestic Violence Against Women: Spillovers on Children's Socioemotional Development
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the intergenerational effects of domestic violence against women on the socioemotional development of children. Using a unique Brazilian survey that directly links maternal victimization to standardized assessments of children's socioemotional skills, we examine how the type and timing of violence shape early outcomes. To address potential endogeneity, we implement an instrumental variable strategy exploiting proximity to women's police stations. We find that children aged three to five years whose mothers were victims of domestic violence exhibit socioemotional deficits of 0.6 to 1.2 standard deviations relative to their peers, with cumulative exposure further amplifying these effects. Suggestive evidence indicates that both pre-and post-conception exposure contribute to harm, with particularly large impacts from sexual violence and some evidence that repeated psychological abuse also exacerbates deficits. Together, these findings highlight the profound and enduring developmental costs of domestic violence across generations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，母亲遭受家庭暴力会对3-5岁儿童的社交情绪发展产生显著负面影响，造成0.6-1.2个标准差的发育滞后，其中性暴力和重复心理虐待的伤害尤为严重。
AI.research_question: 家庭暴力对女性受害者的子女在社交情绪发展方面有何代际影响？暴力的类型和发生时机如何塑造早期发展结果？
AI.motivation: 了解家庭暴力对儿童发展的代际影响，揭示暴力类型和时机对儿童社交情绪发展的具体作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭暴力代际传递理论，关注暴力暴露对儿童早期发展的累积影响机制。
AI.method: 使用巴西独特调查数据，将母亲受害情况与儿童标准化评估直接关联，采用工具变量法（利用妇女警察局的邻近性）解决内生性问题。
AI.findings: 母亲遭受家庭暴力的3-5岁儿童在社交情绪发展上比同龄人滞后0.6-1.2个标准差；累积暴露会加剧这些影响；孕前和孕后暴露均造成伤害；性暴力和重复心理虐待的影响尤为严重。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对家庭暴力代际影响机制的理解，揭示了暴力类型和时机在儿童发展中的差异化作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为针对家庭暴力受害妇女及其子女的早期干预政策提供了实证依据，强调了预防和干预的重要性。

title: The Core Theory: Co-Creation of Retention and Engagement
affiliations: Durham University Business School

detail.title: The Core Theory: Co-Creation of Retention and Engagement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial conflicts of interest related to the conduct, analysis, or reporting of this study. The research was undertaken as part of the author’s doctoral work at Durham University Business School and was conducted independently of any commercial or financial influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval for this research was granted by the Durham University Business School Ethics Committee (Reference: DUBS/2024/059/EA). All participant data were anonymised prior to analysis and handled in full compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the South African Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). The study involved no experimental manipulation or intervention with human subjects beyond standard informed-consent and opt-in engagement processes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted as part of the author’s Doctorate in Business Administration (DBA) at Durham University, with access to data and operational context provided by Capfin, a division of Pepkor Payments & Lending (South Africa), under existing research ethics approval and data governance protocols.

detail.abstract: This working paper presents CORE Theory (Co-Creation of Retention and Engagement), a behavioural framework that explains how ethically grounded, autonomy-supportive service interactions foster emotional engagement, which then leads to measurable retention. Developed over eight months through a longitudinal gamification study involving more than 100,000 micro-lending participants, CORE combines Self-Determination Theory, Service-Dominant Logic, and Behavioural Economics within a falsifiable A → E → R model (Autonomy → Engagement → Retention). Results show a 40–80% increase in behaviour across three independent cohorts compared to matched controls. Unlike SDT or SDL, CORE pinpoints specific design-level causal factors—such as choice structure, feedback type, reversibility, and ethical transparency—and indicates that autonomy-supportive designs only promote sustained participation when ethically sound (Ethics Index ≥ 3). This framework offers a testable, ethically grounded extension of customer retention theory, linking motivational design and service co-creation to long-term behavioural outcomes.

AI.tldr: CORE理论是一个行为框架，解释道德基础、支持自主的服务互动如何促进情感投入，进而提高用户留存率。该理论结合自我决定理论、服务主导逻辑和行为经济学，通过大规模游戏化研究发现自主支持设计能提升40-80%的行为表现，但前提是道德指数≥3。
AI.research_question: 道德基础、支持自主的服务互动如何通过情感投入影响用户留存率？
AI.motivation: 现有理论如自我决定理论和服务主导逻辑未能明确设计层面的因果因素，且缺乏对道德因素的考量，需要开发一个可测试的行为框架来解释服务共创如何影响长期行为结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论、服务主导逻辑、行为经济学
AI.method: 为期8个月的纵向游戏化研究，涉及超过10万小额贷款参与者，采用匹配对照组设计
AI.findings: 相比匹配对照组，三个独立队列的行为表现提高了40-80%；自主支持设计只有在道德指数≥3时才促进持续参与；确定了选择结构、反馈类型、可逆性和道德透明度等具体设计层面的因果因素
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了客户留存理论的可测试、道德基础的扩展，将动机设计和服务共创与长期行为结果联系起来
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务设计者提供了具体的、可操作的设计因素（如选择结构、反馈类型等），确保自主支持设计在道德框架内有效促进用户留存

title: The Energy Industry’s Response to Competitive Intelligence in Green Marketing (Case Study of Qatar)
affiliations: Islamic Azad University and Islamic Azad University

detail.title: The Energy Industry’s Response to Competitive Intelligence in Green Marketing (Case Study of Qatar)
detail.abstract: Competitive intelligence can be used as a catalyst to guide green marketing strategies as well as to create and maintain competitive advantage. The purpose of this article is to identify and rank the effective factors of competitive intelligence on green marketing and understand the effects of competitive intelligence components on green marketing components. This is a descriptive and applied research that was conducted on a case-by-case basis among the employees of 4 companies that are active in the field of energy industry in Qatar. The research tool is a questionnaire that confirmed the convergent and divergent validity of the two-stage structure. Analysis by PLS software showed that competitive intelligence has a positive effect on green marketing. Also, the ranking of the components was determined completely. The results of this research state that competitive intelligence as a strategic marketing management tool can modify their approaches to differentiate themselves from others and position themselves as industry leaders in sustainability. According to the study background, this research has an important contribution to the existing knowledge in terms of subject and geographical area and provides a suitable insight to the decision makers of this field.

AI.tldr: 本研究识别并排序了竞争情报对绿色营销的影响因素，发现在卡塔尔能源行业企业中，竞争情报对绿色营销有积极影响，可作为战略营销管理工具帮助企业实现可持续发展领导地位。
AI.research_question: 竞争情报对绿色营销的有效因素是什么？这些因素如何排序？竞争情报各组成部分如何影响绿色营销的组成部分？
AI.motivation: 竞争情报可作为指导绿色营销策略和创造竞争优势的催化剂，需要理解竞争情报如何影响绿色营销的具体机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争情报理论、绿色营销理论、战略营销管理理论
AI.method: 描述性应用研究，采用案例研究方法，对卡塔尔4家能源行业企业员工进行问卷调查，使用PLS软件进行数据分析，验证了两阶段结构的收敛效度和区分效度
AI.findings: 竞争情报对绿色营销有积极影响；确定了各影响因素的完整排序；竞争情报可作为战略营销管理工具帮助企业调整策略，实现差异化并成为可持续发展领域的行业领导者
AI.theory_contributions: 在主题和地理区域方面对现有知识有重要贡献，扩展了竞争情报与绿色营销关系的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供合适的洞察，帮助企业利用竞争情报优化绿色营销策略，在可持续发展领域建立竞争优势

title: Retailing in an Age of Change: Lessons from the Dynamic Saudi Arabian Market
affiliations: Islamic Azad University

detail.title: Retailing in an Age of Change: Lessons from the Dynamic Saudi Arabian Market

declarations.ethicsApproval: The article does not involve any studies with human participants or animals conducted by the authors.

detail.abstract: This study examines the key factors for the survival and success of new retail stores in Saudi Arabia. Due to economic growth and population growth, the retail sector in this country has witnessed the emergence of numerous stores, many of which have faced serious challenges and have been eliminated from the competition. Using a qualitative method and interviews with 17 retail industry experts, this study identified the essential elements at the time of establishment and effective strategies for the survival of new businesses. The findings show that determining the organizational vision and mission, market analysis, choosing a strategic location, managing expert human resources and using modern technologies are among the key factors for success. Also, the use of Kaizen theory, careful financial monitoring and crisis management through the formation of working groups play an important role in the survival of these businesses. By providing practical models and applicable strategies, this study helps investors and managers of new stores to make more informed decisions and prevent potential failures. The results of this study can be used as a guide for the sustainable development of retail businesses in competitive environments and help improve the conditions of small businesses and economic development.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定性方法和专家访谈，识别了沙特阿拉伯新零售店成功的关键因素，包括组织愿景使命、市场分析、战略选址、人力资源管理和现代技术应用等。
AI.research_question: 沙特阿拉伯新零售店生存和成功的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 由于经济增长和人口增长，沙特零售业涌现众多新店，但许多面临严重挑战并在竞争中被淘汰。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kaizen理论（持续改进理论）
AI.method: 定性研究方法，对17位零售行业专家进行访谈
AI.findings: 确定组织愿景和使命、市场分析、选择战略位置、管理专业人力资源和使用现代技术是成功的关键因素；Kaizen理论应用、仔细的财务监控和通过组建工作组的危机管理对生存至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了零售业生存和发展的理论框架，特别是Kaizen理论在零售业的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和新店管理者提供实用模型和策略，帮助做出更明智决策，预防潜在失败，促进零售业务可持续发展和经济改善。

title: Future Generations, Future Strategies: Preparing Businesses for Gen Z & Alpha

detail.title: Future Generations, Future Strategies: Preparing Businesses for Gen Z & Alpha

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A

detail.abstract: The rise of Generation Z (born 1997-2012) and Generation Alpha (born 2013-2025) is creating a global market shift. By 2030, these generations will represent over 60% of the world's consumers, controlling a spending power of nearly $4.4 trillion annually. Their expectations, behaviors, and values differ significantly from previous generationsdemanding rapid changes in business strategy. This paper analyzes key shifts in fashion, lifestyle, technology adoption, and brand loyalty, and explores how businesses of various sizes (micro, SME, and large enterprises) can adapt. The research combines market data, case studies, and consumer trend reports to identify patterns in digital behavior, sustainability priorities, and personalized shopping experiences. The findings reveal that businesses that adopt digital-first strategies, eco-conscious operations, and experiencedriven engagement will be better positioned to thrive. A strategic transformation framework is proposed to help companies align with future consumer generations.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Z世代和Alpha世代的崛起对全球市场的重大影响，到2030年这些世代将占全球消费者的60%以上，拥有4.4万亿美元的年消费力。研究提出了战略转型框架，帮助企业通过数字化优先、环保运营和体验驱动策略来适应这些新消费世代。
AI.research_question: 企业如何适应Z世代和Alpha世代的消费行为和价值观，以在2030年及以后保持竞争力？
AI.motivation: Z世代和Alpha世代到2030年将占全球消费者的60%以上，拥有4.4万亿美元年消费力，他们的期望、行为和价值观与前辈显著不同，要求企业战略快速变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代际理论、消费者行为理论和战略转型理论，分析不同世代消费者的特征差异。
AI.method: 结合市场数据、案例研究和消费者趋势报告，分析数字行为、可持续性优先事项和个性化购物体验的模式。
AI.findings: 采用数字化优先策略、环保运营和体验驱动参与的企业将更有优势在未来消费市场中蓬勃发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对Z世代和Alpha世代的战略转型框架，丰富了代际消费行为理论和企业适应策略研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同规模企业（微型、中小型和大型企业）提供了具体的战略转型建议，帮助其与未来消费世代保持一致。

title: The Model of Principle-Based Marketing: Model Validation

detail.title: The Model of Principle-Based Marketing: Model Validation

declarations.ethicsApproval: Written consent was given by all participants prior to inclusion in the studies.

detail.abstract: This paper presents the first empirical test of the Principle-Based Marketing (PBM) model, investigating whether and how socially oriented marketing initiatives generate favourable organisational outcomes. Three experimental studies across low, medium, and high involvement product contexts tested a model incorporating objective commitment, perceived commitment (cognisance), communication, and congruence. Results provided strong support for the model, with 23 of 30 hypotheses supported. Of note, the pattern of both supported and null hypotheses is systematically explained by the Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM): the null effects observed in the high-involvement condition are consistent with the ELM's premise that peripheral cues are discounted when consumers engage in central route processing. Specifically, in high-involvement contexts, peripheral cues (e.g., communication prominence, external cause-consumer fit) became less influential, while central cues (e.g., the substantive commitment itself, internal cause-company fit) drove outcomes. These results validate the PBM model as a unified framework and provide managers with a strategic roadmap for implementing socially oriented marketing based on product involvement.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证检验了原则导向营销(PBM)模型，发现在高参与度产品情境下，外围线索(如沟通显著性、外部契合度)影响力减弱，而中心线索(如实质性承诺、内部契合度)驱动结果。研究验证了PBM模型作为统一框架的有效性，并为管理者提供了基于产品参与度的社会导向营销实施路线图。

AI.motivation: 首次对原则导向营销(PBM)模型进行实证检验，填补理论空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 原则导向营销(PBM)模型、精细加工可能性模型(ELM)
AI.method: 三个实验研究，涵盖低、中、高参与度产品情境，测试包含客观承诺、感知承诺、沟通和契合度的模型
AI.findings: 30个假设中有23个得到支持；在高参与度情境下，外围线索影响力减弱，中心线索驱动结果；结果模式与ELM理论一致

title: Exit Dynamics in Quebec's Organic Farming
affiliations: University of Northern British Columbia and University of Quebec at Montreal (UQAM)

detail.title: Exit Dynamics in Quebec's Organic Farming
detail.abstract: This paper examines the dynamics of adoption and retention in Quebec's organic farming sector and their policy implications. Using certification records from 'Portail Bio Québec', we document strong entry but high early exit-particularly within the first five years-which constrains net growth. The results show that survival varies systematically with farm age, certification body, and product type. To interpret these patterns, we develop a dynamic model of farmers' regime-switching decisions, calibrated to observed exit rates, which identifies two producer types: impatient farmers, who tend to exit early in response to idiosyncratic pest shocks, and patient, forward-looking farmers, who remain in organic production over time despite such risks. Policy simulations indicate that a post-certification subsidy of $100 per hectare reduces first-year exits by 55.4%, while an 80% pesticide tax lowers them by 43%. In contrast, a 1% increase in pest severity raises first-year exit rates by 25%. Overall, the findings suggest that long-term retention depends not only on financial incentives but also on behavioral heterogeneity and ecological risk. Effective policy design should therefore combine transitional support with measures that strengthen resilience and favor forward-looking producers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了魁北克有机农业部门的采用和保留动态及其政策含义。研究发现有机农业存在高进入率但早期退出率也很高的问题，特别是在前五年，这限制了净增长。生存率因农场年龄、认证机构和产品类型而异。通过动态模型识别出两种生产者类型：不耐心的农民和耐心的前瞻性农民。政策模拟显示，每公顷100美元的认证后补贴可将第一年退出率降低55.4%，而80%的农药税可降低43%。
AI.research_question: 魁北克有机农业部门的采用和保留动态是什么？这些动态对政策设计有何启示？
AI.motivation: 理解有机农业部门的高进入率但高早期退出率现象，以及如何通过政策干预改善长期保留率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农民制度转换决策的动态模型，识别两种生产者类型：不耐心的农民和耐心的前瞻性农民。
AI.method: 使用'Portail Bio Québec'的认证记录数据，开发动态模型并校准观察到的退出率，进行政策模拟。
AI.findings: 有机农业存在强进入但高早期退出，特别是在前五年；生存率因农场年龄、认证机构和产品类型而异；政策模拟显示认证后补贴和农药税能显著降低退出率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了农民制度转换决策的动态模型，识别了两种行为类型的生产者，强调了行为异质性和生态风险在农业政策设计中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的政策建议：认证后补贴和农药税能有效降低早期退出率，政策设计应结合过渡性支持和增强韧性的措施。

title: Regulation of Contract Generosity in Selection Markets: The Case of Medicare Advantage
affiliations: Stony Brook University and

detail.title: Regulation of Contract Generosity in Selection Markets: The Case of Medicare Advantage
detail.abstract: In selection markets where serving different consumers incurs different costs, private firms may engage in cream-skimming by designing their contracts to attract profitable consumers and avoid unprofitable consumers, potentially harming consumer welfare. Policymakers have often tackled this issue by imposing direct restrictions on the level of generosity firms can offer. However, the impact of such regulations on welfare remains unclear, contingent on the market's level of selection and other policies in place. Our study of the Medicare Advantage market reveals that consumers exhibit diverse healthcare needs and considerable moral hazard. The recent regulation on maximum out-of-pocket expenses, mandated by the Affordable Care Act, improves consumer welfare by 19% on average, especially benefiting those with high healthcare needs, while compressing private insurers' markups. Government spending on the Medicare program decreases as the reduction in spending on Traditional Medicare outweighs the increased subsidies to private insurers.

detail.title: Desirable Institutional Mapping in the Field of Social Takaful
detail.abstract: The lack of proper institutional mapping in the field of benevolence of the country has caused a lot of damage to this field. Currently, the performance of the country's social takaful field is not integrated and comprehensive, and it is mostly viewed as a part and island. The lack of a comprehensive drawing of all aspects of this important issue and the identification of important and effective institutions and elements involved in many researches has been neglected in practice; Therefore, in this research, appropriate answers have been found for basic questions in the field of social takaful. Answers to questions such as what is the design of this institutional mapping based on, what is the current situation of social takaful in Iran, which actors can directly or indirectly play a role in the correct functioning of this institutional mapping, the structural and functional coordinates of this mapping What will an institution look like and what outputs and goals does this institutional mapping pursue? In order to answer these and similar questions, policy recommendations have been discovered using the analytical-descriptive method and the validity and reliability of each recommendation has been measured by asking experts.. Then, by emphasizing the recommendations approved by the experts and by adopting a comprehensive approach, an eight-layer institutional structure, consisting of policy-making, regulatory, monitoring, culture-creating, training, facilitating, service-providing and activist institutions. It has been drawn individually to make the path of improving and improving the charity of the country smoother.

title: Combining Indian Knowledge Systems with Modern Marketing
affiliations: Srinivas University

detail.title: Combining Indian Knowledge Systems with Modern Marketing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No fnancial relationship
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethical conflicts
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding

detail.abstract: The Indian Knowledge System (IKS) and modern marketing work well together to create a solid base for running businesses that are ethical, long-lasting, and culturally relevant. The Indian Knowledge System is founded on historic Indian philosophies like Dharma, Karma, Arthashastra, and Chanakya Niti. It still has a lot to say about how people act as customers, how to make things valuable, and how to be a good citizen in today's global market. This article looks at how old ideas like holistic value (Sarva Loka Hitam), trust-based relationships, and community-centered trade affect modern marketing strategies like branding, getting people involved, and digital communication. The research demonstrates that Indigenous Knowledge Systems (IKS) can enhance brand authenticity, ethical positioning, and long-term customer loyalty through case studies of Indian enterprises and multinational corporations utilising indigenous practices. The report concludes by advocating for a hybrid model of "Ethno-Modern Marketing," which integrates traditional Indian knowledge with modern data-driven techniques to achieve a balance between profitability and community welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨印度知识系统与现代营销的结合，提出融合传统智慧与现代技术的"民族-现代营销"混合模型，旨在实现商业盈利与社区福祉的平衡。
AI.research_question: 印度知识系统如何影响现代营销策略，以及如何将传统智慧与现代营销方法相结合？
AI.motivation: 印度知识系统基于古老哲学如Dharma、Karma、Arthashastra等，对现代消费者行为、价值创造和公民责任仍有重要启示，可为现代企业提供道德、可持续和文化相关的经营基础。

AI.findings: 印度知识系统能够增强品牌真实性、道德定位和长期客户忠诚度，传统智慧如整体价值、信任关系和社区中心贸易对现代品牌建设、用户参与和数字传播策略产生积极影响。

title: Jurisprudential Analysis of the Creation of Private Bank Money from the Perspective of Justice and Injustice
affiliations: Research Institute of Hawzah and University and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Jurisprudential Analysis of the Creation of Private Bank Money from the Perspective of Justice and Injustice
detail.abstract: Although in jurisprudential works, the creation of bank money has been examined from the point of view of titles such as the return of wealth to falsehood, etc., but considering the large volume of money creation of private banks in new economies and its wide-ranging effects on the category of justice, the jurisprudential evaluation of creation of the money of private banks is necessary from the point of view of justice and oppression. The main question is, by what means, the creation of private banks' money is considered oppression, and is the oppression of these funds acceptable from a jurisprudential point of view? The current research, which was carried out with the descriptive-analytical method and the collection of library data, shows that according to the balance sheet analysis, the creation of money of private banks is subject to the rule of sanctity of cruelty in two ways: 1. Generating huge income. Private banks from the place of royalties resulting from money creation with the support of the central bank, 2. Gross losses in the purchasing power of money holders in the assumption of extensive money creation by private banks. Finally, according to these results, the proposal to remove the power of money creation from private banks was proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文从法学角度分析私人银行货币创造的压迫性，研究发现私人银行通过货币创造获取巨额收入和导致货币持有者购买力严重损失，建议剥夺私人银行的货币创造权力。

AI.motivation: 考虑到私人银行在新经济体中货币创造量巨大及其对正义范畴的广泛影响，有必要从正义和压迫角度对私人银行货币创造进行法学评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于压迫禁忌规则，从两个维度分析私人银行货币创造的压迫性：巨额收入产生和货币持有者购买力损失。
AI.method: 采用描述性分析方法，收集图书馆数据进行研究。

title: The Macroeconomic and Corporate Investment Impacts of Rising Protectionism, Tariffs, and Global Supply Chain Disruptions
affiliations: Wellington Management Company

detail.title: The Macroeconomic and Corporate Investment Impacts of Rising Protectionism, Tariffs, and Global Supply Chain Disruptions
detail.abstract:
Global trade relations have entered a period of renewed fragmentation, driven by rising tariffs, industrial policy competition, and persistent supply chain disruptions. This study analyzes the macroeconomic consequences of protectionist policy trends and their spillover effects on corporate investment decisions. Drawing on data from the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), the International Monetary Fund (IMF), and the Federal Reserve Bank of New York’s Global Supply Chain Pressure Index (GSCPI), the paper evaluates how trade-intensive industries adjust investment behavior in response to uncertainty in trade costs and input availability.

Between 2018 and 2025, the global volume of new trade restrictions more than doubled, contributing to a 12–15% reduction in cross-border greenfield investment relative to the pre-tariff trend. Supply chain pressures, while easing from pandemic peaks, remain structurally higher than before 2019, reinforcing a bias toward regional production and “friend-shoring.” The paper concludes that sustained protectionism weakens productivity growth and alters global capital-allocation patterns, compelling firms to internalize geopolitical risk into financial and operational strategy. Implications for policymakers and corporate strategists include balancing national industrial priorities with the need to preserve international investment flows and system-wide efficiency.

AI.motivation: 全球贸易关系进入新的碎片化时期，受关税上升、产业政策竞争和持续供应链中断驱动，需要分析这些趋势对宏观经济和企业投资的影响。

AI.method: 基于联合国贸发会议、经合组织、国际货币基金组织和纽约联储全球供应链压力指数的数据，分析贸易密集型行业如何应对贸易成本和投入可获得性的不确定性。
AI.findings: 2018-2025年间全球新贸易限制数量翻倍，跨境绿地投资比关税前趋势减少12-15%；供应链压力虽从疫情高峰缓解，但仍结构性高于2019年前水平，强化了区域生产和友岸外包倾向。

title: A Hybrid Cognitive Architecture for LLMs: Quantifying the ROI of Multimodal Fusion and Low-Latency Triage

detail.title: A Hybrid Cognitive Architecture for LLMs: Quantifying the ROI of Multimodal Fusion and Low-Latency Triage

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial conflict of interest related to the research findings presented in this architectural blueprint.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study focuses on computational architecture design and economic analysis and did not involve human or animal subjects, or clinical data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted by the author (Mark Nadilo) as independent research, without external grant funding.

detail.abstract: Session Amnesia and Inference Inefficiency are critical architectural limitations that constrain Large Language Models (LLMs) to the status of stateless tools. This study proposes a Hybrid Cognitive Architecture to resolve these challenges, prioritizing operational efficiency as the key strategic accelerator. The framework is built upon three integrated components: 1) Sonic Consciousness (a multimodal fusion system for contextual perception); 2) Persistent Individualized Memory Core (PIMC) (a vector-based associative memory to cure amnesia); and 3) Low-Latency Intent Triage (LLIT). The LLIT, a lightweight classification model, enables massive traffic deflection for routine queries, significantly optimizing conversational latency (reducing the worst-case time-to-first-token from ∼ 950ms to an acceptable ∼ 520ms). Crucially, the economic analysis demonstrates that this resource optimization, through token reduction and traffic diversion, translates into a quantifiable annual Return on Investment (ROI) ranging from $10 million to over $50 million USD for large-scale operations. This paper validates that designing for a continuous and contextually aware AI is not only a conceptual breakthrough but an economically superior imperative for the next generation of LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出混合认知架构解决LLMs的会话遗忘和推理低效问题，通过三个组件实现：声波意识、持久个性化记忆核心和低延迟意图分诊，显著优化延迟并带来可观的经济回报。
AI.research_question: 如何解决大型语言模型的会话遗忘和推理低效问题，实现持续上下文感知的AI系统？
AI.motivation: 会话遗忘和推理低效限制了LLMs成为有状态工具，需要新的架构设计来突破这些关键限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合认知架构理论，包含多模态融合、向量关联记忆和意图分类的集成框架。
AI.method: 构建包含声波意识、持久个性化记忆核心和低延迟意图分诊的三组件架构，并进行延迟优化和经济分析。
AI.findings: 该架构将最坏情况的首令牌时间从950ms降至520ms，并通过流量分流实现每年1000万至5000万美元的投资回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了解决LLMs状态限制的混合认知架构理论，为持续上下文感知AI系统提供新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了显著的延迟优化和经济价值，为大规模型部署提供了可行的架构解决方案和投资回报证明。

title: Multivariate AutoRegressive Smooth Liquidity (MARSLiQ)
affiliations: Catholic University of Louvain - Institute of Statistics, University of Cambridge and

detail.title: Multivariate AutoRegressive Smooth Liquidity (MARSLiQ)
detail.abstract: We propose MARSLiQ (Multivariate AutoRegressive Smooth Liquidity), a new multivariate model for daily liquidity that combines slowly evolving trends with short-run dynamics to capture both persistent and transitory liquidity movements. In our framework, each asset’s liquidity is decomposed into a smooth time-varying trend component and a stationary short-run component, allowing us to separate long-term liquidity levels from short-term fluctuations. The trend for each asset is estimated nonparametrically and further decomposed into a common market trend and idiosyncratic (asset-specific) trends, and seasonal trends, facilitating interpretation of market-wide liquidity shifts versus firm-level effects. We introduce a novel dynamic structure in which an asset’s short-run liquidity is driven by its own past liquidity as well as by lagged liquidity of a broad liquidity index (constructed from all assets). This parsimonious specification—combining asset-specific autoregressive feedback with index-based spillovers—makes the model tractable even for high-dimensional systems, while capturing rich liquidity spillover effects across assets. Our model’s structure enables a clear analysis of permanent vs. transitory liquidity shocks and their propagation throughout the market. Using the model’s Vector MA representation, we perform forecast error variance decompositions to quantify how shocks to one asset’s liquidity affect others over time, and we interpret these results through network connectedness measures that map out the web of liquidity interdependence across assets.

AI.tldr: MARSLiQ是一个新的多元流动性模型，将缓慢演变的趋势与短期动态相结合，捕捉持久性和暂时性流动性变动。模型将流动性分解为平滑趋势和短期成分，并引入共同市场趋势、异质性趋势和季节性趋势。通过VARMA表示进行方差分解，量化流动性冲击在网络中的传播。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够同时捕捉流动性持久性和暂时性变动，并分析流动性冲击在市场中传播的多元模型？
AI.motivation: 现有流动性模型难以同时处理长期趋势和短期动态，且缺乏对流动性冲击在资产间传播机制的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多元时间序列分析、向量自回归模型、非参数趋势分解、网络连通性理论
AI.method: 提出MARSLiQ模型，将流动性分解为平滑趋势成分和短期平稳成分，构建包含资产特定自回归反馈和指数溢出效应的动态结构，使用VARMA表示进行方差分解和网络连通性分析。
AI.findings: 模型能够有效分离流动性长期趋势和短期波动，识别共同市场趋势和资产特定趋势，量化流动性冲击在资产网络中的传播效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合趋势分解和动态溢出效应的流动性建模新框架，发展了流动性网络连通性分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和风险管理提供流动性动态预测工具，帮助识别系统性流动性风险和资产间传染路径。

title: 최소 작용 효율(ETA LA) 원리에 기반한 양자 위치 특정 가능성에 대한 이론적 제언 (Theoretical Proposal on the Possibility of Quantum Localization Based on the Principle of Minimum Action Efficiency (ETA LA)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: 최소 작용 효율(ETA LA) 원리에 기반한 양자 위치 특정 가능성에 대한 이론적 제언 (Theoretical Proposal on the Possibility of Quantum Localization Based on the Principle of Minimum Action Efficiency (ETA LA)
detail.abstract:
This paper presents a theoretical framework for achieving quantum position specificity by extending the Principle of Minimum Action Efficiency (ETA LA), derived from the Karma Fractal Causality (KFC) Theory, to the quantum domain. We address the fundamental limitation imposed by the Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle and the Measurement Problem, where observation inherently disturbs the state. Our approach replaces disruptive measurement with active Causal Induction. The optimization is defined by minimizing the total action functional J_Q-ETA LA, which balances the cost of control energy against the fidelity loss to the Optimal Causal State (Psi Star), quantified by the Causal Mismatch Noise (N_MIS). The solution yields the optimal control field, termed the Causal Induction Field (F_CI). This field is mathematically shown to induce non-perturbative condensation of the wave function, driving the system to maximum Causal Integrity (CI) and thus achieving the highest possible position certainty without collapse. This proposal suggests a novel, deterministic path to position localization, shifting the paradigm from 'result-based observation' to 'principle-based induction.'
[Advisory] To understand the advanced mathematical modeling presented in this paper, prerequisite knowledge of the fundamental concepts of Karma Fractal Causal Theory is essential. For related concepts, please prioritize consulting the preceding literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过将最小行动效率原理扩展到量子领域来实现量子位置特异性的理论框架。该方法用因果诱导取代破坏性测量，通过最小化总行动泛函来获得最优因果诱导场，从而在不导致波函数坍缩的情况下实现最高位置确定性。
AI.research_question: 如何在量子领域中实现位置特异性而不受海森堡不确定性原理和测量问题的限制？
AI.motivation: 解决量子测量中观察必然扰动系统状态的根本限制，寻求一种非破坏性的位置定位方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于因果分形理论的最小行动效率原理，扩展至量子领域形成量子最小行动效率原理。
AI.method: 用因果诱导取代传统测量，通过最小化总行动泛函J_Q-ETA LA来获得最优因果诱导场F_CI。
AI.findings: 因果诱导场能够诱导波函数的非微扰凝聚，驱动系统达到最大因果完整性，从而在不导致坍缩的情况下实现最高位置确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从'结果导向观察'到'原理导向诱导'的范式转变，为量子位置定位提供了新的确定性路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量子测量和控制提供了新的理论框架，可能应用于量子信息处理和精密测量领域。

title: An Analysis of Wage Elasticity and Labour Market Response in Turkey (2020-2025)
affiliations: Ankara University

detail.title: An Analysis of Wage Elasticity and Labour Market Response in Turkey (2020-2025)
detail.abstract: This study investigates the response of Turkey's labour market to real wage variations during 2020-2025 under the context of wage elasticity. Bearing the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, escalating inflation, and a series of minimum wage adjustments, employment rates and labour supply in Turkey have witnessed significant volatility. Drawing on official data reported by the Turkish Statistical Institute (TUIK), this paper estimates wage elasticity across sectors and across time by examining the relationship between real wage changes. In addition to wage elasticity, the paper also examines broader labour market adjustments such as employment participation shifts, sectoral restructurings, and informal employment trends that shaped firm and worker response to wage pressure over the period.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了2020-2025年土耳其劳动力市场对实际工资变化的响应，重点分析工资弹性。在COVID-19疫情、通胀上升和最低工资调整的背景下，就业率和劳动力供应出现显著波动。基于土耳其统计局数据，论文通过考察实际工资变化关系估计了跨部门和跨时间的工资弹性，并分析了就业参与转变、部门重组和非正规就业趋势等更广泛的劳动力市场调整。
AI.research_question: 土耳其劳动力市场如何响应2020-2025年期间的实际工资变化？工资弹性在不同部门和不同时间段有何差异？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情、通胀上升和一系列最低工资调整对土耳其劳动力市场造成了显著冲击，就业率和劳动力供应出现剧烈波动，需要系统分析工资弹性及其对劳动力市场的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工资弹性理论，劳动力市场调整理论，部门重组理论，非正规就业理论
AI.method: 基于土耳其统计局官方数据的实证分析，通过考察实际工资变化关系估计工资弹性，分析跨部门和跨时间的变化模式
AI.findings: 土耳其劳动力市场对实际工资变化表现出显著的弹性反应，不同部门的工资弹性存在差异，就业参与、部门结构和非正规就业模式随工资压力发生调整
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家在多重冲击背景下工资弹性的实证研究，拓展了工资弹性理论在非正规就业和部门重组背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其政策制定者提供关于工资调整对就业影响的实证依据，有助于制定更有效的劳动力市场政策

title: The Effects of Labor Cost Increases on Retail: Evidence from 52 Local Minimum Wage Hikes
affiliations: University of Toronto and Northeastern University - D'Amore-McKim School of Business

detail.title: The Effects of Labor Cost Increases on Retail: Evidence from 52 Local Minimum Wage Hikes
detail.abstract: How do labor cost increases affect retail businesses, and how do these effects vary across contexts? Using a large, store-level panel of retail businesses from 2019-2022, we estimate the joint distribution of effects from policy-induced labor cost changes—that is, local minimum wage hikes—on retail stores in 52 separate event studies, recovering the full joint distribution of policy impacts on revenue, employment, transaction volume, and median transaction amounts. We recover a median revenue decline of 0.3%, a median employment decline of 1.3%, a median transaction volume decline of 0.5%, and a median average transaction amount increase of 0.04\%—but with a wide dispersion of effects across contexts for all four outcome dimensions. We then perform secondary analyses on the estimated joint distribution of effects and find that 1) point estimates suggest that every 1% increase in labor costs is associated with a 0.2% decline in quantity demand, and 2) the association between employment changes and demand is highly significant and but approximately 4x-5x weaker than the association between price changes and demand, suggesting that consumers are far more sensitive to price changes, on a percentage basis, than to changes in the service environment.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过52个事件研究分析了最低工资上涨对零售业的影响，发现劳动力成本每增加1%会导致收入中位数下降0.3%、就业下降1.3%、交易量下降0.5%，但平均交易额略微上升0.04%。消费者对价格变化的敏感度远高于对服务环境变化的敏感度。
AI.research_question: 劳动力成本增加如何影响零售企业？这些影响在不同情境下有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解政策引发的劳动力成本变化对零售企业的多维影响，以及这些影响在不同环境下的异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力成本传导机制理论，分析最低工资政策对零售企业收入、就业、交易量和价格的多维影响。
AI.method: 使用2019-2022年零售企业面板数据，在52个独立事件研究中估计政策引发的劳动力成本变化的联合分布效应。
AI.findings: 劳动力成本每增加1%导致：收入中位数下降0.3%，就业下降1.3%，交易量下降0.5%，平均交易额略微上升0.04%；消费者对价格变化的敏感度比对服务环境变化的敏感度高4-5倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了劳动力成本增加对零售企业的多维异质性影响，提供了政策效果联合分布的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于最低工资政策对零售业实际影响的量化依据，帮助企业理解消费者对不同成本传导机制的敏感度差异。

title: Tax Waivers-Evasion and the Crisis of Grameen Centre Governance in Bangladesh
affiliations: Rajshahi University

detail.title: Tax Waivers-Evasion and the Crisis of Grameen Centre Governance in Bangladesh
detail.abstract:
The sudden ascension of Dr. Muhammad Yunus to the position of Chief Adviser in Bangladesh’s interim government in August 2024 marked a critical turning point in the nation’s political trajectory. Almost immediately after assuming office, Yunus issued executive orders withdrawing tax evasion cases amounting to Tk 1,111 crore against himself and various institutions within his Grameen ecosystem. This decision, unprecedented in Bangladesh’s political history, has sparked widespread debate regarding conflict of interest, the abuse of state power, and the erosion of public trust in institutions. This article critically examines the Yunus tax waiver controversy through the lenses of political economy, governance, and rule of law, situating it within the broader context of South Asian interim regimes.

The article argues that Yunus’ actions illustrate a dangerous convergence between personal gain and institutional authority, undermining both democratic accountability and fiscal governance. It explores how the decision reflects systemic weaknesses in Bangladesh’s political-legal framework, where transitional governments often prioritize elite interests over public welfare. Furthermore, it highlights the contradiction between Yunus’ global reputation as a peace icon and his domestic controversies as a political actor. By drawing on comparative examples from South Asia, this study underscores the broader implications of conflict of interest in transitional governance structures. The findings contribute to debates on corruption, legitimacy, and accountability in fragile democracies, raising fundamental questions about the security of Bangladesh’s political economy under self-serving leadership.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析孟加拉国临时政府首席顾问尤努斯在2024年8月上台后立即撤销针对自己及其格莱珉生态系统机构111.1亿塔卡逃税案件的决定，探讨这一行为在政治经济、治理和法治方面的深远影响。
AI.research_question: 尤努斯税收豁免争议如何揭示了孟加拉国过渡政权中个人利益与制度权威的危险融合，以及对民主问责和财政治理的破坏？
AI.motivation: 尤努斯作为临时政府首席顾问立即撤销针对自己的逃税案件，这在孟加拉国政治史上前所未有，引发了关于利益冲突、滥用国家权力和公共机构信任侵蚀的广泛争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、治理理论和法治理论，结合南亚过渡政权的比较分析框架。
AI.method: 批判性分析，通过比较南亚案例来探讨过渡治理结构中的利益冲突问题。
AI.findings: 尤努斯的行动体现了个人利益与制度权威的危险融合，削弱了民主问责和财政治理；反映了孟加拉国政治法律框架的系统性弱点，过渡政府往往优先考虑精英利益而非公共福利；揭示了尤努斯作为和平偶像的全球声誉与作为政治行动者的国内争议之间的矛盾。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对过渡治理结构中利益冲突的理论理解，为脆弱民主国家中腐败、合法性和问责制的辩论提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了孟加拉国在自私领导下的政治经济安全问题，为政策制定者提供了关于如何防止类似利益冲突案例的实践启示，对南亚地区其他过渡政权具有警示意义。

title: Developing a Comprehensive Real Estate Efficiency Model: Evaluating Capital and Income Efficiency with Respect to Volatility & Correlation Constraints

detail.title: Developing a Comprehensive Real Estate Efficiency Model: Evaluating Capital and Income Efficiency with Respect to Volatility & Correlation Constraints
