declarations.ethicsApproval: This doesn‘ t apply to my work.

keywords: Nonagricultural and Nonresidential Real Estate Markets
Capital Budgeting; Fixed Investment and Inventory Studies
Asset Pricing; Trading Volume; Bond Interest Rates
Financing Policy; Financial Risk and Risk Management; Capital and Ownership Structure

detail.abstract: This paper develops a multidimensional efficiency framework for the real estate sector, integrating yield efficiency, capital-value efficiency, and capital-structure efficiency into a unified quantitative model. The proposed CVE (Correlation–Volatility–Efficiency) formula captures the interaction between profitability, volatility, and leverage under changing market conditions. Drawing on classical financial metrics such as NPV, DCF, and NOI, the model introduces residualization and correlation adjustment to isolate non-redundant value components. Using data from the German real estate market (2022–2025), the model empirically demonstrates how capital efficiency deteriorates during interest rate hikes and constrained credit conditions, and how adequate efficiency can be restored through optimized capital structures. The framework provides a robust analytical tool for investors, policymakers, and developers to evaluate risk-adjusted project performance in volatile markets. By linking capital allocation, value retention, and risk exposure, this study contributes to the literature on real estate finance, investment valuation, and systemic market efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个房地产多维效率框架，将收益率效率、资本价值效率和资本结构效率整合到统一的定量模型中。提出的CVE公式捕捉了在变化市场条件下盈利能力、波动性和杠杆之间的相互作用。该模型通过实证分析德国房地产市场数据，展示了利率上升和信贷紧缩期间资本效率如何恶化，以及如何通过优化资本结构恢复效率。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个多维效率框架来评估房地产市场的风险调整后项目表现？
AI.motivation: 传统房地产估值方法在波动市场条件下无法充分捕捉盈利能力、波动性和杠杆之间的相互作用，需要开发更全面的效率评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典金融指标（NPV、DCF、NOI），引入残差化和相关性调整来分离非冗余价值成分，构建CVE（相关性-波动性-效率）公式。
AI.method: 使用德国房地产市场（2022-2025年）数据进行实证分析，检验模型在利率上升和信贷紧缩条件下的表现。
AI.findings: 在利率上升和信贷紧缩期间，资本效率会恶化，但通过优化资本结构可以恢复足够的效率水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 为房地产金融、投资估值和系统性市场效率文献做出贡献，通过连接资本配置、价值保持和风险敞口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者和开发商提供了评估波动市场中风险调整后项目表现的稳健分析工具。

title: КОНКУРЕНЦИЈА И ДОМИНИРАЊЕ НА ТРЖИШТУ ОСИГУРАЊА У СРБИЈИ: МАТРИЦА SV ЗА ПЕРИОД 2018-2024. ГОДИНЕ (COMPETITION AND DOMINATION IN THE INSURANCE MARKET IN SERBIA: SV MATRIX FOR THE PERIOD 2018-2024)
affiliations: Geographical Institute 'Jovan Cvijić' SASA

detail.title: КОНКУРЕНЦИЈА И ДОМИНИРАЊЕ НА ТРЖИШТУ ОСИГУРАЊА У СРБИЈИ: МАТРИЦА SV ЗА ПЕРИОД 2018-2024. ГОДИНЕ (COMPETITION AND DOMINATION IN THE INSURANCE MARKET IN SERBIA: SV MATRIX FOR THE PERIOD 2018-2024)
detail.abstract:
Serbian Abstract: Чланак истражује конкуренцију и доминирање на тржишту осигурања у Србији (без Косова и Метохије). Примењен је метод матрице SV (Strenght - Variety), а потребни показатељи прерачунати су на основу укупне наплаћене премије осигурања осигуравајућих компанија, према подацима Народне банке Србије за период 2018–2024. Резултати су показали релативно висок укупни степен концентрације (CRSV), као и релативно малу диференцијацију унутар доминантне групе (HTSV). Поред тога, запажа се јасна тенденција смањења оба кључна индикатора који дефинишу матрицу SV: CRSV и HTSV, што показује приближавање квадранту RO матрице SV, односно јачање улоге конкуренције и унутар доминантне групе као и у односу на остале учеснике на тржишту.

English Abstract: The article investigates competition and dominance in the insurance market in Serbia (excluding Kosovo and Metohija). The SV (Strength-Variety) matrix method was applied, and the required indicators were calculated based on the total insurance premiums collected by insurance companies, according to data from the National Bank of Serbia for the period 2018-2024. The results showed a relatively high overall degree of concentration (CRSV), as well as relatively low differentiation within the dominant group (HTSV). In addition, a clear tendency to decrease in both key indicators that define the SV matrix: CRSV and HTSV is observed, which shows an approach to the RO quadrant of the SV market, i.e. a strengthening of the role of competition both within the dominant group and in relation to other market participants.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用SV矩阵方法分析2018-2024年塞尔维亚保险市场竞争格局。结果显示市场集中度较高但呈下降趋势，主导集团内差异化较小，表明市场竞争正在增强。
AI.research_question: 塞尔维亚保险市场的竞争格局和主导地位如何演变？
AI.motivation: 了解塞尔维亚保险市场的竞争动态和集中度变化，为市场参与者提供决策参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: SV（强度-多样性）矩阵理论，包括CRSV（集中度指标）和HTSV（主导集团内差异化指标）。
AI.method: 基于塞尔维亚国家银行2018-2024年保险保费数据，应用SV矩阵方法计算相关指标。
AI.findings: 市场总体集中度较高但呈下降趋势，主导集团内差异化较小，两个关键指标CRSV和HTSV均显示下降趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了SV矩阵方法在保险市场分析中的适用性，提供了塞尔维亚保险市场竞争动态的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险监管机构、市场参与者和投资者提供了塞尔维亚保险市场竞争格局的量化分析，有助于市场决策和监管政策制定。

title: What Is Humanity?
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: What Is Humanity?
detail.abstract: The human history we read today may be an excerpt that omits the main stage now lying under the sea. During the Last Glacial Period (roughly 115,000-11,700 years ago), sea level fell by up to about 120 meters, exposing vast coastal plains such as Doggerland in the North Sea and Sundaland in Southeast Asia.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了末次冰期海平面下降对人类历史研究的影响，指出当前人类历史记载可能忽略了当时暴露的沿海平原地区，这些地区现在已被海水淹没。
AI.research_question: 末次冰期海平面下降如何影响我们对人类历史的理解？
AI.motivation: 当前人类历史研究主要基于陆地考古发现，可能忽略了冰期时暴露的沿海平原地区，这些地区可能曾是早期人类活动的重要场所。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于古气候学、海洋地质学和考古学的跨学科理论框架，研究海平面变化与人类历史演化的关系。
AI.method: 综合古气候重建、海洋地质勘探和考古证据分析的方法。
AI.findings: 末次冰期海平面下降约120米，暴露了北海的Doggerland和东南亚的Sundaland等广阔沿海平原，这些地区可能曾是早期人类活动的重要舞台。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人类历史研究需要重新考虑海平面变化对历史记录完整性的影响，挑战了传统陆地中心的历史观。
AI.practical_contributions: 为水下考古和跨学科历史研究提供了新的方向和理论基础，有助于更全面地理解人类历史发展。

title: Competition isn't Enough: Medicare Still Overpays for Abiraterone
affiliations: and Pennsylvania State University - Penn State College of Medicine

detail.title: Competition isn't Enough: Medicare Still Overpays for Abiraterone
detail.abstract: Following the 2018 patent expiration of abiraterone, a hormonal therapy for prostate cancer, the drug experienced a substantial influx of generic manufacturers and a marked decline in list prices. Using Medicare Part D pricing data from 2019 to 2023, we analyzed trends in both pricing and market share post-generic entry. Among 19 manufacturers that entered the market, generic versions quickly dominated market share. However, despite the availability of significantly lower-cost options, Medicare Part D continued to reimburse for versions priced 10 to 40 times higher than the cheapest available alternatives. This case study illustrates how, even after generic entry, medication pricing can remain uncompetitive due to formulary and reimbursement dynamics. Policy tools such as reference pricing may offer a pathway to mitigate excessive spending and promote value-based purchasing in Medicare Part D.

AI.tldr: 阿比特龙专利过期后，虽然仿制药迅速占据市场主导地位且价格大幅下降，但Medicare Part D仍继续报销价格高出10-40倍的版本，显示即使仿制药进入市场后，药品定价仍可能因处方集和报销机制而缺乏竞争性。
AI.research_question: 仿制药进入市场后，Medicare Part D中的药品定价和市场份额如何变化？
AI.motivation: 研究阿比特龙专利过期后的市场动态，揭示即使仿制药可用，Medicare Part D仍可能继续报销高价药品的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 药品市场竞争理论、仿制药进入对价格影响的理论、医疗保险报销机制理论
AI.method: 使用2019-2023年Medicare Part D定价数据，分析定价趋势和市场份额变化
AI.findings: 19家仿制药企业进入市场，仿制药迅速主导市场份额，但Medicare Part D仍继续报销价格高出10-40倍的版本
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了即使仿制药可用，处方集和报销机制仍可能导致药品定价缺乏竞争性的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为Medicare Part D改革提供政策建议，如参考定价机制，以控制过度支出并促进基于价值的采购

title: Quantitative Tightening and UK yields
affiliations: University of Liverpool

detail.title: Quantitative Tightening and UK yields
detail.abstract: This note assesses the impact of Quantitative Tightening (QT) decisions on UK yields since 2022. We consider both online search activity of QT and total asset purchases by the Bank of England to find that QT has pushed up yields by an average (median) of 37 basis points (33 basis points). The impact of scaling back total asset purchases on UK yields depends on alternative scenarios regarding the very pace of reversing Quantitative Easing (QE).

AI.tldr: 本文评估了2022年以来量化紧缩(QT)决策对英国收益率的影响，发现QT平均(中位数)推高收益率37个基点(33个基点)，且缩减资产购买规模对收益率的影响取决于逆转量化宽松(QE)的速度。
AI.research_question: 量化紧缩决策对英国收益率的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 评估2022年以来英国央行量化紧缩政策对市场收益率的具体影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制、量化宽松与紧缩理论、收益率曲线理论
AI.method: 结合QT在线搜索活动和英国央行总资产购买数据分析，采用计量经济学方法评估QT对收益率的影响
AI.findings: QT平均推高英国收益率37个基点(中位数33个基点)，缩减资产购买规模对收益率的影响取决于逆转QE的速度
AI.theory_contributions: 为量化紧缩政策的传导机制提供实证证据，丰富了货币政策非传统工具的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行制定量化紧缩政策提供参考，帮助市场参与者更好地理解QT对收益率的影响机制

title: Cooperatives’ ‘One-Shareholder-One-Vote’ Principle and Financial Reporting Quality
affiliations: Free University Berlin, Department Accounting and Finance and Free University of Berlin (FUB)

detail.title: Cooperatives’ ‘One-Shareholder-One-Vote’ Principle and Financial Reporting Quality
detail.abstract: Unlike corporations, cooperatives are typically governed by the democratic principle of 'one shareholder, one vote', ensuring that every member has an equal say, regardless of the amount of capital they contribute. However, some cooperatives allow members to have multiple voting rights. Our study, based on a sample from Germany, reveals that cooperatives that allow multiple voting rights tend to exhibit significantly lower financial reporting quality, as indicated by higher discretionary accruals, compared to those that adhere to the 'one-shareholder-one-vote' principle. These results remain robust after applying propensity score matching, using different measures of financial reporting quality, and considering the endogenous choice to allow multiple voting rights. This study adds to the emerging literature on cooperatives' financial reporting practices and explores the relationship between owners' voting power and financial reporting quality.

title: Crops, Insects, and Diseases: Unintended Consequences of Straw-Burning Ban on Ecosystem and Human Health
affiliations: Peking University, Peking University - National School of Development, Peking University, Institute for Economic and Social Research, Jinan University and The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Crops, Insects, and Diseases: Unintended Consequences of Straw-Burning Ban on Ecosystem and Human Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We confirm that there are no conditions under which my research may be influenced by secondary interests, including financial gain.
declarations.funderStatement: This research is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant Nos. 72203078, 72403011, and 72573072) and the Fundamental Research Funds of the Central Universities (Grant No. 23JNQMX60).

detail.abstract: This study demonstrates that environmental regulation can unintentionally alter ecological systems, leading to adverse health outcomes. We find that China's staggered straw-burning ban increased hospitalizations for insect-borne diseases by 50% and medical expenditures by 173%,  partially offsetting the health gains from cleaner air. We confirm that the ban reduced cropland fires, increased insect populations, and spurred public defensive investments, suggesting that the policy improved insect habitats, thereby facilitating insect-borne disease transmission. These effects largely vanish where straw recycling is effective, highlighting the role of complementary policies in mitigating unintended consequences and enhancing environmental policy benefits.

AI.tldr: 中国秸秆禁烧政策意外增加了虫媒疾病传播，导致住院人数增加50%，医疗支出增加173%，部分抵消了空气改善带来的健康收益。
AI.research_question: 环境规制（秸秆禁烧政策）如何影响虫媒疾病的传播和公共卫生？
AI.motivation: 研究环境政策可能产生的意外后果，特别是对生态系统和公共卫生的间接影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境规制理论、生态系统服务理论、公共卫生经济学
AI.method: 利用中国秸秆禁烧政策的交错实施作为准自然实验，采用计量经济学方法分析政策效果。
AI.findings: 秸秆禁烧政策减少了农田火灾，但增加了昆虫种群，导致虫媒疾病住院率上升50%，医疗支出增加173%。在秸秆回收有效的地区，这些负面影响基本消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了环境规制可能通过改变生态系统而产生意外后果的理论机制，强调了政策设计的系统性考量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于环境政策配套措施重要性的实证依据，建议实施秸秆回收等补充政策来减轻负面效应。

title: Carbon Capture Technologies : Efficacy & Costs
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Carbon Capture Technologies : Efficacy & Costs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author does not have any relationships that are a conflict of interest with the article.

detail.abstract: Smokestack carbon capture technologies carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) and carbon capture utilization and storage (CCUS) are based on a brilliant concept-remove the CO2 from smokestacks before it enters the atmosphere. Direct Air Capture (DAC) is based on the sparkling observation that CO2 may be removed from the atmosphere. These are complementary. Research on these topics has calculated some alluring estimates of the amount of CO2 that can be captured. However, after decades of use, CCS and CCUS applications have mostly failed to achieve target volumes of capture. The same problem has beleaguered DAC since its debut in about 2019. This review focuses on CCS for power plants and DAC. Using Google Scholar, a review of scientific research published between January 2020 and October 2025 was conducted. CCS and DAC Lifecycle Analysis (LCA) research has a diversity of definitions of lifecycle, the expected heterogeneity of results, and limited comparability with other research. 1 Net capture in this review refers to the amount of CO2e emitted by CCS, CCUS, or DAC over its lifecycle, minus the amount of CO2 removed by the equipment during the operating phase. The best literature review evaluating this and quantifying numerous challenges of these technologies is referenced below. 2 In addition, one section examines the efficacy of biomass energy CCS (BECCS). More research on the efficacy and scalability of CCS, DAC, and long-term storage of CO2 under various policy regimes and regulatory frameworks is indicated. These are explored to maximize net benefits to society.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文分析了碳捕集与封存(CCS)、碳捕集利用与封存(CCUS)和直接空气捕集(DAC)技术的实际效果，发现这些技术在实际应用中未能达到预期的捕集量目标，并探讨了生命周期分析中的方法论问题。
AI.research_question: CCS、CCUS和DAC技术在实现碳捕集目标方面的实际效果如何？这些技术的生命周期分析存在哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 尽管碳捕集技术概念上很吸引人，但经过数十年应用，CCS和CCUS大多未能达到目标捕集量，DAC自2019年推出以来也面临同样问题，需要评估其实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生命周期分析(LCA)理论框架，评估碳捕集技术的净捕集量（全生命周期排放减去运行阶段捕集的CO2）。
AI.method: 使用Google Scholar对2020年1月至2025年10月期间发表的科学研究进行文献综述。
AI.findings: CCS和DAC的生命周期分析存在定义多样性、结果异质性和与其他研究可比性有限的问题；这些技术在实际应用中未能达到预期的捕集目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了碳捕集技术生命周期分析中的方法论挑战，提出了净捕集量的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于碳捕集技术实际效果的实证证据，建议需要更多研究来评估不同政策制度下这些技术的有效性和可扩展性。

title: "A YOLO-Based Approach": Indicates the Methodology (YOLOv8n, YOLOv8x, YOLOv11), Tying it to the Experiment's Core Technology

detail.title: "A YOLO-Based Approach": Indicates the Methodology (YOLOv8n, YOLOv8x, YOLOv11), Tying it to the Experiment's Core Technology
detail.abstract: In this study, I extensively evaluated the viability of the state-of-the-art YOLOv8 architecture, along with a simulated YOLOv11, for object detection tasks, specifically tailored for human limb localization with a focus on body part identification. All available versions of YOLOv8, including YOLOv8n and YOLOv8x, were initially fine-tuned on a domain-specific dataset comprising 100 images with diverse poses, angles, and lighting conditions, annotated for front/back views and limbs (left_hand, right_hand, left_foot, right_foot), crucial for comprehensive human motion analysis. The 'large' version (YOLOv8x) was selected for further hyperparameter tuning based on its performance metrics. This model underwent a detailed hyperparameter optimization using the One Factor At a Time (OFAT) methodology, concentrating on key parameters such as learning rate, batch size, epochs, and optimizer. Insights from the OFAT study informed a subsequent Random Search (RS), leading to the development of a simulated YOLOv11 model. The final model demonstrated significant improvements over the initial fine-tuned YOLOv8n, increasing overall precision from 0.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了YOLOv8架构及其模拟YOLOv11在人体肢体定位任务中的表现，通过超参数优化显著提升了检测精度。
AI.research_question: YOLOv8架构及其改进版本在人体肢体定位任务中的性能表现如何？
AI.motivation: 人体肢体定位对于运动分析和人机交互具有重要意义，需要高效的物体检测模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于YOLO（You Only Look Once）物体检测框架和深度学习理论。
AI.method: 使用OFAT方法进行超参数优化，随后进行随机搜索，开发模拟YOLOv11模型。
AI.findings: 优化后的模型相比初始YOLOv8n在精度上有显著提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于YOLOv8的改进方法，验证了超参数优化对物体检测性能的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人体肢体定位任务提供了有效的检测模型，可应用于运动分析和人机交互等领域。

title: Strauss–Howe Generational Theory and Technological Acceleration: A Counter-Thesis on Cyclical History (Strauss–Howe Kuşak Teorisi ve Teknolojik Hızlanma Bağlamında Döngüsel Tarih Üzerine Bir Karşı Tez)

detail.title: Strauss–Howe Generational Theory and Technological Acceleration: A Counter-Thesis on Cyclical History (Strauss–Howe Kuşak Teorisi ve Teknolojik Hızlanma Bağlamında Döngüsel Tarih Üzerine Bir Karşı Tez)
detail.abstract: The Strauss-Howe Generational Theory proposes that modern Anglo-American society progresses through four recurring social phases in cycles of approximately 80-90 years: High, Awakening, Unraveling, and Crisis. The theory attributes these cycles to psychological differences between generational cohorts. While acknowledging that the cyclical insight of Strauss and Howe captures certain recurring dynamics in modern history, this article offers an alternative perspective arguing that the assumption of a fixed temporal rhythm is not historically universal. The counter-thesis presented here proposes that social cycles indeed exist, but their duration varies according to technological development, communication speed, and systemic complexity. As a result, cycles in pre-modern societies proceeded more slowly, whereas in the modern era they have accelerated significantly. This suggests that historical cycles follow a progressively tightening rhythm as societies become more technologically advanced.

AI.tldr: 本文对Strauss-Howe代际理论提出修正，认为社会周期确实存在但持续时间随技术发展而变化，而非固定的80-90年周期。
AI.research_question: 社会周期的持续时间是否固定不变，还是会随技术发展而变化？
AI.motivation: Strauss-Howe代际理论假设固定的80-90年周期，但这种时间节奏假设缺乏历史普遍性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Strauss-Howe代际理论、社会周期理论、技术发展与社会变迁关系理论
AI.method: 理论分析与历史比较方法
AI.findings: 社会周期确实存在，但持续时间随技术发展、通信速度和系统复杂性而变化，现代社会的周期明显加速。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社会周期持续时间可变的理论，修正了Strauss-Howe理论的固定周期假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同社会发展阶段的社会周期提供了更准确的分析框架，有助于预测现代社会的变迁节奏。

title: Abortion Laws and Bangladesh in 2025: Developments and Challenges

detail.title: Abortion Laws and Bangladesh in 2025: Developments and Challenges
detail.abstract: This article critically examines the evolution and contemporary landscape of abortion laws in Bangladesh, focusing on developments up to 2025. It explores the interplay between the country's colonial-era Penal Code, which criminalizes most forms of abortion, and the Menstrual Regulation (MR) program, a public health policy permitting early pregnancy termination. The study highlights the persistent legal ambiguities and socio-cultural barriers that constrain women's reproductive autonomy and access to safe services. Drawing on scholarly research, including rights-based analyses, it underscores the tensions between domestic law and international human rights standards, emphasizing the urgent need for legal reform and policy harmonization. Comparative insights from South Asia contextualize Bangladesh's position relative to more liberal abortion regimes in neighboring countries, illustrating both challenges and potential pathways for reform. The article argues that integrating a comprehensive statutory framework with public health initiatives is essential to protect women's health, autonomy, and reproductive rights in Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了孟加拉国堕胎法律的演变和现状（截至2025年），重点探讨了殖民时期刑法与月经调节计划之间的冲突，揭示了法律模糊性和社会文化障碍对女性生殖自主权的限制，主张通过法律改革和政策协调来保护女性健康与权利。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国堕胎法律的演变及其对女性生殖权利的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国存在殖民时期刑法与公共卫生政策之间的法律冲突，导致女性生殖权利受到限制，需要研究法律改革的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于权利分析框架，结合国际人权标准与国内法律比较分析。
AI.method: 文献分析，包括学术研究和比较法研究，特别关注南亚地区的比较视角。
AI.findings: 孟加拉国存在严重的法律模糊性，殖民刑法与月经调节计划之间存在冲突，限制了女性获得安全堕胎服务的机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了孟加拉国堕胎法律演变的理论分析，揭示了法律冲突对女性权利的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国法律改革提供政策建议，强调需要建立全面的法律框架与公共卫生倡议的整合。

title: The Driver's Dilemma: The Nash Equilibrium Behind Large Car Preferences
affiliations: and University of Florida

detail.title: The Driver's Dilemma: The Nash Equilibrium Behind Large Car Preferences
detail.abstract: This paper examines how individual incentives for vehicle safety can lead to socially inefficient outcomes. Using a game-theoretic framework calibrated to reflect stylized facts from the US vehicle market, we show that the rising share of large vehicles-while privately rational-generates external costs for pedestrians and other drivers. We analyze equilibrium outcomes under both homogeneous and heterogeneous preferences, evaluate various policy tools, and extend the model to dynamic settings using sequential game, evolutionary, and agent-based simulations. Our results underscore the need for targeted policies to realign private incentives with social welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论框架分析车辆安全激励的社会效率问题，发现大型车辆比例上升虽然对个人理性，但对行人和其它司机产生外部成本，需要针对性政策来调整私人激励与社会福利的关系。
AI.research_question: 个体车辆安全激励如何导致社会效率低下的结果？
AI.motivation: 研究大型车辆比例上升对交通安全的社会影响，揭示私人理性选择与社会福利之间的冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论框架，包含同质和异质偏好分析，以及序贯博弈、演化博弈和基于代理的模拟。
AI.method: 使用反映美国车辆市场典型事实的校准博弈论模型，分析均衡结果并评估各种政策工具。
AI.findings: 大型车辆比例上升虽然对个人理性，但对行人和其它司机产生外部成本，导致社会效率低下。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了车辆安全激励的社会效率分析框架，揭示了私人理性与社会福利的冲突机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估和设计针对性政策的工具，以重新调整私人激励与社会福利的关系。

title: A Review of Dimensionality Reduction Methods and Their Applications in Economic and Financial Forecasting

detail.title: A Review of Dimensionality Reduction Methods and Their Applications in Economic and Financial Forecasting
detail.abstract: This paper reviews the role of dimensionality reduction in economic and financial forecasting. High-dimensional socioeconomic data often exhibit multicollinearity, overfitting, and instability, making latent representations essential for extracting meaningful predictive structure. Classical econometric approaches such as Principal Component Analysis and dynamic factor models are linked to modern nonlinear and probabilistic methods, including kernel learning, autoencoders, and Variational Autoencoders. Applications across macroeconomic nowcasting, financial forecasting, and policy evaluation illustrate how supervised and generative frameworks-such as the Supervised Variational Autoencoder (SVAE) and attention-based Dirichlet reinforcement learning policies-extend traditional modeling capabilities to nonlinear, high-dimensional systems. The discussion highlights emerging directions in interpretable, uncertainty-aware, and causally grounded representation learning for empirical forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了降维在经济和金融预测中的作用，探讨了从经典线性方法到现代非线性概率方法的演进，及其在宏观经济即时预测、金融预测和政策评估中的应用。
AI.research_question: 降维方法如何解决高维社会经济数据中的多重共线性、过拟合和不稳定性问题，并提升经济金融预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 高维社会经济数据存在多重共线性、过拟合和不稳定性等挑战，需要有效的降维方法来提取有意义的预测结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主成分分析、动态因子模型等经典计量经济学方法，以及核学习、自编码器、变分自编码器等现代非线性概率方法。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理和比较不同降维技术在经济金融预测中的应用。
AI.findings: 监督和生成框架（如监督变分自编码器和基于注意力的狄利克雷强化学习策略）能够将传统建模能力扩展到非线性高维系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了经典计量经济学方法与现代机器学习方法之间的联系，提出了可解释、不确定性感知和因果基础的表示学习新方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济即时预测、金融预测和政策评估提供了更有效的降维工具和预测框架。

title: Screening in Loan Guarantee Programs: Combining Contract Menus with Information Collection

detail.title: Screening in Loan Guarantee Programs: Combining Contract Menus with Information Collection
detail.abstract: To support credit-constrained small businesses, governments use loan guarantee programs that insure lenders against default risk. However, these programs face challenges in allocating appropriate loan sizes due to limited information about small businesses. This paper explores the welfare implications of using a loan guarantee menu as a screening mechanism to address such challenges, in the context of the South Korean loan guarantee program. I investigate how offering a loan guarantee menu alongside soft information collection (e.g., interviews and site visits) encourages borrowers to reveal their private information, thereby enabling the government agency to make more informed loan size decisions. The study evaluates how these screening mechanisms impact both the economic output of small businesses and the financial losses incurred by the government, as captured by the agency's objective function—a combination of these two outcomes. I find that a loan guarantee menu is effective on its own, increasing the value of the agency's objective function by 3.9%. When combined with soft information collection, its impact is significantly enhanced, leading to an 8.7% increase. This complementarity arises because efforts to collect soft information encourage borrowers with varying risk profiles to self-select into appropriate contracts, thereby leading to more efficient loan allocations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在韩国贷款担保计划中使用贷款担保菜单作为筛选机制对福利的影响。研究发现，单独使用贷款担保菜单可使机构目标函数价值增加3.9%，与软信息收集结合使用时效果显著增强，增加8.7%。
AI.research_question: 贷款担保菜单如何作为筛选机制影响小企业的经济产出和政府财务损失？
AI.motivation: 政府贷款担保计划在为信贷受限的小企业提供支持时面临信息不对称问题，难以确定合适的贷款规模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、筛选机制理论、合同理论

The future case study has anonymous, voluntary survey responses from adults, has received informal ethics review and supervision at Evergreen Valley High School and was conducted in accordance with ethical research principles.

detail.abstract: This working paper examines a simple yet consequential question: How do individuals form the kinds of social ties that enable economic mobility, and what personal, institutional, or chance factors influence this process? Building on Mark Granovetter's foundational work on weak ties and embeddedness, and recent empirical studies on social capital, this paper reviews key literature and identifies a gap in understanding the formation-rather than merely the effects-of social connections. I propose a small, ethically sound pilot survey to practice data collection and analysis while still in high school. The objective is modest: to summarize key readings in my own words, and outline a practical next step that adheres to ethical standards and prepares for future, more formal research.

title: Regional Synchronization in Energy-Related Carbon Dioxide Emissions

detail.title: Regional Synchronization in Energy-Related Carbon Dioxide Emissions
detail.abstract: This paper investigates regional comovement in energy-related carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions across the four major U.S. Census regions-Northeast, Midwest, South, and West-over 1960-2023. Using a dynamic factor model (DFM), we extract latent common factors driving emission changes for coal, natural gas, and petroleum to distinguish between nationwide and region-specific dynamics. The analysis reveals strong regional convergence in petroleum-related emissions, reflecting the influence of nationwide macroeconomic and technological shocks. In contrast, coal and gas emissions display substantial regional heterogeneity, shaped by local resource endowments, generation portfolios, and state-level policies. Granger-causality tests further indicate directional substitution from coal to gas emissions, highlighting the asymmetric nature of decarbonization in the power sector. These results show the importance of distinguishing between nationally synchronized and regionally fragmented emission dynamics when designing related policy. While national instruments such as carbon taxes or fuel-efficiency standards may effectively reduce petroleum emissions, regionally tailored interventions are crucial for mitigating coal and gas emissions.

AI.tldr: 本文使用动态因子模型分析1960-2023年美国四大地区能源相关二氧化碳排放的区域联动性，发现石油排放呈现强区域趋同，而煤炭和天然气排放存在显著区域异质性，政策设计需区分全国同步与区域分化的排放动态。
AI.research_question: 美国四大地区能源相关二氧化碳排放是否存在区域联动性？不同燃料类型的排放动态有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解能源相关二氧化碳排放的区域动态对于设计有效的减排政策至关重要，需要区分全国性因素和区域特定因素的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态因子模型(DFM)，格兰杰因果关系检验
AI.method: 使用动态因子模型提取1960-2023年美国四大地区(东北部、中西部、南部、西部)煤炭、天然气和石油排放的潜在共同因子，区分全国性和区域特定动态，并进行格兰杰因果关系检验。
AI.findings: 1) 石油相关排放呈现强区域趋同，受全国宏观经济和技术冲击影响；2) 煤炭和天然气排放存在显著区域异质性，受当地资源禀赋、发电结构和州级政策影响；3) 存在从煤炭到天然气排放的定向替代关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了区分全国同步与区域分化排放动态的理论框架，揭示了不同燃料类型排放动态的异质性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：全国性政策工具(如碳税、燃油效率标准)对减少石油排放有效，但减少煤炭和天然气排放需要区域定制化干预措施。

title: The Minimal State in Italy: A Proposal for Financing Through a Progressive Minimum Wealth Tax
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Minimal State in Italy: A Proposal for Financing Through a Progressive Minimum Wealth Tax
detail.abstract:
This study examines the feasibility of a minimal state in Italy, understood—within the minarchist tradition—as an institutional framework in which public intervention is limited to three essential and indivisible functions: external defense, internal security and public order, and the administration of justice, including the protection of property rights and the enforcement of contracts. The proposed financing model abandons redistributive logic and introduces a “minimal” progressive wealth tax, conceived as a collective insurance premium: each resident contributes in proportion to net wealth (assets net of liabilities), namely the economic magnitude that the state is primarily called upon to protect. To ensure constitutional consistency, the design internalizes Article 53 of the Italian Constitution (ability-to-pay principle and progressivity) through a no-tax area, a few broad brackets with increasing effective rates, and full deduction of liabilities; Article 23 (principle of legality in taxation) is implemented through a comprehensive and typified discipline of tax liability, base, rates, exemptions, and sanctions, thereby guaranteeing legal certainty and predictability.

Methodologically, the estimate of the public expenditure required for a minimal state combines functional accounting based on the COFOG classification (Classification of the Functions of Government, which allocates spending by homogeneous missions) with club goods theory, i.e. goods that are excludable but non-rival up to congestion thresholds and supplied to a defined membership. Within this framework, the plausible and stable range for the three essential functions is hypothesized at 3.5–4% of GDP. This burden is deemed sustainable through a single, simple tax applied to a broad and relatively stable base such as household net wealth, with deferment and installment mechanisms for illiquid assets (e.g., real estate), supported by real guarantees (e.g., mortgages or pledges), in order to avoid de facto confiscatory effects and preserve proportionality. In line with the insurance analogy, tax evasion is reconceptualized as free riding on an indivisible club good: the system prioritizes proportionate administrative sanctions—surtaxes and interest indexed to a risk-free rate—while reserving criminal penalties for fraudulent conduct (false documentation, artifices, systematic organization).

Finally, the study outlines a twenty-year roadmap for transitioning from the current welfare state—particularly with reference to pensions, healthcare, and education—towards a minarchist framework. This transition is based on tax simplification, enhanced transparency, and a transitional fund financed by privatizations and asset sales, aimed at absorbing exit costs and supporting institutional restructuring. The contribution is twofold: (i) to provide a constitutionally compatible operational framework for financing the minimal state through a single progressive tax on net wealth; and (ii) to reorient the public debate from redistribution to the protection of property rights, with implications in terms of individual responsibility, regulatory predictability, and legitimacy of taxation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在意大利建立最小国家的可行性，提出通过单一渐进式净财富税来融资，并设计了从福利国家向最小国家过渡的20年路线图。
AI.research_question: 意大利建立最小国家的可行性如何？如何通过单一渐进式净财富税来融资？
AI.motivation: 重新定位公共辩论，从再分配转向产权保护，关注个人责任、监管可预测性和税收合法性。

AI.method: 基于COFOG分类的功能性会计与俱乐部物品理论相结合，估算最小国家所需公共支出

AI.practical_contributions: 设计20年过渡路线图，基于税收简化、透明度提高和过渡基金，支持制度重构

title: Resilience of Ukraine's Banking Liquidity Infrastructure: The Impact of Migration Shocks (2013 -2023)
affiliations: Association for Financial Professionals (AFP)

detail.title: Resilience of Ukraine's Banking Liquidity Infrastructure: The Impact of Migration Shocks (2013 -2023)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, professional, or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study did not involve human participants, personal data, or clinical subjects. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support from any organization or individual for the research, authorship, or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This study analyzes the impact of large-scale migration shocks on the liquidity infrastructure of Ukraine's banking system from 2013 to 2023. It identifies two key crisis periods triggered by military-political factors: an internal displacement wave (2014-2015) and an external refugee wave (2022-2023). Using data from the National Bank of Ukraine (NBU), the State Statistics Service, the International Organization for Migration (IOM), and aggregated operational data from a leading Ukrainian bank, we conduct a comprehensive assessment of liquidity infrastructure resilience. The paper introduces the Liquidity Adaptation Rate (LAR)-an original analytical framework designed to quantify resilience in cash-based financial infrastructures. The analysis employs a novel metric-the Liquidity Adaptation Rate (LAR)-which measures the banking system's ability to maintain balanced liquidity amid rapid demographic shifts. The results show that the Ukrainian banking system demonstrated high adaptability, albeit with a 3-6 month reaction lag. Accelerated digitization, the automation of cash in transit (CIT) routes, and a significant increase in non-cash transactions were critical stabilizing factors. The paper concludes with practical recommendations for regulators and banks to enhance resilience against future shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2013-2023年大规模移民冲击对乌克兰银行体系流动性的影响，发现银行系统具有高度适应性但存在3-6个月反应滞后，数字化和自动化现金运输是关键稳定因素。
AI.research_question: 大规模移民冲击如何影响乌克兰银行体系的流动性基础设施？
AI.motivation: 研究军事政治因素引发的移民危机对银行系统流动性的影响，为未来类似冲击提供应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性适应率(LAR)分析框架，用于量化现金基础金融基础设施的韧性。
AI.method: 使用乌克兰国家银行、国家统计局、国际移民组织和乌克兰主要银行的聚合运营数据进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 乌克兰银行系统表现出高度适应性，但有3-6个月反应滞后；加速数字化、自动化现金运输路线和非现金交易显著增加是关键稳定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了流动性适应率(LAR)这一原创分析框架，用于衡量银行系统在快速人口变化中维持流动性平衡的能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和银行提供了增强未来冲击韧性的实用建议。

title: Polycrisis: Root Causes and Governance Solutions
affiliations: SITRA - Finnish Innovation Fund

detail.title: Polycrisis: Root Causes and Governance Solutions
detail.abstract: The current polycrisis creates fundamental anxiety and uncertainty in societies. Individuals, organizations, governments and multinational institutions are struggling with the increasingly complex and uncertain environment without a clear vision of how to govern or renew their institutions. This paper analyzes the root causes of polycrisis and provides a framework for adaptive governance at different levels of society. The framework is based on the Law of Requisite Variety and shared transformative learning processes. It provides governance principles for social innovators who develop sustainable governance solutions for the future. These principles are elaborated with a case study on the Brainport-Eindhoven innovation ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了多重危机的根源，并基于必要多样性法则和共享转型学习过程，提出了一个适用于不同社会层面的适应性治理框架，通过Brainport-Eindhoven创新生态系统案例进行了验证。
AI.research_question: 多重危机的根源是什么？如何构建适应性治理框架来应对日益复杂和不确定的环境？
AI.motivation: 当前多重危机在社会中引发根本性焦虑和不确定性，个人、组织、政府和多国机构在缺乏明确治理或制度更新愿景的情况下，难以应对日益复杂和不确定的环境。

AI.theory_contributions: 发展了适应性治理理论，将必要多样性法则和转型学习过程整合到治理框架中

title: Pathology of Charity Organizations in Iran; With an Emphasis on Extracting Strategies and Policies to Promote the Charity Sector Using the SWOT Technique
affiliations: Research Institute of Hawzah and University and Research Institute of Hawzah and University

detail.title: Pathology of Charity Organizations in Iran; With an Emphasis on Extracting Strategies and Policies to Promote the Charity Sector Using the SWOT Technique
detail.abstract: Charities are among non-profit organizations that are not based on personal profit and pursue charitable and public goals. Being non-governmental, non-profit, non-political, voluntary, and independent are common characteristics of public charity organizations. The current research tries to answer these questions using the SWOT technique: What are the weaknesses and threats of charity organizations in the country? And what strengths and opportunities do they benefit from? What strategies can minimize the weaknesses and prevent those threats from causing harm by taking advantage of the strengths and opportunities in charitable organizations? The results of this research, which used the library method in data collection and content analysis in the inferences, and applied CVI and CVR measurement tools in the validity of the results, indicated that by adopting strategies such as the institutionalization of the public sectors of charity affairs with a network approach, institutionalization of the governance sectors of charity affairs with a network approach, cultural and managerial development in the country's charity sector, and the networking of charitable institutions, the existing strengths will be strengthened, the weaknesses of charity organizations will be reduced to the minimum and existing threats will be turned into opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用SWOT分析探讨慈善组织的优势、劣势、机会和威胁，并提出通过制度化、网络化、文化和管理发展等策略来强化优势、减少劣势、将威胁转化为机会。
AI.research_question: 慈善组织在国内的劣势和威胁是什么？它们受益于哪些优势和机会？通过利用慈善组织的优势和机会，可以采取哪些策略来最小化劣势并防止威胁造成损害？
AI.motivation: 慈善组织作为非营利组织，具有非政府、非营利、非政治、志愿性和独立性等特征，但面临各种挑战，需要系统分析其内外部环境以制定有效策略。

AI.method: 使用图书馆方法收集数据，内容分析进行推断，并应用CVI和CVR测量工具验证结果有效性
AI.findings: 通过采取制度化公共部门慈善事务的网络方法、制度化治理部门慈善事务的网络方法、国家慈善部门的文化和管理发展、以及慈善机构的网络化等策略，可以强化现有优势，将慈善组织的劣势降至最低，并将现有威胁转化为机会

title: Reconciling Consumer and Vendor Preferences for Food Safety Attributes in Dhaka Wet Markets, Bangladesh
affiliations: , independent consultant, The Kenya National Treasury, CGIAR - International Potato Center, CGIAR - International Potato Center, International Livestock Research Institute (ILRI) and CGIAR - International Potato Center

detail.title: Reconciling Consumer and Vendor Preferences for Food Safety Attributes in Dhaka Wet Markets, Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Rapid urbanization presents major challenges to urban food systems, impacting access to safe and nutritious food especially in developing countries. With the urban demand for food surging, there is a proliferation of largely unregulated vendors in the informal food sector to meet this demand. However, these vendors often work in market environments characterized by inadequate sanitation infrastructure and poor waste management processes. Coupled with low consumer and vendor awareness on food safety, this presents a high risk for the spread of foodborne diseases and a significant threat to public health. To understand both demand-and supply-side policy options for promoting food safety, this study utilizes a choice experiment approach to investigate the interplay between consumer preferences and vendor practices regarding food safety in Dhaka's urban markets. The study finds that consumers favour high-quality fresh produce and prioritize vendors with good hygiene, as well as markets with medium to high sanitation. Conversely, vendors have high preferences for markets with improved sanitation and permanent infrastructure, but show hesitation towards investments in storage improvements, underlining the need for targeted policy interventions. Both consumers and vendors have a high willingness to pay for improved market conditions that promote food quality and safety, suggesting that improving market sanitation infrastructure and establishing permanent structures to maintain the quality of fresh produce could be mutually beneficial for both types of actors. Additionally, enhancing food safety awareness among both parties is imperative, addressing the prevalent disregard for vendor hygiene and its repercussions for public health.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了达卡城市市场中消费者偏好与摊贩实践在食品安全方面的互动关系，发现消费者重视高质量生鲜产品和摊贩卫生，而摊贩偏好改善的市场卫生条件但不愿投资存储改善。双方都愿意为改善市场条件付费，建议加强市场基础设施建设和食品安全意识教育。
AI.research_question: 在达卡城市市场中，消费者偏好与摊贩实践如何相互作用以促进食品安全？
AI.motivation: 快速城市化给城市食品系统带来挑战，特别是在发展中国家。非正规食品部门摊贩激增，但市场环境卫生基础设施不足，加上消费者和摊贩食品安全意识低，导致食源性疾病传播风险高，威胁公共健康。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择实验方法，分析消费者和摊贩在食品安全方面的偏好和行为。
AI.method: 采用选择实验方法调查达卡城市市场中消费者偏好与摊贩实践。
AI.findings: 消费者偏好高质量生鲜产品和良好卫生的摊贩，以及中等至高卫生水平的市场；摊贩偏好改善的市场卫生和永久基础设施，但对存储改善投资犹豫；双方都愿意为改善市场条件付费。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了消费者和摊贩在食品安全方面的偏好差异和共同点，为理解城市食品系统中行为主体互动提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议改善市场卫生基础设施、建立永久结构以保持生鲜产品质量、加强双方食品安全意识教育，这些措施对消费者和摊贩都有利。

title: How BRICS Countries Are Reshaping Global Finance: Institutions, Policies, and Implications for the Multipolar Order
affiliations: , Government of the Russian Federation - Financial University (Moscow Branch) and Government of the Russian Federation - Financial University (Moscow Branch)

detail.title: How BRICS Countries Are Reshaping Global Finance: Institutions, Policies, and Implications for the Multipolar Order

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no known financial, institutional, or personal relationships that could have influenced the research presented in this paper. The study was conducted independently for academic purposes as part of a Bachelor’s program at the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation. No conflicts of interest are associated with the authors or their affiliations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, experiments, or the collection of personal data. Therefore, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
