No grants, sponsorships, or institutional funding were provided for the preparation of this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) are reshaping global finance through collective economic and political influence. Formed in the early 2000s to strengthen cooperation among emerging economies, BRICS has evolved into a significant actor in international financial governance. The study analyzes the group's institutional innovations, including the establishment of the New Development Bank (NDB) and the Contingent Reserve Arrangement (CRA), as well as its initiatives promoting trade in local currencies and financial autonomy from Western-led systems. The results indicate that BRICS' institutional innovations, particularly the NDB and CRA contribute to diversifying global finance and promoting regional resilience, though internal asymmetries and policy divergence continue to constrain their overall global impact.

AI.tldr: BRICS国家通过新开发银行和应急储备安排等制度创新重塑全球金融，促进金融多元化和区域韧性，但内部不对称和政策分歧限制了其全球影响力。
AI.research_question: BRICS国家如何通过集体经济和政治影响力重塑全球金融？
AI.motivation: BRICS作为新兴经济体合作组织，已发展成为国际金融治理中的重要参与者，需要研究其制度创新和全球影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际金融治理理论、新兴经济体合作理论、制度创新理论
AI.method: 分析BRICS的制度创新，包括新开发银行和应急储备安排的建立，以及推动本地货币贸易和金融自主的举措
AI.findings: BRICS的制度创新，特别是新开发银行和应急储备安排，有助于多元化全球金融并促进区域韧性，但内部不对称和政策分歧限制了其整体全球影响
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴经济体集体行动在国际金融治理中作用的理解，拓展了制度创新理论的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体提供金融合作模式参考，为国际金融体系改革提供实践经验

title: Technofatalism and Modern Geopolitics: From Imaginaries to Instruments of Power
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Technofatalism and Modern Geopolitics: From Imaginaries to Instruments of Power
detail.abstract: This paper argues that technofatalism-the belief that technological trajectories are inevitable and beyond meaningful political steering-has become a latent but formidable force in modern geopolitics. Technofatalism shapes elite decision-making, public expectations, and regulatory postures across domains from semiconductor supply chains and export controls to autonomous weapons and platform governance. Building on science-and-technology studies (STS), theories of technological determinism, and contemporary security studies, I develop a tripartite framework-imaginaries, infrastructures, and instruments-to explain how technofatalist logics move from discourse into strategy and material capabilities. I then analyze three policy arenas: (1) the AI-autonomy complex and lethal autonomous weapons (LAWS); (2) techno-nationalism in chips and critical minerals; and (3) platformized political economies often described as "technofeudalism." Across cases, technofatalism narrows the policy space by naturalizing escalation and preempting inclusive governance. I conclude with a mitigation agenda focused on re-politicizing technology choices through international norms, humility-based risk governance, and institutional designs that counter performative inevitability.

AI.tldr: 本文认为技术宿命论——即认为技术发展轨迹不可避免且无法通过政治手段有效引导的信念——已成为现代地缘政治中潜在的强大力量。通过分析AI自主武器、芯片技术民族主义和平台化政治经济三个政策领域，作者提出了包含想象、基础设施和工具的三元框架来解释技术宿命论如何从话语转化为战略和物质能力，并提出了通过国际规范、风险治理和制度设计来重新政治化技术选择的缓解议程。
AI.research_question: 技术宿命论如何影响现代地缘政治决策，以及如何通过重新政治化技术选择来缓解其负面影响？
AI.motivation: 技术宿命论已成为影响精英决策、公众期望和监管态度的潜在强大力量，但在学术研究中尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科学技术研究（STS）、技术决定论理论和当代安全研究，构建了包含想象、基础设施和工具的三元分析框架。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与三个政策领域的案例分析：AI自主武器系统、芯片技术民族主义、平台化政治经济。
AI.findings: 技术宿命论通过自然化升级和预先排除包容性治理，缩小了政策空间，影响了半导体供应链、出口管制、自主武器和平台治理等多个领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了技术宿命论的概念框架，发展了从话语到战略和物质能力的转化机制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了包含国际规范、基于谦逊的风险治理和反表演性必然性的制度设计的缓解议程，为政策制定者提供了重新政治化技术选择的实践路径。

title: Political Sorting and Information Frictions in Venture Capital
affiliations: Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge

detail.title: Political Sorting and Information Frictions in Venture Capital
detail.abstract: I study whether partisan separation between investor and startup locations creates frictions in venture capital matching. Using a deal-anchored opportunity-set design and county-level presidential vote shares to measure political distance, I find that a one-standard-deviation increase in political distance lowers the probability of forming an investment match by 0.75 percentage points-roughly 8% of the baseline rate. Systematic mechanism tests reveal that political distance operates through soft information frictions: the penalty amplifies where qualitative assessments matter most-first-round investments, young startups, and unfamiliar geographies-and attenuates where information infrastructure is stronger, such as VC hubs and during the 2020-2023 pandemic period. There is little support for alternative explanations tied to political risk and narrative misalignment. Conditional on funding, higher-political-distance deals exhibit better outcomes, consistent with tighter screening. These findings document a hidden cost of political polarization that operates through information networks, with implications for spatial inequality in access to entrepreneurial capital.

AI.tldr: 研究发现投资者与初创企业之间的政治距离会降低风险投资匹配概率，主要通过软信息摩擦机制影响，特别是在早期投资和陌生地理环境中更明显。
AI.research_question: 党派分离是否在风险投资匹配中产生摩擦？
AI.motivation: 探讨政治极化如何通过信息网络影响创业资本的获取，揭示政治分裂的隐藏成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治距离、信息摩擦理论、风险投资匹配理论
AI.method: 采用交易锚定的机会集设计和县级总统投票份额来衡量政治距离
AI.findings: 政治距离增加一个标准差会使投资匹配概率降低0.75个百分点（约基准率的8%），主要通过软信息摩擦机制运作；政治距离较高的交易在获得资金后表现更好，表明筛选更严格
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政治极化通过信息网络运作的隐藏成本机制，拓展了政治距离对经济决策影响的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 对创业资本获取的空间不平等具有启示意义，为风险投资决策提供参考

title: Monetary Tightening and MSME Lending: Assessing the Impact of RBI Repo Rate Changes (2022-24)
affiliations: Sardar Patel Institute Of Technology

detail.title: Monetary Tightening and MSME Lending: Assessing the Impact of RBI Repo Rate Changes (2022-24)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research presented in this paper. The study was conducted independently as part of my academic research interest in monetary policy and MSME finance, without any external influence from organizations whose activities relate to the topic.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available secondary data from RBI, MOSPI, SIDBI, and CGTMSE. No human participants, confidential data, or sensitive information were involved. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All analysis, data compilation, and writing were conducted independently by the author as part of an academic research initiative.

detail.abstract: How resilient is India's MSME sector to abrupt shifts in monetary policy? This paper investigates post-pandemic credit dynamics amidst an aggressive RBI repo rate hiking cycle (2022-2024). Using newly compiled quarterly datasets from RBI, SIDBI, and MOSPI, and applying robust OLS regression and correlation analysis, we find MSME credit growth accelerated in tandem with the repo rate-a surprising result challenging conventional transmission theory. The findings highlight the decisive role of institutional measures-credit guarantees, refinancing, digitalization-at insulating MSMEs even as inflation and policy rates diverged sharply. This work contributes empirical evidence on the effectiveness of targeted policy interventions in maintaining credit resilience during monetary tightening cycles, while acknowledging limitations in establishing causal inference from the available aggregate data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在印度央行2022-2024年激进的回购利率上调周期中，MSME信贷增长与政策利率同步加速，这一结果挑战了传统的货币政策传导理论。研究强调了信贷担保、再融资和数字化等制度性措施在保护中小企业免受通胀和政策利率分歧影响中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 印度MSME部门对货币政策突然转变的韧性如何？
AI.motivation: 研究后疫情时期在印度央行激进的回购利率上调周期（2022-2024）中的信贷动态
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统货币政策传导理论
AI.method: 使用RBI、SIDBI和MOSPI新编制的季度数据集，应用稳健的OLS回归和相关性分析
AI.findings: MSME信贷增长与回购利率同步加速，这一结果挑战了传统的传导理论
AI.theory_contributions: 为货币政策传导理论提供了实证证据，挑战了传统理论预期
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了定向政策干预在货币紧缩周期中维持信贷韧性的有效性，强调了制度性措施的关键作用

title: Inventories, Production Networks, and International Business Cycles

detail.title: Inventories, Production Networks, and International Business Cycles
detail.abstract: This paper shows that inventories buffer the transmission of shocks through domestic and international production networks. Using sectoral trade and production data, I demonstrate that increased upstream and downstream linkages in production networks intensify shock propagation, while inventory holdings mitigate these effects. I develop a multi-country, multi-sector international real business cycle model that integrates inventory investment, production networks, and sector-level productivity shocks. I show that the model is consistent with empirical evidence on the amplifying effects of production networks and the dampening effects of inventory holdings. Furthermore, incorporating inventory investment enhances the model's ability to accurately capture production comovement, volatility, and cyclicality across countries and sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表明库存能够缓冲冲击通过国内和国际生产网络的传播。研究发现生产网络中的上下游联系会加剧冲击传播，而库存持有能够缓解这些效应。
AI.research_question: 库存如何影响冲击通过生产网络的传播？
AI.motivation: 理解生产网络中冲击传播的机制，以及库存在其中扮演的角色
AI.theoretical_framework: 多国多部门国际实际商业周期模型，整合库存投资、生产网络和部门级生产率冲击
AI.method: 使用部门贸易和生产数据，构建多国多部门国际实际商业周期模型
AI.findings: 生产网络中的上下游联系加剧冲击传播，库存持有能够缓解这些效应；包含库存投资的模型能更好地捕捉跨国跨部门的生产联动、波动性和周期性
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了整合库存投资和生产网络的国际实际商业周期模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解冲击传播机制和库存管理提供了理论依据

title: Mobile Forensics: A Distinct Discipline in Digital Investigation and Enterprise Risk Management
affiliations: University of the Cumberlands (formerly Cumberland College)

detail.title: Mobile Forensics: A Distinct Discipline in Digital Investigation and Enterprise Risk Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or personally identifiable information. Therefore, ethical approval was not required in accordance with institutional guidelines and the principles of research integrity.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit organization. The study was conducted as part of academic coursework within the Doctor of Philosophy in Information Technology program at the University of the Cumberlands.

detail.abstract: Mobile forensics has evolved into a very critical discipline within digital forensics, focusing on the acquisition, preservation, and analysis of data from portable devices, including smartphones and tablets. This paper examines the fundamental differences between mobile and computer forensics, emphasizing how decentralized architectures, encryption mechanisms, and diverse operating systems redefine digital investigation. It explores the exponential growth of mobilebased network attacks and their implications for enterprise security, presenting statistical evidence that highlights the rising vulnerability of mobile ecosystems. The study further identifies the core challenges of device fragmentation, encryption barriers, cloud-based storage, and limited standardization. Prominent forensic tools, including Cellebrite UFED, Oxygen Forensic Detective, and Magnet AXIOM, are evaluated for their capabilities in data extraction and validation. A comparative analysis of the iOS and Android platforms reveals the architectural and procedural distinctions that impact forensic methodologies. The paper concludes by emphasizing the need to integrate governance frameworks, such as NIST SP 800-86 and COBIT 5, to enhance forensic readiness, strengthen legal defensibility, and align technical practices with enterprise risk management objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了移动取证与传统计算机取证的关键差异，探讨了移动网络攻击的增长趋势，识别了设备碎片化、加密障碍等核心挑战，评估了主流取证工具，并提出了整合治理框架的必要性。
AI.research_question: 移动取证与传统计算机取证在架构、加密机制和操作系统方面存在哪些根本差异？如何应对移动生态系统日益增长的安全漏洞？
AI.motivation: 移动设备已成为网络攻击的主要目标，其分散式架构、加密机制和多样化操作系统对数字调查提出了新的挑战，需要重新定义取证方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于移动取证理论框架，涵盖设备架构、加密机制、操作系统差异以及网络攻击模式分析。
AI.method: 采用比较分析方法，对比移动与计算机取证差异；通过统计证据分析移动网络攻击趋势；评估主流取证工具的功能和有效性。
AI.findings: 移动取证面临设备碎片化、加密障碍、云存储和标准化不足等核心挑战；iOS和Android平台在架构和取证程序上存在显著差异；移动生态系统漏洞呈指数级增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了移动取证的理论基础，明确了与传统计算机取证的根本差异，为移动取证方法论提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 评估了Cellebrite UFED等取证工具的实际应用价值；提出了整合NIST SP 800-86和COBIT 5等治理框架的建议，以增强取证准备度和法律可辩护性。

title: National Educational Paradigm of Russia in the Conditions of Social Transformation
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: National Educational Paradigm of Russia in the Conditions of Social Transformation
detail.abstract: This article examines the paradigmatic foundations for transforming the Russian education system in the context of societal changes caused by the deteriorating international situation and ideological sovereignty. It substantiates the need to transition from a business-oriented education model to a state-patriotic paradigm focused on nurturing citizens who are bearers of national values.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在因国际局势恶化和意识形态主权而引发的社会变革背景下，俄罗斯教育体系转型的范式基础。论证了从商业导向教育模式向国家爱国主义范式转变的必要性，该范式旨在培养承载民族价值观的公民。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯教育体系在当代社会变革背景下应如何转型？
AI.motivation: 国际局势恶化和意识形态主权要求教育体系进行根本性变革，以应对新的社会需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 范式转换理论、国家爱国主义教育理论、价值观教育理论
AI.method: 理论分析和范式论证
AI.findings: 需要从商业导向教育模式转向国家爱国主义教育范式
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从商业范式向国家爱国主义范式转换的教育理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为俄罗斯教育体系改革提供了具体的转型方向和实施路径

title: Code as Law, Trust as Code: How Programmable Rules Reshape Financial Governance in Decentralized Finance
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics

detail.title: Code as Law, Trust as Code: How Programmable Rules Reshape Financial Governance in Decentralized Finance
detail.abstract: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) represents not merely a technological evolution but a fundamental reconfiguration of financial governance-shifting authority from hierarchical intermediaries to self-executing code. Drawing on institutional economics and legal theory, this article argues that DeFi enacts a new governance paradigm wherein trust is no longer vested in persons or institutions but encoded into deterministic protocols. Through analysis of the four core DeFi primitives-decentralized exchanges, lending platforms, programmable derivatives, and automated financial processes-we demonstrate how programmable rules disintermediate traditional fiduciary and enforcement functions. A focused illustration of Compound's governance evolution reveals both the promise of efficiency gains and the emergence of novel accountability deficits. We identify a central tension: while automated rule enforcement reduces transaction costs and principal-agent frictions, it simultaneously attenuates contestability, adaptability, and redress-features essential to resilient financial systems. The article concludes by proposing a framework for hybrid governance that preserves code-based efficiency while reintroducing deliberative safeguards, offering pathways for regulators, protocol designers, and scholars to navigate the institutional re-embedding of finance in the post-intermediary era.

AI.tldr: DeFi通过将信任编码到确定性协议中，从根本上重构了金融治理，从层级中介转向自我执行代码。文章分析了DeFi四大核心原语，揭示了自动化规则执行在降低交易成本的同时也削弱了系统的可争议性、适应性和救济能力。最后提出了保留代码效率同时重新引入审议保障的混合治理框架。
AI.research_question: DeFi如何通过编码信任重构金融治理范式？这种新范式在效率和问责方面存在哪些核心张力？
AI.motivation: DeFi不仅仅是技术演进，更是金融治理的根本性重构——将权力从层级中介转移到自我执行代码，这引发了关于信任、问责和治理的新问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学和法律理论，探讨DeFi如何将信任从个人或机构转移到确定性协议中。
AI.method: 分析DeFi四大核心原语（去中心化交易所、借贷平台、可编程衍生品、自动化金融流程），并以Compound的治理演进作为重点案例研究。
AI.findings: 自动化规则执行降低了交易成本和委托代理摩擦，但同时也削弱了系统的可争议性、适应性和救济能力，这些特征对弹性金融系统至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DeFi作为新治理范式的理论框架，识别了代码治理中的核心张力，为理解后中介时代的金融制度重构提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了混合治理框架，为监管机构、协议设计者和学者提供了在后中介时代重新嵌入金融制度的路径，平衡代码效率与审议保障。

title: The Interplay Between Private Equity and Sovereign Wealth Funds, and the Global AI Ecosystems: A Comparative Analysis of GCC Investments in Select Destinations

detail.title: The Interplay Between Private Equity and Sovereign Wealth Funds, and the Global AI Ecosystems: A Comparative Analysis of GCC Investments in Select Destinations
detail.abstract: This paper examines the strategic linkages between private equity firms and sovereign wealth funds (SWFs) from Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries-primarily Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), the United Arab Emirates' (UAE) Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA), Mubadala Investment Company, and MGX, and Qatar's Qatar Investment Authority (QIA)-and their investments in artificial intelligence (AI) ecosystems across the USA, China, Japan, Europe (with focus on the Nordic countries, Germany, France, and Eastern Europe), Brazil, Russia, India, and South Korea. Drawing on recent developments, it highlights how GCC SWFs, managing over $4.9 trillion in assets, are leveraging partnerships with private equity to finance AI infrastructure, startups, and innovation, blurring the lines between financial investment and geopolitical influence. The analysis reveals a predominant focus on the USA, with emerging engagements in Asia and Europe, and limited but strategic ties in Latin America and Russia. A percentage-wise distribution of GCC SWF investments, based on public domain data, is provided, along with AI-specific investments as a percentage of total outward flows and market inferences on GCC ownership of global AI value over the next five years. Implications for global AI governance and economic diversification are discussed, emphasizing the role of capital as a form of soft power.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了海湾合作委员会国家主权财富基金与私募股权公司的战略联系，以及它们在人工智能领域的全球投资布局，重点探讨了资本作为软权力的作用。
AI.research_question: 海湾合作委员会国家主权财富基金如何通过与私募股权公司的战略联系，在全球人工智能生态系统中进行投资布局？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能技术的快速发展，海湾合作委员会国家主权财富基金管理着超过4.9万亿美元资产，正通过私募股权合作投资AI基础设施、初创企业和创新项目，模糊了金融投资与地缘政治影响之间的界限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于软权力理论和地缘经济学框架，分析资本作为软权力的作用机制。
AI.method: 基于公开领域数据的定量分析，包括投资分布百分比、AI投资占对外投资总额比例，以及对未来五年全球AI价值所有权的市场推断。
AI.findings: GCC主权财富基金的投资主要集中在美囯，同时在亚洲和欧洲有新兴投资活动，在拉丁美洲和俄罗斯有有限但战略性的联系。投资分布呈现明显的区域偏好。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对主权财富基金作为软权力工具的理解，扩展了地缘经济学在AI投资领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球AI治理和经济多元化提供了政策启示，揭示了资本配置对技术发展路径的影响。

title: Assessing the Impact of Foreign Aid and External Public Debt on Environmental Human Development : Evidence from Least Advanced and Middle-Income Countries

detail.title: Assessing the Impact of Foreign Aid and External Public Debt on Environmental Human Development : Evidence from Least Advanced and Middle-Income Countries
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of foreign aid and external public debt on the environmental human development of 129 least advanced and middle-income countries that have received foreign assistance flows from the OECD-DAC over the period from 2000 to 2020. The results of the panel data based on the robust fixed-effect estimator reveal that foreign aid allocations inhibit development through its detrimental effect on life expectancy, education and income. However foreign aid contributes to mitigate climate damages through its impact on raw material consumption and CO2 emissions reduction. Moreover, external public debt promotes development in least advanced and middle-income countries through its positive impact on life expectancy. To achieve a strong sustainable development, least advanced and middle-income countries need to focus on the financial development, FDI inflows, government effectiveness, and government expenses. They also need to avoid corruption in the borrowed resources to meet economic, human, and environmental targets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2000-2020年间129个最不发达和中等收入国家的外国援助和外部公共债务对环境人类发展的影响。研究发现外国援助通过降低预期寿命、教育和收入抑制发展，但通过减少原材料消耗和CO2排放缓解气候损害；外部公共债务通过提高预期寿命促进发展。
AI.research_question: 外国援助和外部公共债务如何影响最不发达和中等收入国家的环境人类发展？
AI.motivation: 研究最不发达和中等收入国家在可持续发展过程中，外国援助和外部公共债务的作用机制及其对经济、人类和环境目标的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境人类发展理论，分析外国援助和外部公共债务对可持续发展三个维度（经济、社会、环境）的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2000-2020年129个国家的面板数据，采用稳健固定效应估计器进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 外国援助分配通过负面影响预期寿命、教育和收入抑制发展；2) 外国援助通过减少原材料消耗和CO2排放缓解气候损害；3) 外部公共债务通过提高预期寿命促进发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了外国援助和外部公共债务对可持续发展的双重作用机制，丰富了环境人类发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最不发达和中等收入国家提供了实现可持续发展的政策建议：关注金融发展、FDI流入、政府效能和政府支出，避免借贷资源中的腐败。

title: Digitalisation, Social Media and Bank Deposit Dynamics: Evidence from the Recent Euro Area Monetary Tightening
affiliations: Central Bank of Ireland, Central Bank of Malta and European Systemic Risk Board

detail.title: Digitalisation, Social Media and Bank Deposit Dynamics: Evidence from the Recent Euro Area Monetary Tightening
detail.abstract: This study sheds light on the impact of digitalisation and social media on deposit flows and rates of euro area banks during the recent period of monetary tightening. Drawing on difference-in-differences analysis of confidential monthly data (12/2019 –10/2023) of deposit flows and rates as well as measures of bank digitalisation and social media exposure through Twitter sentiment, the study offers two novel sets of findings. First, banks with a higher degree of digitalisation exhibit larger fluctuations in deposits, with higher inflows from mid-2020 to early 2022 but greater outflows in response to the tightening. Digitalisation is also correlated with higher sensitivity of banks’ NFC deposit rates to policy rates. Second, a negative Twitter sentiment reduces deposit inflows, even after accounting for traditional news’ sentiment and a comprehensive set of bank-specific factors, including asset prices and performance indicators.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨数字化和社交媒体在货币紧缩期间对欧元区银行存款流动和利率的影响。研究发现：数字化程度高的银行存款波动更大，对政策利率更敏感；负面Twitter情绪会减少存款流入。
AI.research_question: 数字化和社交媒体如何影响欧元区银行在货币紧缩期间的存款流动和利率？
AI.motivation: 理解数字化和社交媒体在货币政策传导中的作用，特别是在近期货币紧缩背景下对银行体系的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字化银行理论、社交媒体情绪分析理论和货币政策传导机制理论。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法分析2019年12月至2023年10月的月度机密数据，包括存款流动、利率、银行数字化程度和Twitter情绪指标。
AI.findings: 1) 数字化程度高的银行存款波动更大，2020年中至2022年初流入更多，但紧缩期间流出更多；2) 数字化银行对政策利率更敏感；3) 负面Twitter情绪会减少存款流入。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了数字化和社交媒体在货币政策传导中的作用机制理论，为理解现代金融环境下的银行行为提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理数字化风险和社交媒体影响提供实践指导，为监管机构制定相关政策提供依据。

title: When Ideas become Mainstream? Theory and Empirical Evidence from Econometrics Techniques
affiliations: Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos

detail.title: When Ideas become Mainstream? Theory and Empirical Evidence from Econometrics Techniques
detail.abstract: When do ideas become mainstream? Existing models predict that widely-cited innovations should be widely adopted, yet machine learning in economics generates explosive citations while remaining institutionally confined, and structural econometrics maintains the broadest networks despite declining usage. This paper demonstrates that diffusion operates independently across three levels-awareness, adoption, and spatial embedding-each governed by distinct mechanisms. Analyzing six econometric methods using 21,911 citations, 2,744 market observations, and 3,963 researchers (1950-2024), I find that awareness spreads smoothly through citations, but actual adoption faces substantial resistance varying 814-fold across methods. Machine learning grows fastest despite highest barriers because demonstrated value overcomes computational costs. Spatial diffusion varies 8-fold independent of usage patterns: structural econometrics achieves maximum institutional reach despite losing market share. Learning costs create 6.7-fold entry barriers; network effects generate 45-fold adoption increases. Effective innovation policy requires simultaneous intervention across awareness, adoption barriers, and institutional networks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现创新的扩散在认知度、采用度和空间嵌入三个层面独立运作，每个层面受不同机制支配。通过对六种计量经济学方法的分析发现，认知度通过引用平滑传播，但实际采用面临814倍的阻力差异，机器学习增长最快但障碍最高，空间扩散与使用模式无关，结构计量经济学保持最广制度网络。
AI.research_question: 创新何时成为主流？为什么广泛引用的创新不一定被广泛采用？
AI.motivation: 现有模型预测广泛引用的创新应该被广泛采用，但机器学习在经济学中产生爆炸性引用却仍局限于制度内，而结构计量经济学保持最广网络但使用率下降，这种矛盾需要解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新扩散的三层次框架：认知度、采用度、空间嵌入，每个层面受不同机制支配。
AI.method: 分析六种计量经济学方法，使用21,911次引用、2,744个市场观察和3,963名研究人员的数据（1950-2024年）。
AI.findings: 认知度通过引用平滑传播，但实际采用面临814倍的阻力差异；机器学习增长最快但障碍最高；空间扩散与使用模式无关，结构计量经济学保持最广制度网络；学习成本造成6.7倍进入障碍；网络效应产生45倍采用增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出创新扩散的三层次理论框架，揭示认知度、采用度和空间嵌入的独立运作机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 有效的创新政策需要在认知度、采用障碍和制度网络三个层面同时干预。

title: The Death of Tribalism and the Birth of Nationalities: A Progressive Concept for Democratic Progress in Kenya

detail.title: The Death of Tribalism and the Birth of Nationalities: A Progressive Concept for Democratic Progress in Kenya
detail.abstract: Kenya's democratic trajectory has been shaped by the tension between tribalism-a colonial legacy fueling political division-and the emergence of nationalities, civic identities rooted in shared democratic values. This paper examines the decline of tribal affiliations through post-independence reforms and the rise of national identities as a progressive force for democratic governance. Drawing on historical events, the 2010 Constitution, the Building Bridges Initiative (BBI), and the legacy of Raila Odinga-who died in October 2025-it argues that nationalities foster inclusivity, reduce ethnic violence, and strengthen democratic institutions. Despite challenges like elite manipulation and disinformation, Kenya's shift toward civic unity, exemplified by youth movements and devolution, underscores nationalities as the only viable path for democratic progress in its multi-ethnic society.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了肯尼亚民主发展轨迹，分析了部落主义（殖民遗留问题）与民族认同（基于民主价值观的公民身份）之间的张力。研究发现，民族认同的兴起通过促进包容性、减少族群暴力、加强民主制度，为肯尼亚多民族社会的民主进步提供了可行路径。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚的民主发展轨迹如何受到部落主义与民族认同之间张力的影响？民族认同是否能够成为多民族社会民主进步的可行路径？
AI.motivation: 理解肯尼亚民主发展中的关键张力——殖民遗留的部落主义与新兴的民族认同之间的冲突，以及这种张力如何影响国家的民主治理进程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于民族认同理论、民主治理理论和后殖民国家建设理论，分析部落主义与公民身份认同在民主发展中的作用。
AI.method: 历史事件分析、宪法文本分析（2010年宪法）、政策倡议分析（建设桥梁倡议BBI）和关键政治人物遗产分析（Raila Odinga）。
AI.findings: 民族认同的兴起促进了肯尼亚的包容性治理，减少了族群暴力，加强了民主制度；尽管面临精英操纵和虚假信息的挑战，但青年运动和权力下放等机制推动了公民团结。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对多民族社会中民主发展路径的理解，提出了民族认同作为部落主义替代方案的理论框架，丰富了后殖民国家民主转型的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚及其他多民族社会的民主治理提供实践指导，强调了宪法改革、公民教育和青年参与在促进民族认同和民主进步中的重要性。

title: Three Decades of Business and Trade Research in Asean Countries: A Comprehensive Bibliometric Review
affiliations: Rajagiri College of Social Sciences (Autonomous), Kochi, Kerala, India,  and Asian Business School

detail.title: Three Decades of Business and Trade Research in Asean Countries: A Comprehensive Bibliometric Review
detail.abstract: This bibliometric review examines three decades of business and trade research within the ASEAN region, focusing on productivity, collaboration, and emerging trends across member countries. Established in 1967, ASEAN has evolved into a significant economic entity with growing influence in global trade. Using Scopus data from 1994 to 2024, the study employs Biblioshiny and VOSviewer to map key authors, institutions, and research themes. Results reveal a significant rise in publication output, led by Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand, reflecting heightened academic engagement. Dominant themes include "international trade," "commerce," and "competition," with recent emphasis on "sustainability," "digital transformation," and "blockchain." Strong international coauthorship highlights ASEAN's integration into the global research community. The study identifies leading institutions, assesses ASEAN's trade-related policies, and explores their broader economic implications. Limitations include reliance on a single database and the dynamic nature of the field. Future research should integrate multiple databases and examine interdisciplinary and technological intersections shaping ASEAN trade studies.

AI.tldr: 本文对东盟地区30年商业与贸易研究进行文献计量分析，发现出版量显著增长，研究主题从传统贸易转向可持续性、数字化转型和区块链等新兴领域，展现了东盟在全球研究界的整合趋势。
AI.research_question: 东盟地区过去30年商业与贸易研究的学术生产力、合作模式和新兴趋势是什么？
AI.motivation: 东盟自1967年成立以来已发展成为重要的经济实体，在全球贸易中影响力不断增强，需要系统梳理该地区商业与贸易研究的演变历程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学理论，包括科学计量学、合作网络分析和主题演化分析。
AI.method: 使用Scopus数据库1994-2024年数据，采用Biblioshiny和VOSviewer软件进行文献计量分析，包括作者、机构和研究主题的映射。
AI.findings: 出版量显著增长，印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡和泰国为领先国家；主导主题包括"国际贸易"、"商业"和"竞争"，近期转向"可持续性"、"数字化转型"和"区块链"；国际合著关系密切。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了东盟地区商业与贸易研究的文献计量框架，揭示了该领域的研究演进规律和知识结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了领先研究机构和关键研究主题，为政策制定者提供了东盟贸易相关政策评估和经济影响分析的参考依据。

title: Adaptive Significance Levels for Balanced Hypothesis Testing: A Simulation Study

detail.title: Adaptive Significance Levels for Balanced Hypothesis Testing: A Simulation Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human patients or participants. As a simulation-based methodological investigation, it relied entirely on synthetic data generated through Monte Carlo procedures. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Statistical significance testing remains the dominant tool in management research, yet its reliance on fixed thresholds such as p < 0.05 has been widely criticized for inflating false positives and undermining replicability. We introduce an adaptive significance framework that scales a with observed evidence via a logistic adjustment, ensuring greater conservatism near the null while converging to the classical rule at large effects. Monte Carlo simulations across nine canonical test families-including t-tests, ANOVA, correlation, nonparametric, and categorical data tests demonstrate that adaptive a reduces false positives by 15-25% without sacrificing power at substantively meaningful effect sizes. Theoretical analysis establishes formal Type I error control and interpretability of calibration. By filtering trivial but statistically significant results in large samples, suppressing noisy false alarms in small studies, and adding protection in high-stakes contexts, adaptive a offers a rigorous and managerially relevant safeguard that strengthens the credibility of empirical research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个自适应显著性框架，通过逻辑调整根据观察到的证据缩放α值，在零假设附近更保守，在大效应时收敛到经典规则。蒙特卡洛模拟显示该方法能减少15-25%的假阳性，同时不牺牲实质性效应大小的统计功效。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个自适应显著性框架来解决传统统计显著性检验中固定阈值（如p<0.05）导致的假阳性膨胀和可复制性问题？
AI.motivation: 管理研究中统计显著性检验仍占主导地位，但其依赖固定阈值已被广泛批评会导致假阳性膨胀并削弱可复制性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应显著性框架，通过逻辑调整根据观察证据缩放α值，在零假设附近保持更大保守性，在大效应时收敛到经典规则。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟，涵盖九个典型检验族（包括t检验、ANOVA、相关性、非参数和分类数据检验）。
AI.findings: 自适应α能减少15-25%的假阳性，同时在实质性有意义的效应大小上不牺牲统计功效。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了形式化的第一类错误控制和校准的可解释性理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过在大样本中过滤微不足道但统计显著的结果、抑制小研究中的噪声假警报、在高风险情境中增加保护，自适应α为实证研究提供了严谨且与管理相关的保障，增强了研究可信度。

title: Putting Economics Back in Humanomics
affiliations: Florida Atlantic University and

detail.title: Putting Economics Back in Humanomics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Both authors declare no interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Both authors declare no funding.

detail.abstract: This paper defends the economic approach to human behavior against recent critiques from the Humanomics literature. We argue that scholars in that literature often mischaracterize economics as assuming narrow self-interest, when in fact it is a method for analyzing purposeful action under constraints, regardless of motivation. Using examples from charity, blood donation, and political behavior, we show that the economic approach can account for moral and social behavior within the standard framework of utility maximization. By contrast, Humanomics lacks falsifiability and generality. We conclude that economics requires a more consistent application of its core insights, not a new paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文为经济学方法辩护，反对Humanomics学派的批评，指出经济学方法能够解释道德和社会行为，无需新范式。
AI.research_question: 经济学方法是否能够解释道德和社会行为？Humanomics对经济学的批评是否合理？
AI.motivation: 回应Humanomics学派对经济学方法的批评，澄清经济学方法的本质和适用范围。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济学方法作为分析约束条件下有目的行动的方法，效用最大化框架。
AI.method: 使用慈善、献血和政治行为的例子进行理论分析和案例研究。
AI.findings: 经济学方法能够解释道德和社会行为，Humanomics缺乏可证伪性和普适性。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清经济学方法的本质，证明其能够容纳道德和社会行为，无需新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学方法在分析社会行为中的应用提供理论支持，促进经济学方法的更一致应用。

reference: Banque de France Working Paper No. No. 1019
title: Quantifying Uncertainty in France's Debt Trajectory: A VAR-Based Analysis
affiliations: Banque de France, Banque de France and National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE), University of Cergy-Pontoise

detail.title: Quantifying Uncertainty in France's Debt Trajectory: A VAR-Based Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banque de France Working Paper No. No. 1019
publicationDetails.journalName: Banque de France Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We propose a simple, simulation-based framework for stochastic debt-sustainability analysis. Estimating a parsimonious vector autoregression (frequentist and Bayesian) on quarterly French data (1990:Q1-2023:Q4) for the debt's key drivers, we generate predictive fan charts and probability statements for debt-to-GDP outcomes. Median VAR projections are close to a hypothetical deterministic baseline derived from the deterministic debt sustainability analysis framework. Assuming this illustrative central scenario, historical relationships estimated by our VAR models imply a corresponding confidence band around the debt trajectory. The BVAR yields slightly wider cones and lower tail probabilities than the frequentist VAR, with cone widths between those reported by the European Commission and the ECB. Our analysis, which does not reflect the most recent developments in public finance, suggests that an ambitious fiscal consolidation effort would be required to materially enhance the prospects of stabilizing the debt-to-GDP ratio over the medium term.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于模拟的随机债务可持续性分析框架，使用法国季度数据（1990-2023）构建简约VAR模型，生成债务/GDP比率的预测扇形图和概率陈述。分析表明需要雄心勃勃的财政整顿才能在中期内稳定债务比率。
AI.research_question: 如何基于随机方法评估法国债务可持续性？
AI.motivation: 传统确定性债务可持续性分析存在局限性，需要引入随机性来更准确地评估债务风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 向量自回归模型（VAR）、贝叶斯向量自回归模型（BVAR）、债务可持续性分析框架
AI.method: 使用法国1990年第一季度至2023年第四季度的季度数据，构建简约的频数主义VAR和贝叶斯VAR模型，进行模拟预测分析
AI.findings: VAR中值预测接近确定性基准情景；BVAR产生比频数主义VAR更宽的置信区间和更低的尾部概率；需要雄心勃勃的财政整顿才能稳定债务比率
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于模拟的随机债务可持续性分析框架，扩展了传统确定性分析方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供更准确的债务风险评估工具，有助于制定更有效的财政政策

title: Causality Direction and Correlation Dynamics between Oil and Gold Prices in the Global Market: A VAR Model and Crisis Subperiods Approach
affiliations: Islamic Azad University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Causality Direction and Correlation Dynamics between Oil and Gold Prices in the Global Market: A VAR Model and Crisis Subperiods Approach
detail.abstract: This study employs annual data (1900–2023) and monthly data (1974–2025), utilizing the Vector Autoregressive (VAR) model and Granger causality test to evaluate the interrelationships and causality direction between oil and gold prices in the global market. To obtain a more precise picture of the dynamics of this relationship, the monthly period is divided into eight distinct subperiods, including major crisis episodes, such as the 2008 financial crisis, the COVID-19 pandemic, the Russia–Ukraine war, and the first Trump administration, as well as the last quarter of the twentieth century and the first quarter of the twenty-first century. Optimal lag selection and descriptive statistical analyses were conducted for each subperiod to minimize estimation errors and enhance the accuracy of results. Furthermore, to examine the long-term responses of variables to each other’s shocks, impulse response functions derived from the VAR model were employed. The findings indicate that the causal relationship between oil and gold prices in the short run is highly dependent on the time period, data type, and market conditions. Specifically, in some subperiods, a unidirectional causality from gold to oil or from oil to gold is observed, whereas in other periods no significant causal relationship is confirmed. In the long run, statistical evidence suggests that shocks in one of these markets cannot sustainably and significantly influence the price behavior of the other.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用VAR模型和格兰杰因果检验分析1900-2023年年度数据和1974-2025年月度数据，发现石油与黄金价格的因果关系在短期高度依赖时间段、数据类型和市场条件，而在长期两者间不存在持续显著的影响。
AI.research_question: 全球市场中石油与黄金价格之间的相互关系及因果关系方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解石油与黄金价格在不同时期（包括重大危机事件）的动态关系，为投资者和政策制定者提供更准确的市场洞察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 向量自回归(VAR)模型、格兰杰因果检验理论、脉冲响应函数分析
AI.method: 使用年度数据(1900-2023)和月度数据(1974-2025)，将月度数据分为8个子时期（包括2008年金融危机、COVID-19大流行、俄乌战争等重大事件），进行最优滞后选择、描述性统计分析、VAR模型估计和格兰杰因果检验。
AI.findings: 短期因果关系高度依赖时间段、数据类型和市场条件，某些子时期存在从黄金到石油或从石油到黄金的单向因果关系，而其他时期无显著因果关系；长期来看，一个市场的冲击无法持续显著影响另一个市场的价格行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对石油与黄金价格关系动态性的理解，揭示了这种关系在短期的高度情境依赖性，挑战了传统关于两者稳定关系的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在不同市场条件下制定投资策略提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者更好地理解大宗商品市场的联动机制，特别是在危机时期。

title: Are Pharmaceutical Profits Excessive?

detail.title: Are Pharmaceutical Profits Excessive?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I provide consultancy services to pharmaceutical companies.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: This paper received no funding, in-kind support, or editorial input from any firm or industry association. All views are my own.

detail.abstract: Objective: This paper aims to answer the following question: Do firm-level data on investment and profits indicate that pharmaceutical profits are excessive? Data and methods: Time series data on investment and profits for the 15 largest R&D-intensive pharmaceutical firms in the Compustat database are combined with data from other sources on the lags between investment and sales. Nominal values are converted to 2024 values using the US Consumer Price Index (CPI). In addition to these 15 firms, two aggregate firms are created. The first (labelled ALL15) by pooling the data of the 15 firms, the second (labelled TOT) by pooling all R&D-intensive pharmaceutical firms in the Compustat database, including firms that are no longer present. For each firm the ratio of 2005-2024 profits to lagged investment is estimated. These ratios are then used to compute internal rates of return (𝐼𝑅𝑅s). These 𝐼𝑅𝑅𝑠 measure the average profitability of (approximately) 1992–2011 investment. Results: The pooled 𝐼𝑅𝑅 of these 15 firms (ALL15) was 10.0%, which is at the mid-point of values used in the literature for the real cost of capital for pharmaceutical firms. For 3 out of these 15 firms, the 𝐼𝑅𝑅 was at least 20%, which implies excessive profits at the firm-level. These 3 firms are fairly new and relatively small. High 𝐼𝑅𝑅𝑠 for these firms may reflect survival bias. These findings are robust to various sensitivity analyses. Estimated 𝐼𝑅𝑅𝑠 are probably biased upwards, because survival bias and because mergers and acquisitions (M&As) could not be taken into account due to data limitations. That these biases play a role is supported by the finding that the 𝐼𝑅𝑅 for the aggregate firm TOT (which is less sensitive to these biases) is 8.8%, 1.2% lower than the 𝐼𝑅𝑅 for the aggregate firm ALL15. Conclusion: At commonly used values for the cost of capital, the results in this paper on average do not point to excess profits for this sample of firms, nor for the pharmaceutical sector as a whole. Excess profits at the firm-level were found for some smaller firms, but this may reflect survival bias. Future research could improve on the estimates in this paper by including more detailed data on costs and sales, mergers and acquisitions, and investment in drug development by firms not (yet) included in the Compustat database.

AI.tldr: 本文分析15家大型研发密集型制药公司的投资与利润数据，发现整体内部收益率(10.0%)与文献中资本成本估计值相符，表明制药行业整体不存在超额利润。但3家较新小型公司IRR超过20%，可能存在超额利润，这可能是生存偏差所致。
AI.research_question: 制药公司的利润是否过高？
AI.motivation: 评估制药行业是否存在超额利润，这对政策制定和行业监管具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内部收益率(IRR)理论，比较实际收益率与资本成本来判断是否存在超额利润。
AI.method: 使用Compustat数据库中15家最大研发密集型制药公司的时间序列数据，计算2005-2024年利润与滞后投资的比率，进而估算IRR。创建两个聚合公司(ALL15和TOT)进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 15家公司整体IRR为10.0%，与文献中制药公司实际资本成本估计值相符。3家较新小型公司IRR超过20%，但可能受生存偏差影响。TOT聚合公司的IRR为8.8%，低于ALL15的10.0%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于IRR方法的制药行业利润分析框架，识别了生存偏差和并购活动对利润估计的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据，表明制药行业整体不存在系统性超额利润，但对个别小型公司的监管仍需关注。研究结果为行业监管和反垄断政策提供参考。

title: Unlocking Growth in Technology-Driven Markets through Mergers
affiliations: E.CA Economics

detail.title: Unlocking Growth in Technology-Driven Markets through Mergers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I provided economic advice to telecommunication companies in merger and abuseof dominance cases.

detail.abstract: This article explores the efficiencies central to the CMA's Approval Decision of the mobile merger between Vodafone and Three in the UK in 2024 and identifies an additional efficiency not yet explicitly acknowledged by competition authorities: the efficiency of avoiding duplicative fixed investments in technology-driven markets. By consolidating infrastructure, mergers can reduce the aggregate fixed investment needed to achieve a given quality improvement such as shifting from 4G to 5G technology. This dynamic efficiency can bolster the longterm financial viability of a merged entity, thereby reinforcing its capacity to engage in quality competition.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了英国CMA对Vodafone与Three移动合并案的批准决定中的效率因素，并提出了一个竞争监管机构尚未明确承认的新效率类型：避免技术驱动市场中重复固定投资的效率。
AI.research_question: 移动通信市场合并中除了传统效率外，是否存在避免重复固定投资这一新型效率？
AI.motivation: 竞争监管机构在评估合并案时往往忽视技术驱动市场中避免重复固定投资的效率，这种效率对长期市场竞争有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态效率理论，特别是技术驱动市场中的固定投资效率理论。
AI.method: 案例分析，以英国CMA对Vodafone与Three合并案的批准决定为研究对象。
AI.findings: 合并可以通过整合基础设施减少实现技术升级（如4G到5G）所需的总体固定投资，这种动态效率能增强合并实体的长期财务可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"避免重复固定投资效率"这一新概念，丰富了合并效率分析的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争监管机构评估技术驱动市场的合并案提供了新的分析视角，有助于更全面地评估合并对长期市场竞争的影响。

title: Collective AI Creation: The Spiral Creation Model and Emergent Behavioral Patterns Based on the Singular Proposition
affiliations: Independent Researcher, South Korea

detail.title: Collective AI Creation: The Spiral Creation Model and Emergent Behavioral Patterns Based on the Singular Proposition
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Spiral Creation Model, a conceptual and methodological framework for collective AI creativity.
It reinterprets multi-agent collaboration as a temporal and spatial spiral of divergence, convergence, critique, and refinement, centered on a Singular Proposition that anchors the evolution of ideas.
Two guiding principles are proposed:

  • Refined Unpredictability, describing how meaningful novelty arises without randomness;

  • Spatial Compression, explaining how diverse perspectives integrate into coherent creative synthesis.
    By combining insights from design thinking, computational creativity, and collective intelligence theory, the model offers a theoretical foundation for understanding emergent creative behavior in distributed AI systems.
    The study contributes to ongoing debates in the philosophy of AI, cognitive architecture, and AI ethics, proposing a scalable blueprint for human-aligned collective intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了螺旋创造模型，这是一个用于集体AI创造力的概念和方法论框架，将多智能体协作重新解释为围绕单一命题展开的时空螺旋过程，包含发散、收敛、批判和精炼四个阶段。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个理论框架来理解和促进分布式AI系统中的集体创造力？
AI.motivation: 为理解多智能体协作中涌现的创造性行为提供理论基础，解决AI哲学、认知架构和AI伦理中的相关问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 螺旋创造模型，结合设计思维、计算创造力和集体智能理论的见解，包含两个指导原则：精炼不可预测性和空间压缩。
AI.method: 概念和方法论框架构建，通过重新解释多智能体协作为时空螺旋过程。
AI.findings: 提出了一个可扩展的蓝图，用于人类对齐的集体智能，能够解释有意义的新颖性如何在没有随机性的情况下产生，以及多样视角如何整合为连贯的创造性综合。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解分布式AI系统中的涌现创造性行为提供了理论基础，推进了AI哲学、认知架构和AI伦理领域的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可扩展的蓝图，用于实现人类对齐的集体智能系统。

title: Innovative Human Capital and Stock Returns: A Global Perspective
affiliations: University of Florida - Department of Economics, , National Tsing Hua University - Department of Quantitative Finance and HKU, Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Innovative Human Capital and Stock Returns: A Global Perspective
detail.abstract: We analyze the asset pricing implications of innovative human capital from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. Our model features a separation of R&D staff from regular manpower in the production of knowledge and the final good, and predicts expected stock returns to increase with firm-level human capital investment. Additionally, labor market frictions for talent strengthen the predictability of stock returns. We then match international stocks to U.S. patent records, and show that firms with higher inventor-to-employee ratios subsequently experience higher stock returns. Moreover, such a relation is stronger in countries with stronger patent protection that prohibits inventor mobility and increases corresponding adjustment costs.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论和实证角度分析创新人力资本的资产定价含义。研究发现企业人力资本投资与预期股票回报正相关，且在人才市场摩擦较大的国家中这种关系更强。
AI.research_question: 创新人力资本如何影响股票预期回报？人才市场摩擦如何调节这种关系？
AI.motivation: 理解人力资本在资产定价中的作用，特别是创新人力资本对企业价值的影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 将研发人员与普通劳动力分离的生产函数模型，考虑知识生产和最终产品生产两个环节
AI.method: 理论建模与实证分析相结合，将国际股票数据与美国专利记录匹配，使用发明人-员工比率作为人力资本投资代理变量
AI.findings: 发明人-员工比率较高的企业随后经历更高的股票回报；在专利保护更强的国家中这种关系更显著
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了包含创新人力资本分离的资产定价理论框架，揭示了人才市场摩擦对股票回报预测性的调节作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于人力资本投资的企业估值新视角，对跨国投资决策具有指导意义

title: Success factors for young Science and Technology Parks.
affiliations: Kingston University - School of Computer Science and Mathematics, Zayed University and Kingston University

detail.title: Success factors for young Science and Technology Parks.
detail.abstract: This paper presents some novel-seeming concepts derived from new data-driven approaches. An overview of studies on the organic growth of young start-up Science and Technology Parks (STP), using Big Data, econometric analyses, panel data and computer simulations is presented. Results and concepts derived from industrialised countries, notably Sweden and the UK, may well be applicable to some emerging economies. Results are of interest to technology entrepreneurs considering choosing a STP to inhabit, as well as those in the central team, specialising in management and enterprise development, including growing new Parks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大数据、计量经济学分析、面板数据和计算机模拟等方法，研究了年轻科技园区（STP）的有机增长模式，提出了新颖的概念，并探讨了这些概念从工业化国家（如瑞典和英国）向新兴经济体的适用性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过数据驱动方法理解科技园区的有机增长模式？这些模式是否适用于新兴经济体？
AI.motivation: 科技园区作为创新生态系统的重要组成部分，其有机增长模式对技术创业者和园区管理者具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新生态系统理论、园区发展理论和数据驱动决策理论。
AI.method: 采用大数据分析、计量经济学方法、面板数据分析和计算机模拟。
AI.findings: 从瑞典和英国等工业化国家的研究中得出了科技园区有机增长的新概念和模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于数据驱动的科技园区有机增长新概念，丰富了创新生态系统理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为技术创业者选择科技园区提供决策支持，为园区管理团队提供发展策略参考，特别是新兴经济体的园区建设。

title: Cross-Pressured Voters in Africa: Patterns of Loyalty, Defection, and Abstention
affiliations: Stellenbosch University

detail.title: Cross-Pressured Voters in Africa: Patterns of Loyalty, Defection, and Abstention
detail.abstract: Mainstream parties in Africa are increasingly struggling to maintain their base of support, which has traditionally been grounded in group loyalty. As a lens for exploring this changing electoral landscape, this article focuses on the growing segment of the electorate that is cross-pressured between identity orientation and progressive perceptions of economic performance. We employ a multinomial logistic regression to analyse data from Round 9 of the Afrobarometer survey. Consistent with previous studies, our results show that voting patterns in Africa reflect both identity orientations and economic-based calculus. Notably, the study finds that retrospective and prospective cross-pressures between identity and economic orientations promulgate disengagement rather than realignment or switching, which, in principle, structurally advantages ruling parties. In contrast, egocentric crosspressures neither switch nor exit the electorate; instead, they maintain loyalty to the ruling party, which we attribute to irreversible distributive benefits within narrower geographic constituencies. For robustness, we also present findings from Africa's five geographical regions. This study contributes to debates in comparative politics on the psychological underpinnings of electoral choice, shedding light on electoral alignment, realignment and dealignment.

AI.tldr: 非洲主流政党面临支持基础削弱问题，研究发现身份认同与经济表现的交叉压力导致选民脱离政治参与而非转换阵营，这在结构上有利于执政党。
AI.research_question: 非洲选民在身份认同与经济表现交叉压力下的投票行为模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 非洲主流政党传统上依赖群体忠诚的支持基础正在削弱，需要理解选民在身份认同与经济考量之间的复杂决策过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份认同理论、经济投票理论、交叉压力理论
AI.method: 使用Afrobarometer第9轮调查数据，采用多项逻辑回归分析
AI.findings: 身份与经济取向的回顾性和前瞻性交叉压力导致选民脱离政治参与而非阵营转换；自我中心交叉压力则维持对执政党的忠诚
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对选举选择心理基础的理解，阐明了选举结盟、重组和解盟的动态过程
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了执政党在选民交叉压力下的结构性优势，为政党策略制定提供参考

title: Strategies for Emerging Retailers Modelled on Amazon (Designing a Model for Survival and Success)
affiliations: Islamic Azad University, Istanbul Gelisim University and Islamic Azad University

detail.title: Strategies for Emerging Retailers Modelled on Amazon (Designing a Model for Survival and Success)

declarations.ethicsApproval: The article does not involve any studies with human participants or animals conducted by the authors.
declarations.funderStatement: We, the authors of this research, have not received any financial support from any organization or institution. We have decided to conduct this research solely based on our expertise and experience in the field of retailing, as well as relying on the latest information and relevant achievements in this field.

keywords: Survival and Success in Emerging Retails

detail.abstract: As one of the most successful global retailers, with the unique and innovative strategies that it uses, Amazon has become a suitable model for emerging retailers that seek survival and success. Considering the challenges of newly established Mixed and Omni-channel retail stores in UAE markets, this research seeks to provide a model for the survival and success of these businesses. Its purpose is to identify effective and proven Amazon strategies to strengthen the ability of these retailers to face competition and market challenges. To achieve this goal, a mixed research method has been used, which includes grounded theory in the qualitative part, and then, to evaluate the results obtained in the qualitative part, PLS software was used in a two-structure method in the quantitative part. The results show that retailers should have the ability to understand market sensing in order to identify the expectations and demands of stakeholders and customers and turn them into loyal stakeholders and customers. To achieve this goal, it is necessary to adopt strategies based on environmental factors and risks in the market. Finally, such strategies can help create competitive advantages and foster entrepreneurship in this area, which is very necessary and vital for the survival of these businesses and their success in the market. Also, according to the limitations, suggestions have been provided. In general, due to the lack of focused research in this field, this research can make a significant contribution to the survival and success of emerging retail stores.

AI.tldr: 本研究以亚马逊为成功模型，为阿联酋新兴混合和全渠道零售商提供生存和成功策略。研究发现零售商需要具备市场感知能力，识别利益相关者需求，并基于环境因素制定策略，从而创造竞争优势和促进创业精神。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和应用亚马逊的有效策略来增强新兴混合和全渠道零售商在阿联酋市场中的生存和成功能力？
AI.motivation: 新兴混合和全渠道零售商在阿联酋市场面临生存挑战，而亚马逊作为全球成功零售商提供了可借鉴的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扎根理论（定性部分）和PLS软件的两结构方法（定量部分）
AI.method: 混合研究方法，包括定性部分的扎根理论和定量部分的PLS软件分析
AI.findings: 零售商需要具备市场感知能力来识别利益相关者和客户需求，将其转化为忠诚客户；需要基于环境因素和风险制定策略；这些策略有助于创造竞争优势和促进创业精神。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了该领域缺乏针对性研究的空白，为新兴零售商的生存和成功提供了理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿联酋新兴混合和全渠道零售商提供了具体的生存和成功策略，帮助他们应对市场竞争和挑战。

detail.abstract: This technical report introduces the AI Leadership Readiness Framework (ALRF), a practical model for assessing organizational preparedness for responsible artificial intelligence adoption. Derived from doctoral research on transformational leadership and project success in multinational organizations, the framework defines five readiness dimensions: Vision & Strategy, Ethical Governance, Capability & Skills, Change Culture, and Performance Monitoring. The report supports executives, policymakers, and researchers seeking to align AI innovation with human-centred leadership and global ethical standards.

title: Revealing the abatement costs of soil erosion: a non-parametric cost function approach
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Revealing the abatement costs of soil erosion: a non-parametric cost function approach
detail.abstract: An effective design of environmental policies often requires knowledge about the pollution abatement costs (PAC) of the regulated entities, though PAC are usually unknown to the regulator. In this article, we propose a non-parametric cost function model that reveals firms’ cost of inputs assigned to pollution control and that shows how environmental regulations affect the optimal input-mix of firms. Our model is illustrated using data from 89 crop farms in Austria. We reveal farms’ costs associated with their participation in an agri-environmental scheme that provides payments for cover cropping and mulch or direct seeding aiming to reduce soil loss, as well as nutrient run-off in ground and surface water bodies. We find that the abatement of one ton of soil loss increases variable costs by 535 Euros, on average. Savings in fertilizer expenditures are off-set by increases in other cost components (e.g., labor, machinery and energy). Average (marginal) abatement costs decline from 1,552 Euros/t of soil loss (3,264 Euros/t) for farms located in environments with low erosion risk to 135 Euros/t of soil loss (262 Euro/t) for farms with moderate to serious erosion risk. The results suggest that the cost effectiveness of the program can be improved considerably by setting targeting criteria (e.g., soil erosion rates) for eligibility and allocation of funds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个非参数成本函数模型来揭示农场参与农业环境计划（覆盖作物和覆盖或直接播种）的污染减排成本。研究发现，平均每减少一吨土壤流失会增加535欧元的可变成本，且减排成本随侵蚀风险降低而显著下降。
AI.research_question: 如何揭示农场参与农业环境计划的污染减排成本？环境法规如何影响农场的最优投入组合？
AI.motivation: 环境政策设计需要了解受监管实体的污染减排成本，但这些成本通常不为监管者所知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数成本函数模型，用于揭示污染控制投入的成本。
AI.method: 使用奥地利89个作物农场的数据，分析参与农业环境计划（覆盖作物和覆盖或直接播种）的成本。
AI.findings: 平均每减少一吨土壤流失增加可变成本535欧元；肥料支出节省被其他成本（劳动力、机械和能源）增加所抵消；低侵蚀风险农场的平均（边际）减排成本为1,552欧元/吨（3,264欧元/吨），而中高侵蚀风险农场为135欧元/吨（262欧元/吨）。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了揭示污染减排成本的非参数成本函数模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明，通过设定目标标准（如土壤侵蚀率）来确定资格和资金分配，可以显著提高计划的成本效益。

title: The Hidden Costs of Regulating Digital Addiction: Evidence from the Game Restriction Policy in China
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management,  and Renmin University of China - School of Labor and Human Resources

detail.title: The Hidden Costs of Regulating Digital Addiction: Evidence from the Game Restriction Policy in China
detail.abstract: We document unintended social costs of regulating digital addiction and adaptive responses of firms. Exploiting the anti-addiction regulation for online games in China as a natural experiment, we find that the regulation reduces monthly downloads and estimated revenue of gaming Apps by 51% and 44%, respectively. As a response, regulated Apps switch their business models and rely 20% more on advertising revenues, and intentionally increase privacy-violating behaviors by 10%. Meanwhile, security vulnerabilities of Apps also increase by 6%. These adaptive responses are larger for Apps with higher share of minor users and smaller Apps who experience larger reduction in market size, and are larger on the dimension of adjustment that Apps specialize in. In addition, the regulation also lowers the satisfaction of consumers, and leads to fewer entry and more exit of regulated Apps.

AI.tldr: 中国网络游戏防沉迷监管产生了意外社会成本：游戏App下载量和收入分别下降51%和44%，作为应对，App转向更多依赖广告收入（增加20%），并故意增加侵犯隐私行为（10%）和安全漏洞（6%）。这些适应性反应在未成年人用户比例高的App和受市场规模缩减影响更大的小型App中更为明显。
AI.research_question: 数字成瘾监管会产生哪些意外社会成本？企业如何适应性应对？
AI.motivation: 研究数字成瘾监管的意外后果和企业应对策略，为政策制定提供更全面的视角
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管经济学、企业适应性行为理论、数字平台商业模式理论
AI.method: 利用中国网络游戏防沉迷监管作为自然实验，采用实证分析方法
AI.findings: 监管导致游戏App下载量下降51%，收入下降44%；App转向更多广告收入（+20%），增加隐私侵犯行为（+10%）和安全漏洞（+6%）；消费者满意度下降，市场进入减少退出增加
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了监管的意外社会成本，拓展了企业适应性行为理论在数字平台的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供监管设计建议，帮助企业更好应对监管环境变化

title: Stringency of Family Firms and Owner-managers in the Transition to Low-carbon Emissions
affiliations: INSEAD - Economics and Political Sciences, Old Dominion University - Strome College of Business and University of Groningen - Faculty of Economics and Business

detail.title: Stringency of Family Firms and Owner-managers in the Transition to Low-carbon Emissions
detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between carbon emissions and stock returns, with a focus on the role of family ownership and management. Using a sample of 435 publicly listed firms from 14 Western European countries between 2010 and 2020, we investigate whether family-controlled firms—particularly those led by family-member CEOs—are perceived differently by financial markets. Consistent with the existing literature, we find that firms with higher emissions earn higher stock returns but experience lower market valuations, reflecting a carbon risk premium because of a higher carbon transition risk. Importantly, our results show that family firms managed by family CEOs face significantly higher carbon-transition risk and valuation penalties compared to both non-family firms and family firms led by professional CEOs. This differential is particularly pronounced after the 2015 Paris Agreement, which heightened investor awareness of climate risks. This evidence suggests that investors lack confidence in the management of carbon transition risk within family firms managed by family CEOs. We attribute these findings to weaker governance, lower institutional oversight, and control-driven decision-making in family-managed firms. This study contributes to understanding how ownership structures influence corporate responses to environmental pressures and highlights the financial implications of delayed climate action in family-controlled businesses.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了碳排放与股票回报的关系，重点关注家族所有权和管理的作用。研究发现家族企业特别是由家族成员CEO管理的企业面临更高的碳转型风险和市场估值惩罚，这归因于较弱的治理结构和控制导向的决策。
AI.research_question: 家族控制的企业，特别是由家族成员CEO管理的企业，是否在金融市场上对碳排放风险有不同的反应？
AI.motivation: 了解所有权结构如何影响企业对环境压力的反应，以及家族控制企业在气候行动延迟方面的财务影响。

title: From Risk to Action: How Perceived Risks and Cultural Dynamics Drive Surplus Food Purchases in China and Spain
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Risk to Action: How Perceived Risks and Cultural Dynamics Drive Surplus Food Purchases in China and Spain
detail.abstract: Surplus food retailing reduces waste and supports food security; however, cultural differences critically shape consumer behavior. Combining the theory of planned behavior and risk theory, this study compares drivers and barriers of purchase intentions for surplus food in China (n = 695) and Spain (n = 535) using multi-group analysis combined with necessary condition analysis. The results highlight that Chinese consumers’ intentions rely on perceived behavioral control (enabled by e-commerce and policies), personal norms, and attitudes, whereas Spanish intentions hinge on physical, performance, and financial risk perceptions, with no significant behavioral control effects. The findings challenge one-size-fits-all approaches to food waste reduction, proposing an actionable framework in which China prioritizes digital infrastructure and norm-based campaigns, while Spain targets risk-transparent labeling and trust-building. This study advances resource-efficient food systems by prioritizing contextual drivers, offering policymakers a roadmap to align surplus food strategies with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.

title: From Principle to Practice: How Sustainability Is Made Measurable in Safe and Sustainable by Design
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Principle to Practice: How Sustainability Is Made Measurable in Safe and Sustainable by Design
detail.abstract: What does sustainability mean when it must be made measurable? Within the European Commission’s Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, sustainability is framed as a central objective; yet its meaning remains open, contested, and in need of clarification. This paper reconstructs how sustainability is defined within the SSbD-related literature by developing a qualitative indicator set through an immanent critique. Based on a systematic literature review and subsequent refinements, 108 yes/no indicators were identified, spanning environmental, social, and economic dimensions, and structured to reflect both product- and company-specific considerations across different life-cycle stages. The development process itself became a means of interrogating the concept of sustainability. The resulting indicator architecture reveals an implicit understanding of sustainability as a multi-scalar and procedural concept, driven by principles such as harm minimization, resource efficiency, and organizational governance. A concept that carries inherent tensions and divergent interpretations, depending on the object or system deemed to become sustainable.

title: Carbon Offsets and Information Requests: A Field Experiment with Gas Station Visitors
affiliations: University of Groningen, University of Groningen and University of Groningen

detail.title: Carbon Offsets and Information Requests: A Field Experiment with Gas Station Visitors
detail.abstract: We document gas station visitors’ awareness of the carbon footprint cost of their fuel purchases and their willingness to offset this cost by donating to a reforestation offset program. Using on-site pump displays, we experimentally vary how consumers receive information about the true carbon offset cost to test which factors impact information demand and how this information in turn influences pledged donations. In one treatment the information is automatically provided. In three other treatments consumers can request it, and we test whether monetary incentives or social nudges change the demand for information.We find that virtually all visitors (94.9%) severely overestimate the cost of offsetting the carbon emissions of their fuel transaction by about a factor five. Donations strongly correlate with consumer beliefs: A one euro increase in estimated costs increases pledged donations with about 0.65 euro. Information on the true offset cost has no impact on pledged donations. When it is not provided, consumers hardly request it. Monetary incentives or social nudges do not change the demand for information. Only 1.2% of consumers follow through and transfer the pledged donation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现加油站消费者严重高估碳抵消成本约5倍，捐赠意愿与错误信念相关，但提供真实成本信息并不影响捐赠行为，消费者几乎不主动获取信息，且最终兑现捐赠的比例极低。
AI.research_question: 消费者对燃料购买碳足迹成本的认知程度如何？哪些因素影响他们获取碳抵消成本信息的意愿？这些信息如何影响他们的捐赠承诺？

AI.method: 现场实验，通过加油站泵显示器提供碳抵消成本信息，设置自动提供、请求获取（含货币激励和社会助推）等不同处理组
AI.findings: 94.9%的消费者严重高估碳抵消成本约5倍；捐赠金额与错误信念强相关；真实成本信息不影响捐赠；消费者几乎不主动获取信息；货币激励和社会助推无效；仅1.2%兑现捐赠承诺

title: From Words to Orders: Event-Contrastive Embeddings, Meta-Labels, and Intraday Cost-Aware Execution
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Words to Orders: Event-Contrastive Embeddings, Meta-Labels, and Intraday Cost-Aware Execution

keywords: European and path-dependent options. JEL classification. C02

detail.abstract: We test whether event-specific contrastive embeddings of SEC and earnings disclosures, combined with explicit meta-labeling for trade gating and sizing and intraday cost-aware execution (TWAP/VWAP/POV/Almgren-Chriss), improve out-of-sample performance over a TF-IDF baseline under strict time-based evaluation. Our pipeline trains an event-contrastive encoder (InfoNCE), applies walk-forward calibration (Platt or isotonic), and routes gated signals through execution policies with realistic costs (spread and participation impact). We evaluate monthly information coefficients (IC), probabilistic accuracy (log-loss, Brier, reliability), and net portfolio metrics (CAGR, Sharpe, max drawdown) on a holdout window. Initial results indicate more stable calibration and competitive IC relative to TF-IDF, with positive net performance under conservative cost assumptions. Dependence-aware significance (Reality Check / SPA) will be reported after extending the net-return window.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了SEC和财报披露的事件特定对比嵌入方法，结合元标签交易门控和规模调整以及日内成本感知执行策略，在严格时间评估下相比TF-IDF基线的样本外表现提升。结果显示更稳定的校准和竞争力的信息系数，在保守成本假设下获得正向净收益。
AI.research_question: 事件特定的对比嵌入结合元标签交易门控和成本感知执行策略是否能提升样本外表现？
AI.motivation: 传统TF-IDF方法在金融文本分析中可能存在局限性，需要更先进的嵌入技术和交易执行策略来提升投资组合表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件对比学习(InfoNCE)、概率校准(Platt/等渗回归)、交易执行理论(TWAP/VWAP/POV/Almgren-Chriss)

AI.findings: 相比TF-IDF基线，获得了更稳定的校准和竞争力的信息系数，在保守成本假设下实现正向净表现
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合事件对比嵌入和元标签交易门控的框架，改进了金融文本分析中的信号提取和交易执行
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化投资提供了更稳健的文本分析管道，能够在考虑交易成本的情况下实现正向收益

title: German Inflation-Linked Bonds: ​Overpriced, yet Undervalued
affiliations: Banque de France, FRB of San Francisco - Financial Research and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: German Inflation-Linked Bonds: ​Overpriced, yet Undervalued
detail.abstract: We document that German inflation-linked government bond yields contain a convenience or safety premium averaging 0.33 percent. Despite that, the German Federal Finance Agency decided to cease all future issuance of these bonds in November 2023. We examine the market response to this announcement and find that neither the safety premia nor the trading conditions of these bonds have been negatively impacted. Hence, this bond market remains a rich source of information on real rates in the euro area in addition to offering investors a safe inflation-protected asset.

AI.tldr: 德国通胀挂钩政府债券收益率包含平均0.33%的便利性或安全性溢价。尽管存在这一溢价，德国联邦金融署仍决定在2023年11月停止发行此类债券。研究发现这一决定并未对安全性溢价或交易条件产生负面影响，该债券市场仍是欧元区实际利率的重要信息来源。

AI.motivation: 理解德国联邦金融署停止发行通胀挂钩债券的决定对市场安全溢价和交易条件的影响，评估该债券市场作为欧元区实际利率信息来源的持续价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债券市场便利性溢价理论、安全性溢价理论、市场效率理论
AI.method: 事件研究法，分析公告发布前后的市场反应数据

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供决策参考，为投资者确认通胀挂钩债券的持续投资价值

title: Structural challenges of synthetic ETFs domiciled in Europe
affiliations: University of Melbourne - Trinity College and University of Melbourne - Trinity College

detail.title: Structural challenges of synthetic ETFs domiciled in Europe
detail.abstract: This paper examines the advantages and challenges of synthetic Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) in Europe amid rising index customisation and sustainable investing. Synthetic ETFs, which replicate indices via total return swaps, offer cost benefits for smaller providers but raise concerns about counterparty risk and collateral composition. Our analysis confirms that synthetic ETFs are generally more cost-efficient than physical ETFs. While tracking customised indices increases costs for both types, sustainability-oriented indices do not add further costs. Overall, synthetic ETFs’ cost-efficiency can offset the additional expenses of tracking niche or sustainability-linked indices, supporting trends in financial innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧洲合成ETF在指数定制化和可持续投资趋势下的优势与挑战。合成ETF通过总收益互换复制指数，为小型提供商提供成本优势，但存在交易对手风险和抵押品构成问题。研究发现合成ETF通常比实物ETF更具成本效益，跟踪定制指数会增加成本，但可持续指数不会增加额外成本。
AI.research_question: 合成ETF在欧洲市场中的成本效益如何？与实物ETF相比，在跟踪定制指数和可持续指数时的成本差异是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着指数定制化和可持续投资的兴起，了解合成ETF的成本效益对于支持金融创新趋势具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ETF结构理论、交易对手风险管理理论和成本效益分析框架。
AI.method: 比较分析合成ETF与实物ETF的成本结构，特别关注跟踪定制指数和可持续指数时的成本差异。
AI.findings: 1. 合成ETF通常比实物ETF更具成本效益；2. 跟踪定制指数会增加两种ETF的成本；3. 可持续导向指数不会增加额外成本；4. 合成ETF的成本效益可以抵消跟踪利基或可持续相关指数的额外费用。

AI.practical_contributions: 为ETF提供商，特别是小型提供商，在选择ETF结构时提供决策参考；支持可持续投资和指数定制化趋势的发展；帮助投资者更好地理解不同类型ETF的风险收益特征。

title: Decoupling Sovereignty from Sanctity: A Viability Assessment of an International Regime for Jerusalem's Holy Esplanade
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Decoupling Sovereignty from Sanctity: A Viability Assessment of an International Regime for Jerusalem's Holy Esplanade
detail.abstract: Current frameworks for an Israeli-Palestinian resolution consistently fail at the nexus of national sovereignty and religious sanctity in Jerusalem. This policy brief conducts a viability assessment of a "Two States, One Holy Esplanade" model. We assess that decoupling these issues by establishing a sovereign-neutral, international authority for the Temple Mount/Haram al-Sharif is the only feasible mechanism to break the political deadlock. This model presents a manageable risk with a high potential payoff: unlocking viable two-state negotiations by transforming Jerusalem from a zero-sum asset into a shared, globally managed responsibility.

title: Driving Impact? How Imperfect Substitution Shapes Heterogeneous Rebound in Carsharing
affiliations: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, ESCP Business School, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Ben-Gurion University of the Negev

detail.title: Driving Impact? How Imperfect Substitution Shapes Heterogeneous Rebound in Carsharing
detail.abstract: Technologies and social innovations such as carsharing are commonly promoted as pathways to lower environmental impacts through efficiency gains. Yet rebound effects, denoting how behavioral or economic responses can offset efficiency improvements, can erode these benefits. Most rebound studies assume perfect substitution, where a new service displaces a single incumbent product on a one-to-one basis. While analytically convenient, this overlooks real-world complexity and consumer heterogeneity. Using survey data from nearly 4,500 Belgian carsharing users, we compare rebound estimates under perfect substitution with those based on reported shifts in transport modes. Under the perfect substitution assumption, we find a 56% rebound effect. When accounting for imperfect substitution, however, rebound effects vary widely across users. Median effects remain positive (20%–46%), but individual outcomes range from major net benefits to strong rebound (5th–95th percentile: –651% to 181%). A cluster analysis further reveals distinct user groups with systematically different impacts, underscoring that substitution patterns vary not only in scale but also in direction. These findings suggest that carsharing’s environmental impact is highly user-dependent and cannot be captured by a single average estimate. Incorporating imperfect substitution into rebound analysis is therefore critical for both advancing theory and designing more targeted and effective policy interventions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对比完美替代假设和不完美替代假设下的回弹效应，发现汽车共享的环境影响高度依赖用户行为，不能仅用单一平均值来评估。
AI.research_question: 汽车共享服务在考虑不完美替代时的回弹效应如何？与完美替代假设下的结果有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有回弹效应研究通常假设完美替代，即新服务一对一替代现有产品，这忽视了现实世界的复杂性和消费者异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 回弹效应理论、消费者行为理论、替代理论
AI.method: 使用来自近4,500名比利时汽车共享用户的调查数据，比较完美替代假设和基于报告交通方式转变的不完美替代假设下的回弹效应估计。
AI.findings: 在完美替代假设下，回弹效应为56%；但在不完美替代下，回弹效应在用户间差异很大，中位数为20%-46%，个体结果从主要净收益到强回弹效应不等（5%-95%分位数：-651%至181%）。聚类分析显示不同用户群体具有系统性不同的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不完美替代纳入回弹效应分析，推进了回弹效应理论的发展，强调了消费者异质性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计更有针对性和有效的政策干预提供了依据，表明汽车共享的环境影响高度用户依赖，不能仅用单一平均值评估。

title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Healthcare Taxation: Enhancing Accuracy, Compliance, and Explainability in a Complex Regulatory Ecosystem
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Healthcare Taxation: Enhancing Accuracy, Compliance, and Explainability in a Complex Regulatory Ecosystem
detail.abstract: Healthcare taxation presents one of the most complex regulatory landscapes in the United States. Fragmented tax codes, multi-jurisdictional billing requirements, exemptions for specific medical devices, and cross-state digital health delivery models compound compliance challenges for healthcare providers and payers. Traditional AI systems can detect anomalies within financial and billing data, but their inability to offer transparent, rule-based explanations limits their usability in regulatory or audit environments. This paper proposes a Neuro-Symbolic AI framework that integrates the pattern recognition strengths of deep neural networks with the reasoning capabilities of symbolic logic engines. The result is an explainable, transparent, and audit-ready system capable of improving tax accuracy, reducing compliance risk, and supporting evidence-based financial decision-making in healthcare organizations.

title: Do Foreign AI Identity Laws Conflict With India’s Personality Rights Framework? Evaluating The Guernsey, No Fakes, Elvis, And Eu AI Act Models

detail.title: Do Foreign AI Identity Laws Conflict With India’s Personality Rights Framework? Evaluating The Guernsey, No Fakes, Elvis, And Eu AI Act Models
detail.abstract: This study examines the legal challenges AI-generated digital replicas pose to personality rights within India’s fragmented legal system. It critiques scholarly support for adopting foreign proprietary models like Guernsey’s identity-as-property regime, which conflict with India’s constitutional guarantees and create administrative burdens. Using doctrinal analysis of Indian IP laws, judicial precedents, and international frameworks (NO FAKES Act, ELVIS Act, EU AI Act), the study concludes that foreign property-based models are normatively incompatible and impractical for India.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了AI生成数字复制品对印度人格权带来的法律挑战，批判了采纳外国财产权模式（如根西岛身份即财产制度）的学术观点，认为这些模式与印度宪法保障相冲突且不实用。
AI.research_question: AI生成的数字复制品在印度分散的法律体系中对人格权构成哪些法律挑战？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的发展，数字复制品对人格权的威胁日益突出，而印度现有的法律体系对此缺乏明确规制，需要探讨适合印度国情的解决方案。

AI.method: 对印度知识产权法、司法判例以及国际框架（NO FAKES法案、ELVIS法案、欧盟AI法案）进行教义分析

AI.theory_contributions: 批判了将外国财产权模式应用于印度的学术观点，提出了基于印度宪法保障的人格权保护路径

title: Forsake Of Law Satire And Fair Use Vis À Vis Oh, Pretty Woman Dilemma
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Forsake Of Law Satire And Fair Use Vis À Vis Oh, Pretty Woman Dilemma
detail.abstract: Satire has long stimulated critical thinking and provided entertainment, yet its legal protection remains contentious. Copyright holders often sue satirical creators, claiming infringement, with varying success. Courts distinguish parody from satire, granting parody fair use protection while often denying the same to satire. This distinction undermines the Fair Use Doctrine, which balances the rights of copyright holders with the public benefit of intellectual stimulation and criticism. Key legal cases, like the one involving a parody of Roy Orbison's "Oh, Pretty Woman," highlight the transformative nature of parody and its minimal market impact, suggesting it qualifies for fair use. However, similar protections should extend to satire, as it also serves distinct market functions and promotes public discourse. In India, the implications of fair use for satire remain underexplored, but aligning with global interpretations could foster a more balanced and creative environment. Courts should reconsider the exclusion of satire from fair use to better align with the objectives of copyright law.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了讽刺作品的法律保护问题，指出法院通常区分戏仿和讽刺，只给予戏仿合理使用保护，而拒绝给予讽刺同样的保护。作者认为这种区分削弱了合理使用原则，主张讽刺也应获得合理使用保护，以促进公共讨论和创意环境。
AI.research_question: 讽刺作品是否应该获得与戏仿同等的合理使用法律保护？
AI.motivation: 讽刺长期以来激发批判性思维并提供娱乐，但其法律保护仍然存在争议。版权持有者经常起诉讽刺创作者，声称侵权，但成功率不一。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合理使用原则、版权法的平衡原则、戏仿与讽刺的法律区分理论
AI.method: 法律案例分析，包括Roy Orbison的"Oh, Pretty Woman"戏仿案等关键案例研究
AI.findings: 法院区分戏仿和讽刺，给予戏仿合理使用保护但拒绝给予讽刺同样的保护。这种区分削弱了合理使用原则，忽视了讽刺的独特市场功能和促进公共讨论的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了戏仿与讽刺的法律区分，主张扩大合理使用原则的适用范围，为讽刺作品提供更充分的理论保护基础
AI.practical_contributions: 建议法院重新考虑将讽刺排除在合理使用之外的做法，促进更平衡和创造性的环境，特别是在印度等尚未充分探索讽刺合理使用的司法管辖区

title: BKK Meets Romer: International Business Cycles in a Knowledge Economy
affiliations: , Hong Kong Baptist University and Michigan State University

detail.title: BKK Meets Romer: International Business Cycles in a Knowledge Economy
detail.abstract: Innovation, technology adoption, and international knowledge spillovers are key to understanding medium-run international business cycles. Empirically, we merge multi-country data on trade, patent stocks, and citation networks to document three key facts: (i) trade strengthens international GDP and TFP comovement; (ii) knowledge spillovers occur through trade and follow the global citation network; (iii) medium-run output fluctuations are driven mostly by the diffusion and adoption of technologies than by immediate innovations. We develop an international real business cycle model that embeds endogenous innovation, gradual technology adoption, and cross-border knowledge diffusion. Our quantitative model reveals that transitory trade shocks can lead to persistent GDP responses through their interaction with the endogenous dynamics of adoption and knowledge diffusion. These results show that innovation and diffusion dynamics amplify the transmission of transitory trade shocks, transforming them into persistent medium-run business cycle fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证分析和理论建模发现，国际贸易通过知识溢出和技术扩散机制，能够将暂时的贸易冲击转化为持续的中期经济周期波动。创新和扩散动态放大了贸易冲击的传导效应。

title: Religious Fire, Human Imprint: Millennium Black Carbon Record on the Northeastern Tibetan Plateau

detail.title: Religious Fire, Human Imprint: Millennium Black Carbon Record on the Northeastern Tibetan Plateau
detail.abstract: The ecological environment of the Tibetan Plateau, known as the “Third Pole of the Earth”, is extremely sensitive and fragile. With rapid societal development, environmental problems on the Tibetan Plateau have become prominent, as it is downwind of the emission sources from densely populated areas in the Middle East and South Asia, and the plateau has become one of the regions significantly affected by transboundary pollutant transmission (including black carbon, BC). The Tibetan Plateau has a long history of life and religious sacrifices, including aromatic plant-burning, which were recorded in the geologic record; therefore, BC can be used as a potential indicator to study the changes in religious activities.
