title: Optimizing Retail Distribution using a Normalized Grid Framework. A Case Study in Bangladesh
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Optimizing Retail Distribution using a Normalized Grid Framework. A Case Study in Bangladesh

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research is an independent analytical case study using aggregated, anonymized operational data. No personally identifiable information or confidential commercial data is disclosed. The analysis complies with ethical research and data-handling standards.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical review and approval were waived for this study as it involved only aggregated, non-personal, and non-sensitive operational data with no human or customer identifiers.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no external funding for this research.

detail.abstract:
This case study examines the design, implementation, and evaluation of a normalized, grid-based geo-spatial distribution model for optimizing telecom retail and assist channel operations in Bangladesh. Leveraging satellite imagery, machine learning-assisted population mapping, and integrated retail/assist planning, the model addresses systemic inefficiencies in Gross Add (GA) acquisition, Point-of-Sale (POS) deployment, and field force routing. The methodology includes the creation of hexagonal around 1×1 km normalized grids aligned to administrative unions, Go/No-Go grid classification using population, POI, and site proximity criteria, and channel-specific deployment strategies for Retail-Dominant, Assist-Dominant, and Mixed grids.
Pilot implementations in northern and north eastern regions demonstrated measurable improvements in GA retention and POS coverage, with GA quality found to decline significantly when activations occur beyond 1 km from existing sites or retail points. Additionally, the integration of predictive low-balance intervention models reduced at-risk POS by over one-third, safeguarding network value. Territory realignment yielded reduced travel distances and increased productive visits for Distribution Sales Representatives (DSRs).
The findings confirm that combining spatial analytics, differentiated channel strategies, and predictive interventions within a structured grid framework delivers both commercial and operational value. The approach offers a replicable blueprint for distribution optimization in similar emerging-market contexts and provides a bridge between academic spatial planning theory and practical business execution.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个标准化的网格化地理空间分布模型，通过卫星影像、机器学习人口映射和零售/辅助渠道整合规划，优化孟加拉国电信零售和辅助渠道运营。模型在试点区域显著改善了用户获取质量、POS覆盖率和销售代表效率。

AI.theoretical_framework: 空间规划理论、地理空间分析、渠道管理理论
AI.method: 创建1×1公里标准化六边形网格，基于人口、POI和站点邻近度的网格分类，针对零售主导、辅助主导和混合网格制定差异化渠道策略
AI.findings: 激活点距离现有站点或零售点超过1公里时用户获取质量显著下降；预测性低余额干预模型使风险POS减少三分之一；区域重新划分减少了旅行距离并提高了生产性访问
AI.theory_contributions: 将学术空间规划理论与实际业务执行相结合，提供了结构化网格框架下的空间分析、差异化渠道策略和预测性干预整合方法

AI.tldr: 本文分析尼泊尔对金砖国家的立场，探讨与成员国合作情况以及加德满都更深入参与该组织的潜力。
AI.research_question: 尼泊尔对金砖国家的立场是什么？与成员国合作现状如何？尼泊尔更深入参与金砖组织的潜力有多大？

AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论、地缘政治分析、多边合作机制理论
AI.method: 文献分析、政策文件研究、双边关系评估
AI.findings: 尼泊尔对金砖国家持积极态度，与成员国保持良好合作关系，具备进一步深化参与的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了小国与新兴多边组织关系的研究，为理解南亚国家外交政策选择提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔政府制定对金砖政策提供参考，促进尼泊尔与金砖国家的务实合作。

title: Selling to Yourself: Continuation Funds in Private Equity
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business, University of British Columbia (UBC) - Division of Finance, University of Notre Dame - Department of Finance, Stanford University - Graduate School of Business and Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Finance

detail.title: Selling to Yourself: Continuation Funds in Private Equity
detail.abstract:
Continuation funds (CFs) are private equity structures in which a manager raises a new fund to purchase assets from their existing fund. This structure has surged in popularity, from five funds in 2018 to 130 in 2024. We use a hand-collected sample of 472 CFs to test a model in which heterogeneous preferences drive CFs. Consistent with the model’s predictions, CFs emerge when LPs are more heterogeneous and managers have earned carried interest that they can roll. LPs typically choose to exit rather than invest, with this decision driven by both LP-level frictions and time varying LP liquidity demands.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了私募股权中的延续基金现象，发现当有限合伙人偏好异质性较高且基金经理已获得可滚存附带权益时，更可能设立延续基金。有限合伙人通常选择退出而非继续投资，这一决策受LP层面的摩擦和流动性需求影响。
AI.research_question: 什么因素驱动了私募股权延续基金的设立？有限合伙人如何决定是否参与延续基金投资？
AI.motivation: 延续基金从2018年的5只激增至2024年的130只，这种结构的流行需要理论解释和实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质性偏好理论，认为LP的差异化投资偏好和流动性需求是延续基金出现的关键驱动因素。
AI.method: 使用手工收集的472个延续基金样本，检验异质性偏好驱动模型。
AI.findings: 延续基金在LP偏好异质性较高且基金经理已获得可滚存附带权益时更可能出现；LP通常选择退出而非继续投资，决策受LP层面摩擦和时变流动性需求影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为延续基金现象提供了基于异质性偏好的理论解释框架，深化了对私募股权基金结构创新的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基金经理和有限合伙人提供了关于延续基金设立条件和投资决策的实证依据，有助于优化基金管理和投资策略。

title: A Note on Factors Influencing Trust in Government
affiliations: Stanford University, Stanford University and Stanford University

detail.title: A Note on Factors Influencing Trust in Government
detail.abstract:
Responses to surveys eliciting evaluations of trust in government, both generally and in specific areas, have varied over time and across countries. Using consistent survey data for 34 OECD countries from 2007-2023, we estimate a model of factors determining levels of trust. We employ a series of econometric techniques of increasing sophistication. The level and growth rate of real income per capita, social spending per capita, the degree of decentralization, and economic freedom all exert positive effects on trust. Inflation, unemployment, and debt per capita negatively affect trust. Additionally, higher levels of human capital and the elderly share of the population negatively affect trust. In the context of trust in government, the estimates suggest a heavier weight on inflation than on unemployment when compared to Okun’s misery index, which weights them equally. Additionally, the estimates are used to evaluate combinations of policies, e.g. debt-financed increases in social spending that affect inflation and/or unemployment, to determine the net effect on trust in government.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2007-2023年34个OECD国家的调查数据，通过计量经济学方法分析影响政府信任度的因素。研究发现人均实际收入、社会支出、分权程度和经济自由对政府信任有正向影响，而通胀、失业、债务、人力资本和老年人口比例则有负向影响。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素决定了OECD国家民众对政府的信任度？
AI.motivation: 不同国家和时期对政府信任度的调查结果存在显著差异，需要系统分析影响政府信任的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治经济学和公共选择理论，结合宏观经济变量与制度因素对政府信任的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2007-2023年34个OECD国家的调查数据，采用逐步复杂的计量经济学技术进行估计。
AI.findings: 人均实际收入、社会支出、分权程度和经济自由正向影响信任；通胀、失业、债务、人力资本和老年人口比例负向影响信任；通胀对信任的负面影响比失业更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了政府信任决定因素的理论框架，揭示了通胀相对于失业在影响政府信任中的不对称权重。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估政策组合（如债务融资的社会支出增加）对政府信任净影响的实用工具。

title: Leniency Designs: An Operator’s Manual
affiliations: Yale School of Management, Brown University and Princeton University

detail.title: Leniency Designs: An Operator’s Manual
detail.abstract:
We develop a step-by-step guide to leniency (a.k.a. judge or examiner instrument) designs, drawing on recent econometric literatures. The unbiased jackknife instrumental variables estimator (UJIVE) is purpose-built for leveraging exogenous leniency variation, avoiding subtle biases even in the presence of many decision-makers or controls. We show how UJIVE can also be used to assess key assumptions underlying leniency designs, including quasi-random assignment and average first-stage monotonicity, and to probe the external validity of treatment effect estimates. We further discuss statistical inference, arguing that non-clustered standard errors are often appropriate. A reanalysis of Farre-Mensa et al. (2020), using quasi-random examiner assignment to estimate the value of patents to startups, illustrates our checklist.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个关于宽恕设计（法官或审查员工具）的分步指南，基于最新计量经济学文献。介绍了无偏折刀工具变量估计器（UJIVE）及其在宽恕设计中的应用，包括假设检验和统计推断。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和实施有效的宽恕设计（leniency design）来利用外生宽恕变异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏关于宽恕设计实施的系统指南，需要明确的方法论来避免偏差并验证关键假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工具变量方法，特别是无偏折刀工具变量估计器（UJIVE）的理论框架，强调准随机分配和平均第一阶段单调性假设。
AI.method: 开发分步指南，使用UJIVE进行估计和假设检验，包括对Farre-Mensa等人（2020）研究的重新分析作为实证示例。
AI.findings: UJIVE能够有效利用外生宽恕变异，避免细微偏差，并能检验关键假设和评估处理效应估计的外部有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为宽恕设计提供了系统的方法论框架，扩展了工具变量方法在准实验设计中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了实施宽恕设计的实用指南，包括统计推断建议和假设检验方法。

title: The Race Between Asset Supply and Asset Demand
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Economics, University of Minnesota - Minneapolis, Northwestern University and Harvard University

detail.title: The Race Between Asset Supply and Asset Demand
detail.abstract:
We introduce an asset supply-and-demand approach to analyze the trajectory of US aggregate wealth, real interest rates, and fiscal sustainability. Our framework uses micro-founded and easy-to-implement sufficient statistics to quantify how shifts in demographics, inequality, and other forces affect asset market equilibrium. From 1950 to the present, rapid population aging, rising income inequality, increasing foreign demand for US assets, and declining productivity growth all contributed to a surge in asset demand. Asset supply initially fell, then turned around sharply, mainly driven by increases in government debt and the value of capitalized profits. Overall, asset demand won the race, and interest rates fell. Looking ahead to 2100, population aging will continue to strongly push up asset demand, but at current tax and benefit levels, asset supply will win the race, as rising entitlement costs push up government debt even more. While rising asset demand creates space for debt to eventually reach 250% of GDP without higher interest rates, stabilizing debt at any level requires a permanent fiscal adjustment of at least 10% of GDP.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个资产供需框架来分析美国财富、实际利率和财政可持续性。研究发现1950年至今资产需求增长快于供给，导致利率下降；展望2100年，在现行政策下资产供给将超过需求，政府债务可能达到GDP的250%，需要至少10%GDP的永久性财政调整来稳定债务。
AI.research_question: 人口老龄化、收入不平等、外国资产需求变化等因素如何通过资产供需机制影响美国财富积累、实际利率和财政可持续性？
AI.motivation: 理解长期财富积累、利率趋势和财政可持续性的驱动因素，为政策制定提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产供需均衡框架，基于微观基础的充分统计量方法。
AI.method: 使用充分统计量量化人口结构、收入分配、外国需求等因素对资产市场均衡的影响，分析1950-2100年的历史趋势和未来预测。
AI.findings: 1950年至今资产需求增长快于供给导致利率下降；未来在现行政策下资产供给将超过需求，政府债务可能达到GDP的250%。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了分析财富积累和财政可持续性的资产供需框架，提供了量化分析长期经济趋势的新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估财政可持续性的工具，指出需要至少10%GDP的永久性财政调整来稳定债务水平。

title: Financial Reporting Quality during a Crisis: A Systematic Review
affiliations: School of Business, The University of Notre Dame Australia

detail.title: Financial Reporting Quality during a Crisis: A Systematic Review
detail.abstract:
Purpose-This paper presents a systematic literature review, including content and bibliometric analyses, of the impact of a crisis on financial reporting quality. In addition, this review identifies emerging research themes and provides future directions. 

Design/methodology/approach-The adopted systematic literature review approach finds 29 highly cited articles on the effect of a crisis on financial reporting quality, with an additional seven studies for analysis identified in a review of emerging literature. 

Findings-This study consolidates prior research findings on financial reporting quality during a crisis under four major themes: (i) earnings quality and its determinants; (ii) audit quality around a crisis; (iii) conservatism, valuation effects and corporate governance; and (iv) financial stability and regulations. Mixed and inconclusive findings are documented for most themes, suggesting that this literature is still in its infancy and there is room for further theoretical refinement. 

Originality-To the best of the author's knowledge, this is the first study to systematically review and synthesise prior research findings on the quality of financial reporting during economic crises. The study identifies many unexplored research areas regarding crises, with possible direct implications for financial reporting practices. The impact of these issues needs to be carefully considered and understood, with the current coronavirus pandemic demonstrating that firms have the opportunity to compromise ethical aspects of their decisions as they experience pressure to maximise profits. 

Implications-The study's findings potentially have important ramifications for managers, standard setters, government regulators and policymakers. By highlighting examples of changes in firms' reporting practices during a crisis, the study provides a context in which to understand the influence or potential influence of the current coronavirus pandemic on firms' financial reporting practices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述，分析了危机对财务报告质量的影响，识别了四个主要研究主题，并指出该领域研究尚不成熟，存在混合和不确定的发现。
AI.research_question: 危机如何影响财务报告质量？
AI.motivation: 系统梳理危机对财务报告质量影响的研究现状，识别新兴研究主题并为未来研究提供方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务报告质量理论框架，包括盈余质量、审计质量、稳健性、公司治理等维度。
AI.method: 系统文献综述方法，包括内容分析和文献计量分析，共分析了36篇相关研究。
AI.findings: 将危机期间财务报告质量研究归纳为四个主题：(1)盈余质量及其决定因素；(2)危机期间的审计质量；(3)稳健性、估值效应和公司治理；(4)财务稳定性和监管。大多数主题存在混合和不确定的发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统综述危机期间财务报告质量研究，识别了该领域研究的不足和未来研究方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果对管理者、准则制定者、政府监管者和政策制定者具有重要启示，有助于理解当前新冠疫情对企业财务报告实践的影响。

title: Portfolio Choice and Settlement Frictions: A Theory of Endogenous Convenience Yields
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Portfolio Choice and Settlement Frictions: A Theory of Endogenous Convenience Yields
detail.abstract:
We study settlement frictions that arise from the need to finance negative balances through an over-the-counter (OTC) market. We derive a closed-form expression for the endogenous convenience yield and show how it can be incorporated into a canonical portfolio problem. Using this framework, we examine how shifts in settlement frictions affect liquidity premia, the volume of overnight funding, the dispersion of market rates, and optimal portfolio allocations. From a normative perspective, we show that in the competitive equilibrium, investors may either over- or under-invest in liquid assets; moreover, both higher risk aversion and tighter aggregate liquidity increase the likelihood of under-accumulation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了场外市场中结算摩擦对流动性溢价、隔夜融资量和市场利率分散度的影响，并探讨了在竞争均衡下投资者可能过度或不足投资于流动性资产的情况。
AI.research_question: 结算摩擦如何影响流动性溢价、隔夜融资量、市场利率分散度和最优资产配置？
AI.motivation: 研究场外市场中由于需要融资负余额而产生的结算摩擦问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于场外市场理论和投资组合理论，推导了内生便利收益的闭式表达式。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，将便利收益纳入标准投资组合问题框架进行分析。
AI.findings: 结算摩擦的变化会影响流动性溢价、隔夜融资量和市场利率分散度；在竞争均衡中，投资者可能过度或不足投资于流动性资产；更高的风险厌恶和更紧张的总体流动性会增加投资不足的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 推导了内生便利收益的闭式表达式，并将其纳入标准投资组合问题框架，为分析结算摩擦提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了关于结算摩擦如何影响市场流动性和资产配置的见解，有助于优化投资决策和监管政策。

title: Our Underappreciated International Reserve System
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), University of California, Berkeley and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Our Underappreciated International Reserve System
detail.abstract:
We document some underappreciated aspects of the recent evolution of the international reserve system. These include the growing share of gold in global central bank reserves, the continuing emergence of nontraditional reserve currencies, and the stalling share of renminbi in reserves. These trends are consistent with our findings in our earlier papers. In addition we look to the future, pondering the potential implications of dollar-linked stablecoins, the expansion of the BRICS grouping of countries and their de- dollarization plans, the development of blockchain-based platforms such as Project mBridge for the direct exchange of central bank digital currencies, and questions about the dollar’s safe-haven status.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了国际储备体系的最新演变，包括黄金储备份额增长、非传统储备货币崛起、人民币储备份额停滞，并探讨了美元稳定币、金砖国家去美元化、央行数字货币平台等未来趋势。
AI.research_question: 国际储备体系正在发生哪些重要变化？这些变化对美元主导地位有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解国际储备体系的演变趋势，为政策制定者和投资者提供前瞻性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际货币体系理论、储备货币竞争理论、数字货币对传统金融的影响理论
AI.method: 文献综述、数据分析、趋势观察和前瞻性分析
AI.findings: 黄金在全球央行储备中份额增长；非传统储备货币持续崛起；人民币储备份额停滞不前；这些趋势与作者早期研究一致
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对国际储备体系演变机制的理解，为储备货币竞争理论提供了新的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行储备管理、国际投资和政策制定提供了重要参考，有助于理解去美元化趋势和数字货币对国际金融体系的影响

title: Stablecoins: A Revolutionary Payment Technology with Financial Risks
affiliations: Andersen Institute for Finance and Economics, Andersen Institute for Finance and Economics, Andersen Institute for Finance and Economics, Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School and George Washington University, Columbian College of Arts and Sciences, Department of Economics

detail.title: Stablecoins: A Revolutionary Payment Technology with Financial Risks
detail.abstract:
The GENIUS Act, recently signed into law, establishes a dual federal and state regulatory framework for stablecoins, effectively segmenting the USD stablecoin market into GENIUS-compliant stablecoins and those that are not. This paper discusses the use cases and potential benefits of stablecoins in terms of payment system efficiency and costs, as well as their substitutability with money market mutual funds and bank deposits. It then analyzes the financial stability risks associated with both GENIUS-compliant and unregulated stablecoins using empirical analysis and historical case studies. It concludes by discussing the economic implications of the emergence of a large dollar stablecoin ecosystem. The discussion is supported by a new survey of expert opinions canvassed through Large Language Model (LLM) analysis of all U.S. podcast episodes on stablecoins from January 20 to July 17, 2025.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了GENIUS法案对稳定币市场的监管影响，探讨了稳定币在支付系统效率和成本方面的优势，以及其与货币市场基金和银行存款的可替代性，并通过实证分析和历史案例研究了合规与非合规稳定币的金融稳定风险。
AI.research_question: GENIUS法案如何影响美元稳定币市场？合规与非合规稳定币分别带来哪些金融稳定风险？
AI.motivation: GENIUS法案建立了联邦和州双重监管框架，将稳定币市场分割为合规与非合规两类，需要分析这种监管变化对金融稳定的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 支付系统效率理论、金融稳定理论、监管套利理论
AI.method: 实证分析、历史案例研究、基于LLM的专家意见调查（分析2025年1月20日至7月17日美国所有关于稳定币的播客）
AI.findings: 稳定币在支付效率和成本方面具有优势，但不同监管状态的稳定币带来不同的金融稳定风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对监管框架下稳定币市场分割的理论理解，拓展了金融稳定风险评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于稳定币监管效果的实证依据，帮助金融机构评估稳定币相关风险。

title: Middlemen in Search Equilibrium: A Survey
affiliations: Zhejiang University,  and University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Finance, Investment and Banking

detail.title: Middlemen in Search Equilibrium: A Survey
detail.abstract:
This essay surveys the literature on middlemen—i.e., intermediation in exchange—reviewing, extending and consolidating key developments in the field. This is important because intermediated trade is common in reality but absent in standard general equilibrium theory. We focus on research using search theory. In various models, agents may act as middlemen when they are good at search, bargaining, recognizing quality, storing inventories, using credit, etc. The theory applies to markets for goods, inputs or assets. We discuss versions with indivisible or divisible goods, fixed or endogenous participation, stationary and dynamic equilibria, and some implications for efficiency and volatility.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了关于中间商（交易中介）的文献，回顾、扩展并整合了该领域的关键进展。重点研究使用搜索理论的模型，探讨了各种情况下代理人如何成为中间商，并讨论了不同版本模型的效率与波动性影响。
AI.research_question: 中间商在交易中介中的作用机制及其对市场效率的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 中介交易在现实中很常见，但在标准一般均衡理论中却缺失，因此需要专门研究中间商的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索理论、一般均衡理论、交易中介理论
AI.method: 文献综述、理论模型分析（包括可分割与不可分割商品、固定与内生参与、静态与动态均衡等模型）
AI.findings: 代理人可能因为擅长搜索、议价、识别质量、库存管理、信用使用等而成为中间商；该理论适用于商品、投入品或资产市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了标准一般均衡理论中中介交易缺失的空白，系统整合了中间商理论的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实市场中中间商的作用提供了理论框架，对市场效率和波动性有重要启示。

title: Taxing Identity
affiliations: University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: Taxing Identity
detail.abstract:
Taxation based on identity has a long, often sordid history, and persists to this day, usually with some subtlety. It is a relatively tame cousin of the blatant, violent, and genocidal policies that have targeted people of certain religions, races, and genders for millennia. It is, nevertheless, an issue to be confronted rather than ignored by public finance economists. This is especially true because the concept of identity played a prominent role in the US presidential election of 2024, and is likely to be at least an undercurrent to the policy debates beginning in 2025, including those concerning tax policy. Tax based on identity is difficult, although not impossible, to justify within standard optimal tax analysis, because in that framework the policy objective is usually framed as being anonymous (impartial) and eschews basing policy on disparate preferences. The most promising justification seems to be if, for example, race is systematically correlated with the failure of income to represent ability to pay. It then acts as a tag that can help achieve the desired allocation of tax burden at minimal efficiency cost. For unjustified identity-based tax policy, analysis can help to spot its existence and quantify its social welfare cost.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨基于身份的税收政策，分析其在最优税收框架中的合理性，认为当身份（如种族）与支付能力系统性相关时，可作为标签实现税负分配，同时量化不合理身份税收的社会福利成本。
AI.research_question: 基于身份的税收政策如何在标准最优税收分析框架中合理化？其社会成本如何量化？
AI.motivation: 基于身份的税收具有悠久历史且持续存在，在2024年美国总统选举中身份概念突出，预计将影响2025年税收政策辩论，需要公共财政经济学家正视此问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准最优税收理论框架，强调税收政策的匿名性和中立性，避免基于不同偏好的政策制定。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，探讨身份标签在税收分配中的作用机制。
AI.findings: 当身份（如种族）与收入无法准确反映支付能力系统性相关时，身份可作为标签帮助以最小效率成本实现期望的税负分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展最优税收理论，探讨身份标签在税收政策中的合理应用条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供分析工具，识别不合理身份税收政策并量化其社会福利成本。

title: Rating Government Procurement Markets
affiliations: University of Illinois, National University of Singapore (NUS) - Sustainable & Green Finance Institute (SGFIN), University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business, University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics, AI for Good Foundation and

detail.title: Rating Government Procurement Markets
detail.abstract:
We develop a novel, scalable method for assessing the quality of public procurement systems using standard administrative data. Our approach compares the distribution of procurement opportunities to the distribution of contract awards across firms. We first derive a simple theoretical benchmark that relates the expected distribution of contract value winning firms, measured as a Herfindahl–Hirschman index (HHI), to the distribution of auction values, measured as a respective HHI, and the number of winning firms. Significant deviations of winning firms’ HHI from this benchmark indicate potential governance failures such as corruption or unchecked collusion. Our method requires no subjective input, is transparent and reproducible, and allows for meaningful comparisons across countries, industry sectors, and over time. We use procurement data from Ukraine and EU member states in 2018–2021 to assess the performance of five large sectors. Results indicate that Ukraine’s procurement performance in four of the five sectors is comparable to many other European countries. However, Ukraine’s construction sector consistently displays the largest excess concentration among all countries considered, consistent with anecdotal evidence of corruption in this sector. Overall, with minimal data requirements, our method offers a practical tool for cross-sector and cross-country assessment of procurement systems.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 开发了一种使用标准行政数据评估公共采购系统质量的新方法，通过比较采购机会分布与合同授予分布来识别潜在治理失败。
AI.research_question: 如何利用标准行政数据开发可扩展的方法来评估公共采购系统的质量？
AI.motivation: 需要一种透明、可重复且无需主观输入的客观方法来评估采购系统，以识别腐败或串通等治理失败问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）的理论基准，将合同价值分布与拍卖价值分布联系起来。
AI.method: 比较采购机会分布与合同授予分布的差异，使用乌克兰和欧盟成员国2018-2021年采购数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 乌克兰在五个大型部门中有四个的采购表现与其他欧洲国家相当，但建筑部门在所有国家中显示出最大的过度集中，与腐败传闻一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了将合同价值分布与拍卖价值分布联系起来的理论基准，为采购系统评估提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种数据需求最小、透明可重复的实用工具，可用于跨部门和跨国家的采购系统评估。

title: Occupations, Human Capital Accumulation and Inequality
affiliations: Charles III University of Madrid - Department of Economics, Charles III University of Madrid, University of Toronto and Princeton University - Princeton School of Public and International Affairs

detail.title: Occupations, Human Capital Accumulation and Inequality
detail.abstract:
Two robust empirical facts are that mean wages and cross-sectional wage dispersion both increase over the life cycle. We study how these two changes vary across occupations and document a strong positive correlation: occupations with high mean wage growth over the life cycle also exhibit greater increases in cross-sectional wage dispersion. We develop a novel dynamic Roy model that features both static and dynamic comparative advantage and show that it can account for the variation in life cycle wage distributions across high and low wage occupations. Dynamic comparative advantage reflects individual heterogeneity in occupation specific learning abilities and is the dominant force that shapes occupation choice in our model. We highlight several important implications of dynamic comparative advantage and show that our model captures the data better than a benchmark model that features persistent shocks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现职业生命周期中平均工资和工资分散度呈正相关，开发了一个包含静态和动态比较优势的动态Roy模型来解释这一现象，其中动态比较优势（个体在职业特定学习能力上的异质性）是主导职业选择的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 不同职业中生命周期工资分布的变化模式是什么？为什么高平均工资增长的职业也表现出更大的工资分散度增加？
AI.motivation: 两个稳健的实证事实：平均工资和横截面工资分散度都随生命周期增加，需要理解这些变化如何在不同职业间变化及其背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态Roy模型，包含静态比较优势和动态比较优势，其中动态比较优势反映个体在职业特定学习能力上的异质性。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与实证分析相结合，开发新颖的动态Roy模型来解释职业间生命周期工资分布的差异。
AI.findings: 职业间存在强正相关：高平均工资增长的职业也表现出更大的横截面工资分散度增加；动态比较优势是主导职业选择的关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包含动态比较优势的动态Roy模型，强调职业特定学习能力的异质性在解释职业选择和生命周期工资分布中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解职业选择、工资增长模式和劳动力市场不平等提供了新的理论框架和政策启示，模型表现优于仅包含持久冲击的基准模型。

title: Violent Peers at School: Impacts and Mechanisms
affiliations: University of Warwick - Department of Economics and The Hebrew University of Jerusalem

detail.title: Violent Peers at School: Impacts and Mechanisms
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the impact of classroom exposure to peers with a history of violent behavior on academic achievement and the underlying mechanisms. This measure of peer violence departs significantly from earlier studies that measured potential peer violence based on the background characteristics of students. We exploit idiosyncratic treatment variations during the transition from primary to middle school for causal identification. We find that a higher proportion of violent peers negatively affects cognitive performance in tests in various subjects, particularly pronounced in mathematics and English, compared to Hebrew and science. These effects are more pronounced in girls than in boys. While boys’ performance is negatively influenced only by the presence of violent male peers, girls are adversely affected by both violent male and female peers. As for mechanisms, violent peers disrupt learning environments and lower teachers’ productivity, reflected in lower job satisfaction and perception of higher workloads. Violent peers also significantly increase the likelihood of other students engaging in physical fights, and reduce their homework time, especially for girls and students from low SES.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了班级中暴力行为史同伴对学生学业成绩的影响及其机制。研究发现暴力同伴比例越高，学生在各科认知测试中的表现越差，特别是数学和英语，且女生受影响更大。机制包括破坏学习环境、降低教师生产力、增加学生斗殴可能性、减少作业时间。
AI.research_question: 班级中暴力行为史同伴如何影响学生的学业成绩？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要基于学生背景特征来衡量同伴暴力潜力，而本研究采用更直接的暴力行为史测量方法，以更准确地评估同伴暴力对学业的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 同伴效应理论、教育生产函数理论、社会学习理论
AI.method: 利用小学到中学过渡期间的异质性处理变异进行因果识别，采用准实验设计分析暴力同伴比例对学业成绩的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 暴力同伴比例越高，学生认知测试成绩越差，数学和英语受影响最严重；2. 女生受影响比男生更显著；3. 男生仅受暴力男同伴影响，女生受暴力男、女同伴双重影响；4. 暴力同伴破坏学习环境，降低教师工作满意度和生产力；5. 增加学生斗殴可能性，减少作业时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了同伴暴力对学业影响的因果证据；2. 揭示了性别差异在同伴暴力影响中的重要作用；3. 阐明了暴力同伴通过多种机制影响学业成绩的路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为学校管理提供班级编排策略建议；2. 为教师培训提供针对性指导；3. 为教育政策制定者提供干预暴力同伴影响的依据；4. 特别关注弱势群体（女生、低SES学生）的保护措施。

title: Economic Development According to Chandler
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, University of Minnesota - Minneapolis, Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Economics, University of Warwick and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis

detail.title: Economic Development According to Chandler
detail.abstract:
Chandler (1977) shows that large firms require hierarchies of white-collar workers to coordinate complex production. We document that this insight continues to hold globally today, and we show that low education levels in developing countries limit the supply of white-collar workers and constrain firm size. We extend the occupational choice model of Lucas (1978) to allow entrepreneurs to reorganize their firms by allocating administrative tasks to hired professionals, which brings the firm closer to constant returns to scale. We calibrate the model to be consistent with cross-sectional microdata and validate it using quasi-experimental and experimental evidence on the effects of educational expansions and management training interventions. Skills explain two-thirds of the reorganization of production into large firms with economic development, while structural transformation and reductions in barriers are needed to explain the remaining shift.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Lucas的职业选择模型，证明发展中国家教育水平低限制了白领工人供给，从而制约了企业规模扩张。技能因素解释了经济发展中三分之二的企业重组为大型企业的现象。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家教育水平如何通过限制白领工人供给来影响企业规模和组织结构？
AI.motivation: Chandler(1977)指出大型企业需要白领层级来协调复杂生产，但发展中国家教育水平低可能限制了这种组织能力的发展
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Lucas(1978)的职业选择模型，允许企业家通过将管理任务分配给专业雇员来重组企业组织
AI.method: 校准模型以匹配横截面微观数据，并使用准实验和实验证据验证教育扩张和管理培训干预的效果
AI.findings: 技能因素解释了经济发展中三分之二的企业重组为大型企业的现象，其余需要结构转型和障碍减少来解释
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Lucas的职业选择模型，将企业组织重组纳入分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家通过教育投资和管理培训促进企业规模扩张提供了政策依据

title: The Impact of Pay Transparency in Job Postings on the Labor Market
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), University of Southern California and SkyHive

detail.title: The Impact of Pay Transparency in Job Postings on the Labor Market
detail.abstract:
This paper studies the labor market effects of recent state-level policies that require employers to disclose salary information in job postings. Leveraging a difference-in-differences design, we show that employers increased the fraction of postings with salary information by 30 percentage points. Across three datasets, we find consistent evidence of an increase in wages of 1.3-3.6%. We find no impacts on pay dispersion, employment, the number of postings, or skill and education requirements. Our evidence is consistent with pay transparency increasing competition in the labor market, leading to positive spillovers on incumbent workers and always-posting firms.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过三重差分设计分析美国州级薪酬透明度政策的影响，发现政策使雇主在招聘信息中披露薪资的比例提高30个百分点，工资水平增长1.3-3.6%，但对薪酬分散度、就业、职位数量或技能要求没有影响。
AI.research_question: 州级薪酬透明度政策对劳动力市场有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究近期各州要求雇主在招聘信息中披露薪资的政策对劳动力市场的影响，特别是对工资水平、就业和竞争的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场竞争理论，薪酬透明度可能通过增加信息对称性来影响工资设定和市场竞争。
AI.method: 采用三重差分设计，分析三个不同数据集，比较政策实施前后的变化。
AI.findings: 1) 雇主披露薪资信息的比例增加30个百分点；2) 工资水平显著增长1.3-3.6%；3) 对薪酬分散度、就业、职位数量和技能要求无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为薪酬透明度政策的经济效应提供实证证据，支持透明度通过增加市场竞争影响工资的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于薪酬透明度政策实际效果的证据，表明此类政策能提高工资水平而不损害就业。

title: Do Test Scores Misrepresent Test Results? An Item-by-Item Analysis
affiliations: Brown University, , Georgetown University - Public Policy Institute (GPPI) and University of Chicago

detail.title: Do Test Scores Misrepresent Test Results? An Item-by-Item Analysis
detail.abstract:
Much of the data collected in education is effectively thrown away. Students answer individual test questions, but administrators and researchers only see aggregate performance. All the item-level data are lost. Ex ante it is not clear this destroys much useful information, since the aggregate might be a sufficient statistic. Using data from Texas for 5 million students and 1.31 billion student-item responses, we show that in fact aggregation does destroy a great deal of valuable information in education: (1) Even conditional on a summary test measure, there is additional information in the item-level data; (2) This additional information is relevant for the student outcomes that education decisions seek to optimize; and (3) This information can be made practically useful for schools. Given how inexpensive storing, transmitting and analyzing such data would be, large gains could be had in education by simply using all the data we currently collect.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析德州500万学生和13.1亿学生-项目回答数据，证明教育数据聚合会丢失大量有价值信息，使用完整的项目级数据可以显著改善教育决策。
AI.research_question: 教育数据聚合是否会破坏有价值信息？项目级数据是否包含超越汇总测试分数的额外信息？
AI.motivation: 教育中收集的大量数据被浪费，学生回答单个测试问题，但管理者和研究者只能看到汇总表现，所有项目级数据都丢失了。
AI.theoretical_framework: 充分统计量理论 - 检验汇总数据是否包含所有相关信息，还是项目级数据包含额外有价值信息。
AI.method: 使用德州500万学生和13.1亿学生-项目回答的大规模数据集进行实证分析。
AI.findings: (1) 即使控制了汇总测试分数，项目级数据仍包含额外信息；(2) 这些额外信息与教育决策优化的学生结果相关；(3) 这些信息对学校具有实际应用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了教育数据聚合的充分性假设，证明项目级数据包含超越汇总分数的有价值信息。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出通过存储、传输和分析完整的项目级数据，可以在教育领域获得巨大收益，且成本低廉。

title: Branching Fixed Effects: A Proposal for Communicating Uncertainty
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics

detail.title: Branching Fixed Effects: A Proposal for Communicating Uncertainty
detail.abstract:
Economists often rely on estimates of linear fixed effects models developed by other teams of researchers. Assessing the uncertainty in these estimates can be challenging. I propose a form of sample splitting for network data that breaks two-way fixed effects estimates into statistically independent branches, each of which provides an unbiased estimate of the parameters of interest. These branches facilitate uncertainty quantification, moment estimation, and shrinkage. Algorithms are developed for efficiently extracting branches from large datasets. I illustrate these techniques using a benchmark dataset from Veneto, Italy that has been widely used to study firm wage effects.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于网络数据的样本分割方法，将双向固定效应估计分解为统计独立的分支，每个分支都能提供参数的无偏估计，便于不确定性量化、矩估计和收缩估计。
AI.research_question: 如何评估线性固定效应模型估计的不确定性？
AI.motivation: 经济学家经常依赖其他研究团队的线性固定效应模型估计，但评估这些估计的不确定性具有挑战性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线性固定效应模型、网络数据分析、样本分割理论
AI.method: 提出网络数据的样本分割方法，将双向固定效应估计分解为统计独立的分支，并开发了从大数据集中高效提取分支的算法。
AI.findings: 该方法能够提供参数的无偏估计，便于进行不确定性量化、矩估计和收缩估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了网络数据样本分割的理论框架，为固定效应模型的不确定性评估提供了新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 使用意大利威尼托地区的基准数据集验证了该技术的有效性，该数据集被广泛用于研究企业工资效应。

title: A Cold Stop: Temperature, Unemployment and Joblessness Dynamics
affiliations: School of Global Policy and Strategy, Universite du Luxembourg - Department of Economics, Columbia University and Lund University

detail.title: A Cold Stop: Temperature, Unemployment and Joblessness Dynamics
detail.abstract:
We provide new evidence that short-run temperature shocks affect unemployment dynamics. Linking daily weather data with three decades of Current Population Survey microdata, we show that cold, but not hot, temperatures significantly increase unemployment risk. This effect is concentrated in climate-exposed industries and driven by both increased job separations and longer unemployment durations. Separations appear to be driven by a rise in layoffs rather than quits, while the increase in unemployment duration is largely explained by a decline in employer vacancy postings. Taken together, temperature-induced joblessness dynamics are primarily demand-driven, rather than a result of changes in worker behavior.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现短期寒冷天气冲击会显著增加失业风险，这种影响主要集中在气候暴露行业，由工作分离增加和失业持续时间延长共同驱动，主要是需求端因素而非工人行为变化所致。
AI.research_question: 短期温度冲击如何影响失业动态？
AI.motivation: 理解天气变化对劳动力市场的即时影响，特别是温度波动如何通过不同机制影响失业率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场供需理论，分析温度冲击对就业分离、失业持续时间和职位空缺的影响机制。
AI.method: 将每日天气数据与三十年当前人口调查微观数据链接，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 寒冷（而非炎热）温度显著增加失业风险；影响集中在气候暴露行业；由解雇增加和失业持续时间延长共同驱动；雇主职位空缺减少是失业持续时间延长的主要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了温度冲击主要通过需求端（雇主行为）而非供给端（工人行为）影响失业动态的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者应对气候变化对劳动力市场的影响提供实证依据，特别是在气候暴露行业的就业保护政策设计方面。

title: Social Dynamics of AI Adoption
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, Bocconi University, University of Chicago and University of Cologne

detail.title: Social Dynamics of AI Adoption
detail.abstract:
Anxiety about falling behind can drive people to embrace emerging technologies with uncertain consequences. We study how social forces shape demand for AI-based learning tools early in the education pipeline. In incentivized experiments with parents—key gatekeepers for children’s AI adoption—we elicit their demand for unrestricted AI tools for teenagers’ education. Parental demand rises with the share of other teenagers using the technology, with social forces increasing willingness to pay for AI by more than 60%. Providing information about potentially adverse effects of unstructured AI use negatively shifts beliefs about the merits of AI, but does not change individual demand. Instead, this information increases parents’ preference for banning AI in schools. Follow-up experiments show that social information has little effect on beliefs about AI quality, perceived skill priorities, or support for bans, suggesting that effects operate through social pressure rather than social learning. Our evidence highlights social pressure driving individual technology adoption despite widespread support for restricting its use.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 父母对AI教育工具的需求受社会压力驱动而非理性评估，即使知道AI的负面影响，社会压力仍使支付意愿增加60%以上，但父母更支持在学校禁止AI使用
AI.research_question: 社会力量如何影响教育管道早期对AI学习工具的需求？
AI.motivation: 担心落后会促使人们接受后果不确定的新兴技术，父母作为孩子AI采用的关键把关人，其决策受到社会力量的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会压力理论、技术采纳理论、社会学习理论
AI.method: 激励性实验，研究父母对青少年教育AI工具的需求，测试社会信息、负面信息对需求和信念的影响
AI.findings: 父母需求随其他青少年使用比例上升而增加，社会力量使AI支付意愿增加60%以上；负面信息改变信念但不改变个人需求，反而增加对学校禁止AI的支持；社会信息对AI质量信念、技能优先感知或禁令支持影响不大
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示社会压力而非社会学习是技术采纳的主要驱动力，解释了个人采用与集体限制支持之间的矛盾
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供关于AI工具监管的实证依据，帮助理解家长决策机制以设计更有效的技术采用干预措施

title: Smart Cities and Infrastructure
affiliations: Francis Xavier Engineering College - Francis Xavier Engineering College, Students, Francis Xavier Engineering College - Francis Xavier Engineering College, Students, Francis Xavier Engineering College - Francis Xavier Engineering College, Students, Francis Xavier Engineering College - Francis Xavier Engineering College, Students and Francis Xavier Engineering College - Francis Xavier Engineering College, Students

detail.title: Smart Cities and Infrastructure
detail.abstract: The idea of "smart cities" has become increasingly popular as urbanization rates continue to rise worldwide. Smart cities improve the efficiency, sustainability, and livability of urban areas by utilizing cutting-edge technologies and data-driven strategies. In addition to outlining important technology advancements including the Internet of Things (IoT), big data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and sustainable energy solutions, this short examines the essential elements and advantages of smart cities.It also looks at the difficulties and factors to be taken into account when putting smart city plans into practice, such as privacy, security, and digital divide concerns. The brief also includes real-world instances of prosperous smart city initiatives from across the globe, illustrating their influence on enhancing public services, transit networks, energy conservation, and urban dwellers' general quality of life.This brief offers a thorough summary of the revolutionary potential of smart cities in reshaping urban environments going forward.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了智慧城市的概念、关键技术（物联网、大数据分析、人工智能、可持续能源解决方案）及其在提高城市效率、可持续性和宜居性方面的优势，同时分析了实施过程中的挑战（隐私、安全、数字鸿沟）并提供了全球成功案例。
AI.research_question: 智慧城市如何通过先进技术和数据驱动策略改善城市效率、可持续性和宜居性？
AI.motivation: 随着全球城市化率持续上升，智慧城市概念越来越受欢迎，需要系统分析其核心要素、优势及实施挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于智慧城市理论框架，整合物联网、大数据分析、人工智能和可持续能源等技术要素。
AI.method: 文献综述和案例分析，通过全球成功智慧城市项目的实例研究。
AI.findings: 智慧城市能够显著提升公共服务、交通网络、能源效率和居民生活质量，但面临隐私保护、安全风险和数字鸿沟等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了智慧城市的核心理论框架，明确了技术要素与城市发展目标之间的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者和政策制定者提供了实施智慧城市战略的实践指导和成功案例参考。

title: A Second Chance at Schooling? Unintended Consequences of Prison Education
affiliations: Cornell University and Grinnell College

detail.title: A Second Chance at Schooling? Unintended Consequences of Prison Education

publicationDetails.detailsText: This is an unpublished working paper

detail.abstract: Despite rapid growth in US prison education programs, causal evidence of their effectiveness is limited. Leveraging detailed administrative data from Iowa, we estimate the impact of prison education on future incarceration, employment, and education, using course availability to instrument for course-taking. We find that course-taking increases reincarceration for technical violations but not for new crimes. Exploring mechanisms, we find that education participants are 14% likelier to be assigned to work release---probably with the aim of supporting their reentry into society. However, work release increases revocation risk. A mediation exercise confirms no relationship between education and reincarceration after we control for release type. We also find that course-taking increases the probability of post-release employment, consistent with the increased likelihood of assignment to work release.

AI.tldr: 本文利用爱荷华州的行政数据，通过课程可用性作为工具变量，研究了监狱教育对再监禁、就业和教育的影响。研究发现，参加课程会增加因技术违规导致的再监禁风险，但不会增加因新犯罪导致的再监禁。教育参与者更可能被分配到工作释放项目，但工作释放会增加撤销风险。控制释放类型后，教育与再监禁之间没有关系。课程参与还增加了释放后就业概率。
AI.research_question: 监狱教育项目对囚犯释放后的再监禁、就业和教育结果有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国监狱教育项目快速增长，但关于其有效性的因果证据有限。需要更严谨的研究来评估这些项目的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用工具变量方法，以课程可用性作为课程参与的工具变量，建立因果关系。
AI.method: 利用爱荷华州的详细行政数据，采用工具变量回归分析，研究监狱教育对再监禁、就业和教育的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 课程参与增加因技术违规导致的再监禁风险，但不增加因新犯罪导致的再监禁；2) 教育参与者被分配到工作释放项目的可能性增加14%；3) 工作释放增加撤销风险；4) 控制释放类型后，教育与再监禁无关系；5) 课程参与增加释放后就业概率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了监狱教育项目有效性的因果证据，揭示了教育通过工作释放机制影响再监禁的复杂路径，挑战了教育直接减少再犯罪的简单假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监狱教育政策制定提供实证依据，建议关注工作释放项目的风险管理，优化教育项目的实施方式以真正降低再犯率。

title: Recurring Demand for Corporate Bonds
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Recurring Demand for Corporate Bonds
detail.abstract: We find that nearly all of the credit premium of investment-grade corporate bonds is earned during a narrow window around the turn of the month. During these periods, corporate bond yield spreads decline by approximately four basis points. This pattern can be explained by the monthly bond mutual fund reinvestment cycle, which is driven by the rebalancing methodology of the main bond index benchmarks. A back-of-the-envelope calculation estimates a price multiplier ranging from 0.91 to 2.72. Firms capitalize from this predictable demand by issuing bonds at the beginning of the month.

AI.tldr: 研究发现投资级公司债券的信用溢价几乎全部在月末窗口期获得，此时债券利差下降约4个基点，这由债券基金月度再投资周期驱动，企业利用这一可预测需求在月初发债。
AI.research_question: 投资级公司债券的信用溢价在时间维度上如何分布？是什么因素驱动了这种时间模式？
AI.motivation: 理解公司债券信用溢价的时间分布模式及其驱动机制，揭示债券市场定价效率问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债券指数基准再平衡理论、债券基金投资行为理论、市场微观结构理论
AI.method: 实证分析公司债券收益率利差的时间模式，结合债券基金再投资周期进行机制分析，并进行粗略计算估计价格乘数
AI.findings: 投资级公司债券的信用溢价主要集中在月末窗口期，此时债券利差下降约4个基点，这一模式由债券基金月度再投资周期驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了债券市场定价的时间异质性，提出了债券指数基准再平衡对市场定价的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为债券投资者提供了可预测的交易机会，为企业债券发行时机选择提供了指导

title: Mathematical Proof of Feedback Decoupling and Singularity Classification in Amplification Dynamics

detail.title: Mathematical Proof of Feedback Decoupling and Singularity Classification in Amplification Dynamics
detail.abstract: We provide a complete mathematical characterization of dynamical systems with observable amplification ratio R A (t) and time-varying feedback coupling L(t). Under explicit regularity conditions, we prove that finite-time singularities cannot occur when external resources grow sublinearly, classify long-term asymptotic behavior based on the amplification ratio, and derive sharp su!cient conditions for global boundedness. We distinguish coordinate singularities-where e!ciency E(t) = 1/L(t) diverges as L(t) → 0-from state-space singularities, where the system state S(t) itself blows up. The former represent asymptotic feedback decoupling: points where intrinsic time halts, the system becomes purely resource-driven, and internal amplification ceases to contribute. These results formalize how bounded resources and vanishing coupling yield measurable regimes of divergent e!ciency without physical blow-up, unifying amplification, stability, and singularity within a single observable framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文对具有可观测放大比R_A(t)和时变反馈耦合L(t)的动态系统进行了完整的数学刻画，证明了在外部资源亚线性增长时不会出现有限时间奇点，基于放大比分类长期渐近行为，并推导了全局有界性的充分条件。
AI.research_question: 具有时变反馈耦合和可观测放大比的动态系统的数学特性和奇点行为是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解动态系统中放大、稳定性和奇点之间的关系，特别是当反馈耦合随时间变化时系统的行为特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态系统理论、反馈耦合理论、奇点分析、放大比理论
AI.method: 数学分析和证明方法，在明确的正则性条件下进行理论推导
AI.findings: 1) 外部资源亚线性增长时不会出现有限时间奇点；2) 区分了坐标奇点和状态空间奇点；3) 坐标奇点代表渐近反馈解耦；4) 推导了全局有界性的充分条件
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了统一的观测框架，将放大、稳定性和奇点理论整合在一起，形式化了有界资源和消失耦合下发散效率的可测量机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为动态系统的设计和分析提供了理论指导，特别是在涉及反馈耦合和资源约束的工程应用中

title: "More Work, Less Time for What We Will?" The Trade-Offs between Work and Non-Work Time in the US, 2003-2024, and their Implications for Worker Well-Being
affiliations: The University of Manchester and Pennsylvania State University - Abington College

detail.title: "More Work, Less Time for What We Will?" The Trade-Offs between Work and Non-Work Time in the US, 2003-2024, and their Implications for Worker Well-Being
detail.abstract: This article explores the association between the length of individuals' daily working time in the US and the amount of time they allocate toward non-work activities. To illustrate the trade-offs incurred by longer work hours, we use the Current Population Survey's American Time Use Survey, 2003-2024. We divide unpaid non-work time into leisure activities; productive non-work activities such as household production, caregiving, volunteering, and education; and sleep time. We find that each additional hour of work time is associated with a reduction of 21 minutes of leisure and 22 minutes of productive activity. In addition to demonstrating differences in leisure and productive non-work time based on gender and household composition, we forward the current literature by revealing differences in time use based on race, education, and post-covid effects, raising questions for future research. We conclude by exploring the implications of these time allocation patterns and constraints for worker well-being and potential policy reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文使用美国时间使用调查数据（2003-2024）分析工作时间与非工作时间分配的关系，发现每增加1小时工作时间，休闲时间减少21分钟，生产性非工作时间减少22分钟，并揭示了基于性别、种族、教育程度和疫情后影响的差异。
AI.research_question: 美国个体每日工作时间长度与非工作时间分配之间存在怎样的关联？
AI.motivation: 探讨较长工作时间带来的时间分配权衡，理解工作与非工作活动之间的时间替代关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间分配理论，工作-生活平衡理论，时间使用模式分析
AI.method: 使用美国人口普查局当前人口调查中的美国时间使用调查数据（2003-2024年），将无薪非工作时间分为休闲活动、生产性非工作活动（家务生产、照料、志愿服务、教育）和睡眠时间。
AI.findings: 每增加1小时工作时间，休闲时间减少21分钟，生产性非工作活动时间减少22分钟；存在基于性别、家庭构成、种族、教育程度和疫情后影响的显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了时间使用文献，揭示了基于种族、教育程度和疫情后影响的时间使用差异，为未来研究提出新问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 探索这些时间分配模式和约束对劳动者福祉的影响，为潜在政策改革提供依据。

title: How Much New Information is There in the EPA's Mandatory GHG Reporting Program?
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Gies College of Business, University of Kansas - Accounting and Information Systems Area,  and Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Accounting & Management Information Systems

detail.title: How Much New Information is There in the EPA's Mandatory GHG Reporting Program?
detail.abstract: The value of environmental disclosures is at the center of ongoing regulatory and political debate, with some policymakers arguing that the Environmental Protection Agency’s mandatory Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program should be reconsidered due to significant costs on businesses without commensurate benefits. Against this backdrop, we examine whether GHGRP disclosures convey new, decision-useful information to equity markets. Using adjusted R² from regressions of firms’ calendar-year returns on three-day GHGRP-release-window returns, we find that GHGRP disclosures explain 6% of the variation in annual returns. This magnitude represents 62% of the information content of a typical quarterly earnings announcement that is mandated, regulated, and specifically targeted towards investors. Overall, our evidence indicates GHGRP disclosures are relevant to the capital market and underscores the importance of carefully weighing informational benefits against costs in ongoing policy debates over the future of GHGRP.

AI.tldr: 温室气体报告计划(GHGRP)披露对股票市场具有显著信息价值，解释了6%的年度收益变动，相当于典型季度盈利公告信息含量的62%。
AI.research_question: GHGRP披露是否向股票市场传递了新的、对决策有用的信息？
AI.motivation: 环境披露的价值是当前监管和政治辩论的核心，一些政策制定者认为EPA的强制性温室气体报告计划应重新考虑，因为给企业带来显著成本但缺乏相应收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、有效市场假说、环境信息披露价值理论
AI.method: 使用调整后的R²，通过将公司日历年度收益对GHGRP发布窗口(三天)收益进行回归分析
AI.findings: GHGRP披露解释了6%的年度收益变动，这一幅度代表了典型季度盈利公告信息含量的62%
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了强制性环境披露对资本市场的相关性，为环境信息披露价值提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了GHGRP信息效益的量化证据，强调在政策辩论中需要仔细权衡信息效益与成本

title: Financial Market Fragility in the Era of AI Planning
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School - Finance Department  and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Finance

detail.title: Financial Market Fragility in the Era of AI Planning
detail.abstract: This paper studies how AI planning, the core technology behind Agentic AI systems that reason over sequences of actions toward long-term goals, affects financial market stability. We develop a dynamic trading framework with positive-feedback investors, constrained arbitrageurs, and oligopolistic informed speculators who may coordinate through intertemporal planning: trading aggressively to generate (negative) bubbles and unwinding gradually to extract profits. Such coordination differs from traditional collusion because it faces two unique challenges: time inconsistency, as coordinated plans are ex post incentive-incompatible, and weak punishment, as deviations are difficult to penalize when no large (negative) bubble ultimately materializes. We characterize the equilibria featuring planning-based coordination among speculators. In simulation experiments, AI-planning speculators trained via reinforcement-learning algorithms with explicit planning modules autonomously discover and implement intertemporal collusive trading strategies based on compounded price-trigger rules, coordinating without communication or intent. With strong feedback trading, AIplanning speculators coordinate dynamically on destabilizing strategies that create and exploit (negative) bubbles, manipulating feedback traders and amplifying market fragility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI规划技术如何影响金融市场稳定，发现AI规划型投机者通过强化学习自主发现并实施跨期合谋交易策略，在不沟通或无意的情况下协调制造和利用（负面）泡沫，放大市场脆弱性。
AI.research_question: AI规划技术如何影响金融市场稳定性？
AI.motivation: AI规划是Agentic AI系统的核心技术，能够推理长期目标下的行动序列，但其对金融市场稳定性的影响尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态交易框架，包含正反馈投资者、受限套利者和寡头垄断知情投机者，投机者可能通过跨期规划进行协调。
AI.method: 模拟实验，使用带有显式规划模块的强化学习算法训练AI规划型投机者。
AI.findings: AI规划型投机者自主发现并实施基于复合价格触发规则的跨期合谋交易策略，在强反馈交易环境下协调实施破坏稳定的策略，制造和利用（负面）泡沫。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI规划型投机者协调的新机制，与传统合谋不同，面临时间不一致性和弱惩罚两个独特挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管AI在金融市场中的应用提供理论依据，揭示了AI可能自主发现和实施破坏市场稳定的策略风险。

title: Specialisation of Manufacturing Industries in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area—A Location Quotient Approach
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Specialisation of Manufacturing Industries in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area—A Location Quotient Approach
detail.abstract: Using the location quotient method on the latest available industrial output data across 31 manufacturing industries at city, provincial, and national levels, this study identifies industrial specialisation in nine Pearl River Delta cities within the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area and the region as a whole. By combining location quotients with industrial output shares, the study further assesses the competitive strengths of the nine cities within the regional context and the region's overall industrial strength in the national context, especially as compared with the Yangtze River Delta. The study confirmed that, despite local economic plans often targeting similar priority industries, a region's industrial pattern and development trajectory evolve from a synergy of public policies, local industrial heritage, and resource endowments. It revealed that Pearl River Delta cities exhibit a dynamic division of labour and industrial complementarity, enabling further coordination and integration for mutual reinforcement.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用区位商方法分析珠三角9个城市在粤港澳大湾区的产业专业化程度，发现尽管地方经济规划常瞄准相似优先产业，但区域产业模式和发展轨迹是由公共政策、地方产业遗产和资源禀赋协同作用形成的。珠三角城市展现出动态的劳动分工和产业互补性，有利于进一步协调整合。
AI.research_question: 珠三角城市在粤港澳大湾区的产业专业化程度如何？这些城市的竞争优劣势以及在区域和国家层面的产业实力如何？
AI.motivation: 分析珠三角城市在粤港澳大湾区的产业专业化模式，评估其区域竞争力和全国产业实力，特别是与长三角的比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区位商理论、产业专业化理论、区域分工理论
AI.method: 使用区位商方法，基于最新的城市、省级和国家级31个制造业产出数据

title: The Certainty Delusion: How Absolute Conviction About 'What Is Best' Enables Mass Killing
affiliations: City University of New York (CUNY) - Koppelman School of Business

detail.title: The Certainty Delusion: How Absolute Conviction About 'What Is Best' Enables Mass Killing
detail.abstract: This paper exposes the universal psychology behind modern mass atrocities: the lethal fusion of absolute certainty and lost humility. It argues that genocide and mass violence arise less from ideology itself than from the conviction of being right, regardless of whether that conviction is political, religious, economic, or scientific. Drawing on research in cognitive bias and neuroscience, the paper shows how certainty bias, confirmation bias, and binary thought transform belief into brutality. Across history, from totalitarian regimes to colonial and racial crimes, the feeling of possessing ultimate truth has justified systemic murder. Recognizing certainty as a neurological illusion, not moral clarity, offers a path toward intellectual humility and safeguards against future atrocities.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了现代大规模暴行的普遍心理机制：绝对确定性和丧失谦逊的致命融合。研究发现，种族灭绝和大规模暴力更多源于确信自己正确的信念，而非意识形态本身。通过认知偏见和神经科学研究，论文展示了确定性偏见、确认偏见和二元思维如何将信念转化为暴行。
AI.research_question: 现代大规模暴行背后的普遍心理机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解种族灭绝和大规模暴力发生的根本心理原因，为预防未来暴行提供理论依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知偏见理论、神经科学、社会心理学
AI.method: 基于历史案例分析和认知神经科学研究综述
AI.findings: 大规模暴行源于绝对确定性和丧失谦逊的心理融合，确定性偏见、确认偏见和二元思维是主要心理机制
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了大规模暴行的心理机制理论框架，将确定性视为神经学幻觉而非道德明晰
AI.practical_contributions: 为预防未来暴行提供了基于认知科学的方法，强调培养智力谦逊的重要性

title: Artificial Intelligence in Legal Education: A Scoping Review
affiliations: and University of Ottawa - Common Law Section

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Legal Education: A Scoping Review
detail.abstract: There is a lack of consolidated knowledge regarding the potential, best practices, and limitations associated with artificial intelligence (AI) in legal education. This review synthesises 82 academic works published between January 2020 and April 2025 originating from 26 jurisdictions. Our review yields four main themes: First, current empirical evidence suggests that AI tools (e.g., large language models, chatbots) alone have so far performed below average on law school evaluations, though detailed prompts can substantially improve outputs. Second, the literature provides concrete use cases for AI tools as teaching aids, facilitators of interactive exercises, legal writing aids, and skill development. Third, the literature highlights the risks of passive reliance on AI and diverse perspectives over appropriate AI use. Fourth, the literature suggests that AI will make legal educational content more accessible but perhaps also less transparent and more formalistic. These themes underscore the importance of evidence-based approaches to AI integration in legal education.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述分析了2020-2025年82篇学术文献，发现AI在法律教育中表现低于平均水平但可通过详细提示改进，可作为教学辅助工具，但存在被动依赖风险，可能使内容更易获取但透明度降低。
AI.research_question: AI在法律教育中的潜力、最佳实践和局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: 缺乏关于AI在法律教育中潜力、最佳实践和局限性的系统知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于26个司法管辖区的82篇学术文献的系统综述。
AI.method: 对2020年1月至2025年4月期间发表的82篇学术文献进行系统综述。
AI.findings: 1) AI工具在法律考试中表现低于平均水平但可通过详细提示改进；2) AI可作为教学辅助、互动练习促进者、法律写作辅助和技能发展工具；3) 存在被动依赖AI的风险和关于适当使用的不同观点；4) AI可能使法律教育内容更易获取但透明度降低且更形式化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI在法律教育中的应用提供了系统的理论框架和实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律教育机构提供了AI整合的证据基础，指出了具体应用场景和风险，支持基于证据的AI整合方法。

title: Does Corporate Governance Disclosure Provide Context for Investors' Trading Decisions?
affiliations: University of Colorado at Boulder, University of Colorado at Boulder and University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business

detail.title: Does Corporate Governance Disclosure Provide Context for Investors' Trading Decisions?
detail.abstract: We evaluate patterns in proxy statement download activity throughout the year to provide insight into when investors acquire governance information to provide context around trading decisions. While prior research often assumes that investors primarily rely on corporate governance disclosures to inform voting decisions and monitor management, theory predicts that governance information should also provide useful context for investors concerned about agency issues and trading around firm information events. Consistent with this prediction, we provide robust evidence that proxy statement downloads increase around M&A announcements, extreme bad earnings news, and governance incidents. We further document a positive relation between proxy statement acquisition and intraperiod timeliness around these information events, controlling for financial statement download activity and other firm and event characteristics. Collectively, our evidence suggests governance disclosures provide useful context around investors’ trading decisions, particularly when concerns around agency conflicts are more salient.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析代理声明下载模式，发现投资者在并购公告、极端负面盈利消息和治理事件期间会更多地获取治理信息，这表明治理披露为投资者的交易决策提供了有用背景信息。
AI.research_question: 投资者何时获取治理信息以为交易决策提供背景？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常假设投资者主要依赖公司治理披露来为投票决策和监督管理层提供信息，但理论预测治理信息也应该为关注代理问题和围绕公司信息事件进行交易的投资者提供有用背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论、信息不对称理论、投资者决策理论
AI.method: 分析代理声明下载活动模式，控制财务报表下载活动和其他公司及事件特征
AI.findings: 代理声明下载在并购公告、极端负面盈利消息和治理事件期间显著增加，且代理声明获取与这些信息事件期间的期间内及时性呈正相关
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对治理信息在投资者交易决策中作用的理解，验证了治理披露为交易决策提供背景的理论预测
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和公司提供了关于投资者如何以及何时使用治理信息的实证证据，有助于改进信息披露实践

title: Algorithmic Exuberance
affiliations: University of Oxford

detail.title: Algorithmic Exuberance
detail.abstract: Financial markets increasingly run on interacting algorithms. I develop a theory of Algorithmic Exuberance, in which volatility arises endogenously from two coupled feedbacks: market-algorithmic reflexivity (trading systems learning from one another) and information-algorithmic reflexivity (algorithmic amplification of news, narratives, and sentiment). The model yields a compact Reflexivity Index with Reflexivity Share of Variance (RSV) and Implied Reflexivity (IR) that makes reflexivity empirically observable. Using CRSP market data from 1980-2024, I document a structural shift since the early 2000s toward more persistent volatility, fatter tails, and higher implied reflexivity, consistent with automation and AI diffusion. Modern markets are recursively adaptive systems that evolve through continuous machine-to-machine feedback and learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了算法繁荣理论，认为金融市场波动性源于两个耦合反馈：市场-算法反身性（交易系统相互学习）和信息-算法反身性（算法放大新闻、叙事和情绪）。作者开发了反身性指数，并用1980-2024年CRSP数据证明自2000年代初以来市场出现了结构性转变，表现为更持久的波动性、更肥的尾部分布和更高的隐含反身性。
AI.research_question: 算法交易如何通过反身性机制影响金融市场波动性？
AI.motivation: 金融市场日益依赖相互作用的算法运行，需要理解算法交互如何内生地产生波动性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法繁荣理论，包含市场-算法反身性和信息-算法反身性两个耦合反馈机制。
AI.method: 开发反身性指数（包含反身性方差份额RSV和隐含反身性IR），使用CRSP市场数据（1980-2024年）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 自2000年代初以来，市场出现结构性转变：更持久的波动性、更肥的尾部分布、更高的隐含反身性，这与自动化和AI扩散一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了算法繁荣理论，将反身性概念扩展到算法交互领域，并开发了可观测的反身性度量指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和市场参与者提供了量化算法反身性的工具，有助于理解现代市场的递归适应性系统特性。

title: The Fiscal Sources of Euro Area Inflation Through the Lens of The Bernanke-Blanchard Model
affiliations: De Nederlandsche Bank, European Central Bank (ECB) and

detail.title: The Fiscal Sources of Euro Area Inflation Through the Lens of The Bernanke-Blanchard Model
detail.abstract: We estimate the contribution of discretionary fiscal policy measures to euro area inflation in the post-pandemic era using an extension of Bernanke and Blanchard (2024b)’s semi-structural model. Since the pandemic, aggregate discretionary fiscal measures had a modest yet progressively increasing positive contribution to inflation that partly worked through an indirect effect on wage growth and inflation expectations. However, net indirect taxes helped to contain inflationary pressures, both during the pandemic and energy crises. Fiscal policy, therefore, can be a powerful tool to smooth the inflationary effects of adverse supply shocks, yet may also increase inflation persistence if fiscal stimulus is not timely withdrawn.

AI.tldr: 使用扩展的Bernanke和Blanchard半结构模型估计疫情后欧元区财政政策对通胀的贡献，发现财政政策对通胀有温和但逐步增加的正面影响，部分通过工资增长和通胀预期传导，但间接税有助于抑制通胀压力。
AI.research_question: 疫情后欧元区财政政策对通胀的贡献程度如何？
AI.motivation: 理解疫情后财政政策在欧元区通胀动态中的作用，评估财政政策作为应对供应冲击的工具效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bernanke和Blanchard (2024b)的半结构模型扩展
AI.method: 扩展的半结构模型估计方法
AI.findings: 财政政策对通胀有温和但逐步增加的正面贡献，部分通过工资增长和通胀预期间接传导；间接税有助于抑制通胀压力；财政政策可平滑供应冲击的通胀效应，但需及时退出以避免通胀持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Bernanke和Blanchard的半结构模型，深化了对财政政策通胀传导机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了财政政策在应对供应冲击时的有效性评估，强调了财政刺激及时退出的重要性。

title: The Ultimate Goal of Education from the Islamic Point of View

detail.title: The Ultimate Goal of Education from the Islamic Point of View
detail.abstract: The ultimate goal in Islamic education enjoys a special position. The experts of Islamic education have mentioned various goals as the ultimate goals. They have mentioned goals such as proximity to Allah, pure life, Allah’s vicegerency, annihilation in Allah, and Allah’s consent, while there is just one ultimate goal. The question is as follows: “What is the ultimate goal of Islamic education according to Quranic verses and Islamic traditions?” The present study analyzes the Quranic verses and Islamic traditions as well as the views of the scholars of morality to investigate the ultimate goal of education form the Islamic viewpoint. The findings of the study suggest that Islamic education has just one goal and that is Allah’s consent. Other things are either in line with that goal or are among the general goals of the Islamic education in various domains such as ritual, religious, social education and the like.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析古兰经经文、伊斯兰传统和道德学者的观点，探讨伊斯兰教育的终极目标。研究发现伊斯兰教育只有一个终极目标——获得真主的喜悦，其他目标要么与此一致，要么是伊斯兰教育在仪式、宗教、社会等领域的通用目标。
AI.research_question: 根据古兰经经文和伊斯兰传统，伊斯兰教育的终极目标是什么？
AI.motivation: 伊斯兰教育专家提出了各种终极目标，如亲近真主、纯洁生活、真主的代理、在真主中消亡、真主的喜悦等，但实际上应该只有一个终极目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于古兰经经文、伊斯兰传统和道德学者的观点构建理论框架。
AI.method: 分析古兰经经文、伊斯兰传统以及道德学者的观点。
AI.findings: 伊斯兰教育只有一个终极目标——获得真主的喜悦。其他目标要么与此一致，要么是伊斯兰教育在仪式、宗教、社会等领域的通用目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了伊斯兰教育终极目标的单一性，明确了真主喜悦作为唯一终极目标的地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊斯兰教育实践提供了明确的方向指导，帮助教育者在各种教育领域中统一目标。

title: The Integrated Economic Growth Model of Vietnam

detail.title: The Integrated Economic Growth Model of Vietnam
detail.abstract: This paper proposes an Integrated Growth Model (IGM) to explain Vietnam's transition from a factor-driven to a productivity-driven development trajectory. Over the past three decades, Vietnam's growth has relied heavily on capital accumulation and low-cost labor, but this approach has reached its structural limits, reflected in low total factor productivity (TFP), limited domestic value added (DVA), and weak innovation and market access (IMA). The IGM conceptualizes productivity as a function of three interactive pillars-institutions, infrastructure, and data-which together form a system of integrated drivers for sustainable growth. The study employs a conceptual analytical approach grounded in productivity theory and institutional economics, synthesizing global frameworks and Vietnam's policy experience to construct a comprehensive analytical model. The findings indicate that the integration of institutional coordination, infrastructure development, and data connectivity can enhance TFP, increase domestic value creation, and expand access to international markets. The paper concludes by outlining key policy orientations to support Vietnam's 2025-2030 transformation toward a knowledge-based, innovative, and self-reliant economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个综合增长模型（IGM），解释越南从要素驱动向生产率驱动发展轨迹的转型。该模型将生产率概念化为制度、基础设施和数据三个互动支柱的函数，为可持续增长提供综合驱动力。
AI.research_question: 越南如何从要素驱动型增长转向生产率驱动型发展轨迹？
AI.motivation: 越南过去三十年的增长严重依赖资本积累和低成本劳动力，但这种方法已达到结构极限，表现为全要素生产率低、国内附加值有限、创新和市场准入能力弱。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生产率理论和制度经济学的综合增长模型（IGM），将制度、基础设施和数据视为生产率增长的三个互动支柱。
AI.method: 采用概念分析方法，综合全球框架和越南政策经验构建综合分析模型。
AI.findings: 制度协调、基础设施发展和数据连接的整合可以提升全要素生产率、增加国内价值创造并扩大国际市场准入。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了综合增长模型（IGM），为理解制度、基础设施和数据在生产率增长中的互动作用提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为越南2025-2030年向知识型、创新型和自立型经济转型提供了关键政策导向。

title: Civil Authority and Military Obedience: The Question of Whether Uniformed Personnel Can Lawfully Restrict the FCT Minister's Access to Land within Abuja
affiliations: David Ekpo & Associates

detail.title: Civil Authority and Military Obedience: The Question of Whether Uniformed Personnel Can Lawfully Restrict the FCT Minister's Access to Land within Abuja
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether uniformed personnel, acting "on orders," can lawfully prevent the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) from accessing land within Abuja. It situates the question within Nigeria's constitutional hierarchy, the doctrine of civilian supremacy, and the legal framework governing land administration in the FCT. Drawing from constitutional provisions, statutory mandates, and principles of administrative law, the article concludes that such prevention-unless backed by a valid presidential directive or court order-is unconstitutional and ultra vires.

title: Building a Purpose-Driven Culture
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Building a Purpose-Driven Culture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: This chapter explores the emergence and evolution of Purpose culture as a transformative organizational paradigm that unites moral conviction with operational excellence. Rooted in stakeholder theory, Purpose culture asserts that businesses exist not merely to generate profit but to create sustainable value for people, communities and the planet. The discussion traces its intellectual and historical lineage from corporate social responsibility to contemporary sustainability and "conscious capitalism" movements, illustrating how leading organizations such as Patagonia and Unilever exemplify this ethos in practice. Core features-integrity, empathy, stewardship, and authenticity-are examined alongside leadership behaviors, structural alignment and communication norms that enable purpose to permeate organizational systems. The chapter also analyzes risks such as purpose drift and moral overreach and proposes diagnostic and developmental tools for assessing and strengthening Purpose culture. By integrating ethics into strategy, governance, and innovation, Purpose culture reframes success as the pursuit of meaning and societal contribution alongside long-term performance.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨了目标文化作为一种将道德信念与运营卓越相结合的组织范式的兴起和演变。基于利益相关者理论，目标文化主张企业不仅为创造利润而存在，更要为人类、社区和地球创造可持续价值。文章分析了目标文化的核心特征、领导行为、结构对齐和沟通规范，同时讨论了目标漂移和道德越界等风险，并提出了评估和加强目标文化的诊断和发展工具。
AI.research_question: 目标文化如何作为一种将道德信念与运营卓越相结合的组织范式出现并发展？
AI.motivation: 企业不仅应该追求利润，还应该为人类、社区和地球创造可持续价值，这需要一种新的组织文化范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论、企业社会责任、可持续发展理论、有意识资本主义
AI.method: 文献综述和案例分析（如Patagonia和Unilever等领先组织的实践）
AI.findings: 目标文化的核心特征包括诚信、同理心、管家精神和真实性；成功的实施需要领导行为、结构对齐和沟通规范的配合；存在目标漂移和道德越界等风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将利益相关者理论与组织文化理论相结合，提出了目标文化作为一种新的组织范式，重新定义了企业成功的标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了诊断和发展工具来评估和加强目标文化，为组织将道德融入战略、治理和创新提供了实践指导。

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human or animal participants. All case studies and examples used are from publicly available sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was done independently and was not funded by any organization or company.

detail.abstract: The increasing sophistication and frequency of cyberattacks have exposed the limitations of traditional cybersecurity auditing methods. Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) provide opportunities to revolutionize auditing by enabling predictive, automated, and real-time monitoring of cyber risks. This paper investigates the integration of AI into cybersecurity audits, highlighting the benefits for threat detection, anomaly analysis, and continuous monitoring. It also critically examines the ethical, regulatory, and governance challenges associated with AI-driven auditing, including algorithmic bias, data privacy, and regulatory compliance. Drawing on recent literature and case studies, this paper proposes a framework for organizations to leverage AI in auditing while maintaining robust oversight and governance. The study emphasizes the need for a balanced approach that combines AI’s technological advantages with human expertise, ethical considerations, and regulatory compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI在网络安全审计中的应用，分析了AI带来的威胁检测、异常分析和实时监控等优势，同时批判性地审视了算法偏见、数据隐私和监管合规等伦理与治理挑战，提出了结合AI技术优势与人类专业知识的平衡框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将人工智能整合到网络安全审计中，并在利用其技术优势的同时应对相关的伦理、监管和治理挑战？
AI.motivation: 传统网络安全审计方法在面对日益复杂和频繁的网络攻击时存在局限性，而AI和机器学习技术为审计的预测性、自动化和实时监控提供了革命性机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI驱动的审计理论框架，结合网络安全风险管理、算法伦理和监管合规理论。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和案例研究方法，分析AI在网络安全审计中的应用现状和挑战。
AI.findings: AI能够显著提升网络安全审计的威胁检测能力、异常分析效率和实时监控水平，但同时也带来了算法偏见、数据隐私和监管合规等新挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI驱动的网络安全审计理论框架，强调了技术优势与人类专业知识、伦理考量和监管合规的平衡整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了利用AI进行网络安全审计的实用框架，帮助企业在享受技术红利的同时建立有效的监督和治理机制。

detail.abstract: Cybersecurity has become a critical component of organizational governance and compliance frameworks due to the increasing prevalence of cyber threats, regulatory scrutiny, and stakeholder expectations. Cybersecurity audits serve as a systematic tool for evaluating an organization’s information systems, policies, and controls, ensuring alignment with corporate governance objectives and regulatory requirements. This paper examines the role of cybersecurity audits in enhancing corporate governance and compliance. It explores their contribution to risk identification, internal control assessment, regulatory adherence, and ethical oversight. Additionally, it addresses emerging challenges, such as integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) in audits, ethical considerations, and data privacy concerns, and provides recommendations for strengthening audit practices. Through a review of literature, case studies, and best practices, this study underscores the importance of cybersecurity audits in fostering resilient, accountable, and transparent organizational systems.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨网络安全审计在提升公司治理和合规性方面的作用，包括风险识别、内部控制评估、监管遵从和道德监督，并分析AI整合、伦理问题和数据隐私等新兴挑战。
