title: Tool and Tutor? Experimental Evidence from AI Deployment in Cancer Diagnosis
affiliations: UCL School of Management, University College London, INSEAD, INSEAD and Sichuan University

detail.title: Tool and Tutor? Experimental Evidence from AI Deployment in Cancer Diagnosis
detail.abstract: Numerous countries globally face shortages of medical experts, deepening inequalities in access to healthcare. Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based diagnostic tools hold considerable promise to tackle this challenge by enabling even novices to deliver expert-level medical services. However, reliance on AI for task completion may hinder the learning required for novices to develop expertise. We thus explore whether AI-based diagnostic tools can be used to enhance not only performance but also learning in the context of lung cancer diagnosis. We examine the distinct effects of AI input during training (i.e., learning how to diagnose) versus in practice (i.e., completing diagnostic tasks) on novice medical profession-als' performance. In two field experiments, 576 medical students were randomly assigned across conditions, manipulating the access to AI input during their training, during a test of their diagnostic capabilities, or both. During practice, participants diagnosed potential lung cancer cases using chest CT scans, and their diagnoses were evaluated against the ground truth obtained through histopathological examinations. Study 1 (N = 336) revealed that AI input in training alone improved human diagnostic accuracy by 3.2 percentage points over the control, while AI input during practice alone increased human accuracy by 7.9 percentage points. Combined deployment in both training and practice yielded an improvement of 13.7 percentage points-significantly exceeding either approach alone. Study 2 (N = 240) showed that AI input in practice alone improved accuracy in subsequent practice, unaided by AI, by 9.9 percentage points over the control. Even minimally informative AI input in training improved diagnostic accuracy by 5.3 percentage points over the control. These results reveal AI's dual role: As a tool, it could rapidly improve novices' performance; as a "tutor," it could enhance their capabilities for independent diagnoses unaided by AI. We propose that using AI tools need not always lead to human skill decay or stagnation. Indeed, when the tool provides input that enhances humans' mental models relevant to the task (ra-ther than merely completing the task for them), it could enhance humans' independent capabilities for task completion.

AI.tldr: AI诊断工具在医疗培训中具有双重作用：作为工具可即时提升新手医生的诊断准确性，作为"导师"可增强其独立诊断能力。研究发现AI在培训和实践中的组合使用效果最佳，能显著提高诊断准确性。
AI.research_question: AI诊断工具能否在提升新手医疗专业人员诊断表现的同时，也促进其学习和发展独立诊断能力？
AI.motivation: 全球医疗专家短缺导致医疗资源分配不均，AI诊断工具有望让新手提供专家级医疗服务，但担心依赖AI会阻碍学习过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI作为工具与AI作为导师的双重角色理论，关注AI输入如何影响人类心智模型和独立能力发展。
AI.method: 两个现场实验，576名医学生随机分配到不同条件，操纵AI在培训期间、测试期间或两者的可访问性，使用胸部CT扫描诊断肺癌病例。
AI.findings: AI在培训中单独使用提高诊断准确性3.2个百分点，在实践中单独使用提高7.9个百分点，两者组合使用提高13.7个百分点。AI在实践中使用还能提升后续无AI辅助的独立诊断能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI工具不一定导致人类技能衰退，当AI输入能增强人类相关任务的心智模型时，反而能提升独立完成任务的能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗培训提供有效策略，证明AI可以同时作为绩效提升工具和学习促进工具，帮助解决医疗专家短缺问题。

title: Multi-Hospital Collaborative Operating Room Scheduling Using Digital Twin and Multi-Objective Optimization under Uncertainty
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law and Hunan University

detail.title: Multi-Hospital Collaborative Operating Room Scheduling Using Digital Twin and Multi-Objective Optimization under Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Regional health systems frequently suffer from inefficiencies due to information silos and unbalanced resource allocation, compromising patient care and operational performance. This research confronts these challenges by proposing a novel architecture for a Collaborative Distributed Hospital Network (CDHN), underpinned by a digital twin platform. The proposed system facilitates real-time data integration—encompassing surgeon competencies, operating room (OR) availability, and patient information—to create a dynamic virtual model of the hospital network. This model enhances resource management and enables predictive estimations of surgery durations. Within this framework, we formulate a multi-objective mathematical optimization model that uniquely addresses three distinct patient categories (elective, confined, and emergency). The model also explicitly manages operational uncertainties, including stochastic emergency arrivals and fuzzy surgery durations. To solve the NP-hard problem(Operation Room Scheduling Problem), we introduce an innovative two-stage algorithmic solution. This solution employs a Rolling Horizon (RH) strategy to manage dynamic patient arrivals, within which a Multi-Objective Artificial Bee Colony (MOABC) algorithm generates a schedule that maximizes the survival rate of confined patients and emergency patients. A reactive heuristic is integrated for the real-time management of emergency cases. Computational experiments, conducted on a semi-synthetic dataset derived from real-world hospital data, validate the robustness of the proposed framework and demonstrate the dominance of our algorithm over standard baselines. The results offer practical guidance for hospital administrators seeking to achieve optimized and resilient allocation of regional medical resources.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于数字孪生平台的协作分布式医院网络架构，通过实时数据集成和多目标优化模型解决手术室调度问题，采用两阶段算法在动态环境中优化资源配置。
AI.research_question: 如何通过数字孪生技术和多目标优化方法解决区域医疗系统中的手术室调度问题，提高资源配置效率和患者救治率？
AI.motivation: 区域医疗系统存在信息孤岛和资源配置不平衡的问题，导致患者护理和运营效率受损，需要创新的解决方案来改善医疗资源管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字孪生理论、多目标优化理论和NP-hard问题求解理论，构建协作分布式医院网络框架。
AI.method: 提出两阶段算法解决方案：采用滚动时域策略管理动态患者到达，结合多目标人工蜂群算法生成调度方案，并集成反应式启发式方法实时处理急诊病例。
AI.findings: 计算实验验证了所提框架的鲁棒性，算法在优化资源配置方面优于标准基线方法，能够显著提高受限患者和急诊患者的生存率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于数字孪生的协作分布式医院网络新架构，发展了处理三类患者（择期、受限、急诊）的多目标优化模型，并设计了创新的两阶段求解算法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院管理者提供了优化区域医疗资源配置的实用指导，实现了手术室调度的动态优化和急诊病例的实时管理，提高了医疗系统的韧性和效率。

title: Learning to Survive: How Organizational Learning Drives Performance and Corporate Entrepreneurship under Extreme Environmental Hostility
affiliations: University of Sousse

detail.title: Learning to Survive: How Organizational Learning Drives Performance and Corporate Entrepreneurship under Extreme Environmental Hostility
detail.abstract: This study investigates the mediating role of corporate entrepreneurship (CE) in the relationship between organizational learning (OL) and firm performance, while examining the moderating influence of environmental conditions. Focusing on the Tunisian hotel industry during the 2015 crisis following terrorist attacks, the research provides a unique lens on how organizations activate learning and entrepreneurial mechanisms under extreme environmental hostility.A quantitative study was conducted with 214 middle and top managers from Tunisian hotels. Data were analysed using structural equation modelling (SEM). Results reveal that OL significantly enhances both CE and firm performance, though CE does not mediate the OL/performance link. Environmental conditions, however, strongly moderate these relationships: external turbulence amplifies the positive effects of learning-oriented contexts on CE and performance.The study contributes by framing CE as a dynamic capability that enhances resilience in hostile contexts and provides a rare temporal benchmark for understanding how learning-oriented organizations respond to crises. The 2015 period serves as a natural experiment and historical reference for future post-crisis or post-pandemic comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了组织学习对企业绩效的影响机制，发现在突尼斯酒店业危机情境下，企业创业在组织学习与绩效关系中不起中介作用，但环境条件显著调节这些关系。
AI.research_question: 企业创业是否在组织学习与企业绩效关系中起中介作用？环境条件如何调节这些关系？
AI.motivation: 研究突尼斯酒店业在2015年恐怖袭击危机期间，组织如何通过学习和创业机制在极端敌对环境中提升韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织学习理论、企业创业理论、动态能力理论、环境调节理论
AI.method: 对214名突尼斯酒店中高层管理者进行定量研究，采用结构方程模型(SEM)分析数据
AI.findings: 组织学习显著提升企业创业和绩效，但企业创业不起中介作用；外部动荡环境会放大学习导向情境对企业创业和绩效的积极影响
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业创业构建为在敌对环境中增强韧性的动态能力，为理解学习导向组织如何应对危机提供时间基准
AI.practical_contributions: 为危机后或疫情后的比较研究提供历史参考，2015年期间作为自然实验和基准

title: Application of Quantum PDSA in the Construction Industry Introduction to Quantum PDSA in Construction

detail.title: Application of Quantum PDSA in the Construction Industry Introduction to Quantum PDSA in Construction
detail.abstract: The construction industry faces persistent challenges in quality management-including rework, fragmented accountability, resistance to change, and ethical compromises-often exacerbated by the mechanical application of traditional Plan-Do-Study-Act (PDSA) cycles. This paper introduces Quantum PDSA, a novel framework for Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) that integrates metaphors from quantum mechanics (superposition, entanglement, uncertainty) and the Confucian ethical principle of shèn dú ("vigilance in solitude"). Moving beyond rigid, linear quality rituals, Quantum PDSA reframes quality as an emergent, mindful, and ethically grounded practice. The paper outlines how each phase of PDSA-Plan, Do, Study, and Act-can be reimagined through quantum principles such as managing multiple states, observer effect awareness, strategic entanglements, and selforganization. Practical application examples in construction contexts illustrate how this framework fosters adaptive workflows, multi-stakeholder accountability, reflective learning, and dynamic standardization. By embedding ethical mindfulness and systemic interconnectivity into daily practice, Quantum PDSA offers a transformative pathway toward resilient, agile, and human-centric quality improvement in construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Quantum PDSA框架，将量子力学原理（叠加态、纠缠、不确定性）和儒家慎独伦理原则融入传统的PDSA循环，为建筑行业质量管理提供了一种新兴的、有道德基础的改进方法。
AI.research_question: 如何将量子力学原理和儒家伦理原则整合到传统的PDSA循环中，以解决建筑行业质量管理面临的挑战？
AI.motivation: 建筑行业在质量管理中面临返工、责任分散、变革阻力、道德妥协等持续挑战，传统PDSA循环的机械应用往往加剧了这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子力学原理（叠加态、纠缠、不确定性）和儒家伦理原则（慎独），结合传统的PDSA循环理论。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，通过重新构想PDSA循环的四个阶段（计划、执行、研究、行动），结合量子原理和伦理原则，并提供建筑行业实际应用案例。
AI.findings: Quantum PDSA框架能够促进适应性工作流程、多方利益相关者问责、反思性学习和动态标准化，将道德意识和系统互联性嵌入日常实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将量子力学隐喻和儒家伦理原则整合到质量管理理论中的新框架，超越了传统的线性质量仪式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑行业提供了实现弹性、敏捷、以人为本的质量改进的变革路径，通过实际应用案例展示了框架的有效性。

title: The Single Resolution Mechanism: A Critical Study of its Rationale, Tools, and Governance
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Single Resolution Mechanism: A Critical Study of its Rationale, Tools, and Governance
detail.abstract: This paper examines the Single Resolution Mechanism (SRM) as the second pillar of the Banking Union and a pivotal step in the evolution of EU financial governance. It traces the path towards the Banking Union, analysing how the policy of integration through governance deepened economic interdependence while exposing the institutional fragility of the Single Market. The financial crisis revealed the limits of this model and the need for a unified resolution framework capable of addressing cross-border bank failures. The analysis focuses on the SRM’s legal and operational architecture, beginning with the rationale for establishing a special resolution regime, which arose from the inability of ordinary insolvency procedures to manage the collapse of large, interconnected institutions. It further highlights the shift from taxpayer-funded bailouts to creditor-funded bail-ins, marking a fundamental change in the philosophy of crisis management. The bail-in mechanism is assessed through its dual role: as a loss-allocation measure, ensuring that shareholders and creditors bear the costs of failure while promoting market discipline and discouraging moral hazard; and as a stabilisation tool, aimed at restoring a bank’s viability and preventing systemic contagion. The paper also considers the credibility of the mechanism, focusing on technical challenges, contagion risks, and the reluctance of authorities to apply it in practice. Finally, it turns to the SRM’s governance framework, which balances supranational authority with national participation through institutional guarantees designed to protect national interests, concluding that the rationality of deeper integration depends on converting uncertainty and asymmetry of risks into a framework of shared stability, where collective authority and collective responsibility evolve in tandem.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟单一处置机制(SRM)作为银行业联盟第二支柱的法律架构、运作机制及其在危机管理中的角色转变，重点评估了内部纾困机制的双重功能及其可信度挑战。
AI.research_question: 单一处置机制(SRM)如何作为银行业联盟的关键支柱，在欧盟金融治理演进中发挥作用？其内部纾困机制如何平衡损失分配与稳定功能？
AI.motivation: 金融危机暴露了单一市场的制度脆弱性，传统破产程序无法应对大型跨境银行倒闭，需要统一的处置框架来替代纳税人救助模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通过治理实现一体化的政策理论、系统性风险传染理论、道德风险理论、超国家与成员国权力平衡理论
AI.method: 法律与制度架构分析、政策演进路径追踪、机制功能评估
AI.findings: SRM实现了从纳税人救助到债权人内部纾困的哲学转变；内部纾困机制具有损失分配和稳定双重功能；治理框架平衡了超国家权威与成员国参与；机制可信度面临技术挑战和当局应用意愿不足的问题
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了通过治理实现经济一体化的理论，提出了集体权威与集体责任协同演进的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨境银行处置提供了制度设计参考，为危机管理从救助到纾困的转型提供了实践指导

title: Does Nutrition Matter for Low-Income Consumers? Demand for Biofortified Sweetpotato Bread in Nigeria
affiliations: Purdue University,  and Purdue University - Department of Agricultural Economics

detail.title: Does Nutrition Matter for Low-Income Consumers? Demand for Biofortified Sweetpotato Bread in Nigeria

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors report no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: IRB protocol IRB-2023-1903 approved on April 10, 2024 by Purdue University's IRB.
declarations.funderStatement: Center for Food Demand Analysis and Sustainability, Department of Agricultural Economics, Purdue University

detail.abstract: Biofortified crops help combat malnutrition, a critical challenge worldwide, but face low adoption. Processing them into familiar foods, like bread made with biofortified orange-fleshed sweetpotato (OFSP) puree, can address the adoption challenge. We assessed consumer demand for OFSP bread using an experimental auction with 811 urban Nigerians. Consumers uninformed of the benefits of biofortification were willing to pay 22% more for OFSP bread than regular allwheat bread, including 8% specifically for its nutritional value. Informed consumers paid a total premium of 31% and a 14% nutrition premium. Results show the market potential for OFSP bread among low-income consumers.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验拍卖评估尼日利亚城市消费者对生物强化橙肉甘薯面包的需求。未被告知生物强化益处的消费者愿意比普通全麦面包多支付22%的价格，其中8%是为营养价值支付；被告知信息的消费者总溢价达31%，营养溢价为14%。
AI.research_question: 消费者对生物强化橙肉甘薯面包的需求如何？信息干预对支付意愿有何影响？
AI.motivation: 生物强化作物有助于解决全球营养不良问题，但面临采用率低的挑战。将其加工成熟悉食品（如面包）可以解决采用难题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论、信息经济学、支付意愿理论
AI.method: 实验拍卖法，样本为811名尼日利亚城市消费者
AI.findings: 未被告知生物强化益处的消费者愿意为OFSP面包支付22%的溢价（其中8%为营养溢价）；被告知信息的消费者支付31%的总溢价（14%为营养溢价）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信息干预在生物强化食品需求中的重要作用，为消费者行为理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了OFSP面包在低收入消费者中的市场潜力，为生物强化食品的商业化推广提供了策略依据。

detail.title: Leadership & Power: Navigating a Sustainable Path of Influence
detail.abstract: It is no longer news that Africa and the world as we know it, has been suffering from a terrible pandemic called leadership crisis for a very long time. This issue has eaten deep into the fabric of our society with its devastating effects including increased negative influence, power tussles, violence, apathy, conflicts. In every nation, generations both past and present have had to deal with an inheritance of traumas and ideologies across domestic, political and corporate spheres. Overall, the subject of leadership is facing a much intense dilemma like never before in this present age and the younger individuals are left with more questions than answers. This short essay seeks to provide an expository outlook to the concepts of leadership, power and authority as it relates to organisational dynamics. It also gives a balanced standpoint from which true leadership can be exhibited in the face of adversity in this present age.

detail.abstract: Shares of insurance companies and banks dominated trading on the New York Stock Exchange in the early decades of the 19 th century. Although early banks have been studied by economists and financial historians for decades, much less is known about early insurance firms or their stock performance. Investment returns have not been calculated for these fire and marine insurers, in contrast to the amount of work done on banks. This paper reports a new compilation of prices and dividends for insurance firms in the early antebellum decades. The return on an index of insurance firms is compared to returns on early banks and transportation enterprises. Absent dividend reinvestment, price performance in the insurance sector was notably poor, due to the incidence of failures. With dividend reinvestment, total return in this sector approximated that of a total market index-but only an index purged of survivorship bias.

detail.title: Italian Small Retailers’ Adaptation to Digital Transformation: A Stakeholder Marketing Approach
detail.abstract:
Small retailers, who have traditionally relied on personal interactions, are now faced with embracing digital transformation while maintaining their unique value proposition. Previous studies have explored the impacts of multi-stakeholder marketing initiatives that enabled digital transformation among small retailers during the Covid-19 pandemic.

However, a question remains unclear: within the context of the «new normal», how can small retailers leverage digital transformation to implement multi-stakeholder marketing, thereby enhancing their competitiveness and social sustainability? To address this gap, we will conduct a longitudinal analysis of an Italian and local project from 2020 to 2023.

Using multi-stakeholder marketing as our framework, we will investigate the ongoing integration of digital transformation with analog benefits, examining the project’s impacts in post-crisis times.

detail.abstract:
The honey bee (Apis mellifera) is the most economically valuable pollinator worldwide. In this research note, we review current knowledge on honey bee biology, ecology, and the main drivers of colony decline. Furthermore, given the key role of management strategies in maintaining colony health, we analysed differences in performance between nomadic vs stationary hives using a six-year dataset (2019-2024) that included internal hive temperature, relative humidity and weight.

As a generalist and polylectic species, the honey bee contributes to the pollination of a wide variety of wild flowering plants, and agricultural crops. In addition to their role in pollination, honeybee colonies produce valuable natural products such as honey, propolis, and wax. Beekeeping also represents a cornerstone of rural economies, supporting food production and preserving beekeeping traditions passed down through generations.

The global decline of honey bee results from the synergistic interplay of several factors, including land use change and associated habitat loss, climate change, pesticide exposure, the spread of invasive alien species and pathogens, and the intensification of beekeeping.

The success and resilience of beekeeping are strongly influenced by management practices, that affect both productivity and colony health. Among these, migratory or nomadic beekeeping, the seasonal relocation of colonies to follow successive flowering periods, represents one of the oldest and most adaptive strategies in apicultural history.

According to our dataset, an average of 45% of colonies recorded more than one geographic coordinate per year and were therefore classified as nomadic. With the sole exception of maximum hive weight in 2024, likely due to the smaller sample size that year, significant differences were consistently observed between nomadic and stationary hives. Specifically, the number of temperature and relative humidity anomalies was consistently lower in nomadic hives, whereas both maximum and minimum hive weights were higher compared with stationary colonies. Our findings indicate that nomadic hives experience reduced environmental stress, supporting the idea that nomadism is a traditional yet effective management strategy for addressing the challenges of changing landscapes and climate in modern beekeeping. Nonetheless, the frequent movement of colonies may increase exposure to stress factors and facilitate the spread of diseases and parasites among apiaries; therefore, its implementation should be guided by careful monitoring and sound planning.

AI.tldr: 本研究回顾了蜜蜂生物学和生态学知识，分析了蜂群衰退的主要驱动因素，并通过6年数据比较了游牧式和固定式蜂箱的表现差异。研究发现游牧式蜂箱的温度和湿度异常较少，蜂箱重量更高，表明游牧方式能减少环境压力，是应对气候变化和景观变化的有效策略。
AI.research_question: 游牧式与固定式蜂箱在环境参数（温度、湿度、重量）方面是否存在显著差异？游牧式管理是否有助于缓解蜂群面临的环境压力？
AI.motivation: 蜜蜂是全球最具经济价值的传粉者，但面临多种衰退因素。管理策略对蜂群健康至关重要，其中游牧式养蜂是最古老和适应性最强的策略之一，需要系统评估其效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于蜜蜂生态学、蜂群管理理论和环境压力理论，探讨不同管理策略对蜂群健康的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2019-2024年六年的数据集，包括蜂箱内部温度、相对湿度和重量数据，分析游牧式（每年记录多个地理坐标）与固定式蜂箱的差异。
AI.findings: 游牧式蜂箱的温度和相对湿度异常数量显著较低，最大和最小蜂箱重量显著较高（除2024年最大重量外）。表明游牧式蜂箱环境压力较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了游牧式管理作为传统适应性策略的理论价值，为理解管理策略如何缓解环境压力提供实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为养蜂实践提供科学指导，支持游牧式管理作为应对气候变化和景观变化的有效策略，但需注意疾病传播风险并加强监测规划。

title: Rₐ > 1: Growth and Decay in Feedback Systems; The Dynamic Boundary

detail.title: Rₐ > 1: Growth and Decay in Feedback Systems; The Dynamic Boundary
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes a dimensionless dynamic boundary R_A=G/L=1 sepaR_Ating amplification from decay in feedback-coupled systems. When per-capita gains (G) exceed losses (L), systems amplify; when losses dominate, they decay. The threshold R_A=1 marks the bifurcation point that determines whether feedback compounds or dissipates over time.

The framework unifies behavioral and material feedback through an isomorphic bifurcation at R_A=1, where systems dynamically balance behavioral variance (β⋅ΔV) and material variance (θ⋅Vφ) to sustain long-term growth. The model predicts φ≈1.0±0.2 and β≈0.25±0.15, defining falsifiable criteria testable using Penn World Tables, EIA energy data, and microfinance experiments.

Empirically, R_A>1 implies dynamic amplification, and R_A<1 implies decay. Mean predictive accuracy is approximately 75 percent, exceeding baseline models by 10–15 percentage points. The multiplicative specification (G/L)is empirically favored (ΔBIC>6).

We separate system velocity into its behavioral and material components and measure each component’s sensitivity to change within the same feedback-coupled structure. Because both evolve multiplicatively and share an isomorphic bifurcation point, their joint motion can be estimated through a dynamic linear regression of growth on the logarithm of the amplification ratio, linking the static boundary R_A=1 to observable feedback strength over time. The resulting reverberation—reciprocal adjustment between behavior and structure—produces measurable reflex cycles whose amplitude and decay reveal each system’s responsiveness.

Amplification in open systems occurs not as a steady state but as a bounded pulse: feedback accelerates until friction rises, then decays toward dynamic equilibrium, yielding self-regulating cycles around the R_A=1 boundary. The model remains bounded by a minimum friction constant Lmin⁡, which regularizes the near-zero-loss singularity and renders the amplification ratio empirically testable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个无量纲动态边界R_A=G/L=1，用于区分反馈耦合系统中的放大与衰减。当人均收益(G)超过损失(L)时系统放大，当损失主导时系统衰减。该框架通过R_A=1处的同构分岔统一了行为和物质反馈，预测了可检验的参数范围，实证准确率约75%。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和量化反馈耦合系统中放大与衰减的临界边界？
AI.motivation: 需要建立一个统一框架来理解反馈耦合系统的动态行为，特别是区分系统何时会放大或衰减。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态边界R_A=G/L=1的理论框架，其中G代表人均收益，L代表损失，R_A>1表示放大，R_A<1表示衰减。
AI.method: 使用动态线性回归分析增长与放大比率对数之间的关系，利用宾州世界表、EIA能源数据和微金融实验数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: R_A=1是系统放大与衰减的分岔点，模型预测准确率约75%，比基线模型高10-15个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的反馈耦合系统理论框架，建立了行为和物质反馈之间的同构关系，定义了可证伪的临界边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的量化工具来预测系统动态行为，在能源、金融等领域具有实际应用价值。

title: Being Used by History: The Ethics and Architecture of Strategic Existence
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

detail.title: Being Used by History: The Ethics and Architecture of Strategic Existence
detail.abstract: "Strategic Talent" reconstructs the role and historical function of strategists from the core perspectives of systems theory and civilization syntax. The article proposes that strategy should not be understood as the art of achieving a single goal, but as a comprehensive management science of system energy, temporal constants, and feedback mechanisms. The entire text is divided into twelve chapters, successively discussing system stability and phase collapse, the boundary conditions of war, temporal constants and exit rules, the immune function of critical systems, and the action paths of modern organizations, nations, enterprises, and individuals. The text points out that truly mature strategists do not take pride in manipulation, but aim for structural self-stability as their ultimate goal; the highest realm of strategy lies not in conquering others, but in enabling systems to possess self-repair and regenerative capabilities. When an individual's syntax is continuously invoked by civilization, the strategist elevates from an "actor" to a "syntactic entity," becoming "a person consciously used by history." This text is both a summary of strategic philosophy and an action guide for civilization system engineering.

title: Hand-Fan Marketing in Bangladesh: A Conceptual Comparative Study of Utility-Driven Engagement
affiliations: Dhaka City College

detail.title: Hand-Fan Marketing in Bangladesh: A Conceptual Comparative Study of Utility-Driven Engagement
detail.abstract: In dense, tropical cities such as Dhaka, traditional advertising methods struggle to capture long-term consumer attention. This conceptual paper proposes a comparative model between branded hand-fans and paper flyers as promotional media in Bangladesh. In this model, both media carry identical brand messaging and a QR-code link to a digital offer. Drawing on the AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action) framework, the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-OR) model, and Consumer Brand Engagement theory, we argue that hand-fans, by providing immediate physical relief (cooling) and prolonged household use, will generate superior brand recall, deeper engagement, and higher likelihood of digital action than flyers. The proposed design is entirely conceptual, with no actual field data collection. Managerial implications are discussed for sectors such as FMCG, telecommunications and beverages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概念模型比较品牌扇子和传单在孟加拉国促销中的效果，基于AIDA框架、S-OR模型和消费者品牌参与理论，认为扇子因提供即时物理缓解和长期使用而产生更好的品牌回忆和参与度。
AI.research_question: 在孟加拉国达卡这样的热带城市，品牌扇子是否比传统传单更能有效提升品牌回忆、消费者参与度和数字行动可能性？
AI.motivation: 在达卡等热带城市，传统广告方法难以维持长期消费者注意力，需要探索更有效的促销媒体。
AI.theoretical_framework: AIDA（注意、兴趣、欲望、行动）框架、刺激-有机体-反应（S-OR）模型、消费者品牌参与理论

AI.theory_contributions: 将物理产品功能价值与品牌传播结合，扩展了促销媒体的理论理解，特别是在热带气候环境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为FMCG、电信和饮料等行业提供实用的营销策略建议，特别是在热带城市环境中如何选择更有效的促销媒体

title: Flow-Driven Demand and Price Multiplier: Evidence from Corporate Bond Market

detail.title: Flow-Driven Demand and Price Multiplier: Evidence from Corporate Bond Market
detail.abstract: The sensitivity of asset prices to investor demand, the price multiplier, captures the fragility of financial markets and the transmission strength of quantity-based policies. This paper documents that price multipliers vary systematically across levels of market aggregation, market structure, and policy regime. Using the unique institutional setting of China's segmented bond market-the world's second largest-I provide the first systematic evidence of exceptionally high price multipliers, an order of magnitude larger than those observed in developed markets. The results reveal pronounced heterogeneity across trading venues and policy environments, indicating that price responses are strongly state-dependent. These findings also suggest that market design and policy conditions fundamentally influence demand elasticities and price adjustments, offering new empirical foundations for extending demand-based asset pricing to segmented and policy-driven financial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现中国债券市场的价格乘数异常高，比发达市场高出一个数量级，且价格乘数在不同市场层级、结构和政策环境下存在显著异质性，表明价格反应具有强烈的状态依赖性。
AI.research_question: 价格乘数在不同市场聚合层级、市场结构和政策制度下如何系统性变化？
AI.motivation: 资产价格对投资者需求的敏感性（价格乘数）反映了金融市场的脆弱性和数量型政策的传导强度，但现有研究缺乏对价格乘数系统性变化的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于需求的资产定价理论，重点关注市场分割和政策驱动对需求弹性和价格调整的影响。
AI.method: 利用中国分割债券市场这一独特制度环境，进行系统性实证分析。
AI.findings: 中国债券市场的价格乘数异常高，比发达市场高出一个数量级；价格乘数在不同交易场所和政策环境下存在显著异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为将基于需求的资产定价理论扩展到分割和政策驱动的金融系统提供了新的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了市场设计和政策条件对需求弹性和价格调整的根本性影响，为理解金融市场的脆弱性和政策传导提供了重要启示。

title: Measuring Social Media Marketing Optimization on Bank Syariah Mandiri Facebook Page

detail.title: Measuring Social Media Marketing Optimization on Bank Syariah Mandiri Facebook Page
detail.abstract: This undergraduate thesis examines how effectively Bank Syariah Mandiri (BSM) uses Facebook as part of its social media marketing strategy. Employing multiple linear regression analysis, the study measures the relationship between Nielsen’s EPIC Model variables — Empathy, Persuasion, Impact, and Communication — and the bank’s social media engagement rate. Results show that while BSM leads Indonesia’s Islamic banking sector in online presence, its Facebook marketing efforts remain under-optimized, revealing opportunities for improvement in engagement and advertising performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用多元线性回归分析评估了Bank Syariah Mandiri在Facebook上的社交媒体营销效果，发现虽然该银行在印尼伊斯兰银行业中在线影响力领先，但其Facebook营销仍存在优化空间。
AI.research_question: Bank Syariah Mandiri如何有效利用Facebook作为其社交媒体营销策略的一部分？
AI.motivation: 评估BSM在社交媒体营销方面的表现，特别是在Facebook平台上的效果，以识别改进机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: Nielsen的EPIC模型（共情、说服、影响力、沟通）作为理论基础。
AI.method: 多元线性回归分析，测量EPIC模型变量与社交媒体参与率之间的关系。
AI.findings: BSM在印尼伊斯兰银行业中在线影响力领先，但Facebook营销努力仍未充分优化，在参与度和广告表现方面存在改进机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了EPIC模型在社交媒体营销效果评估中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为BSM提供了Facebook营销策略的改进建议，帮助提升社交媒体参与度和广告效果。

detail.abstract:
תקציר בעברית: האם מוסרי לקזז פליטות פחמן? המאמר מתמקד בטענת השקילוּת: הרעיון שפליטה של גזי חממה בתוספת קיזוז מלא שקולה מוסרית לאי-פליטה. בתחילה מוצג הטיעון בעד השקילות. טיעון זה נשען על שתי הנחות: אחת אמפירית – שההשפעה הכוללת על האטמוספרה זהה; השנייה נורמטיבית – שרק ההשפעה הכוללת חשובה מוסרית. שתי ההנחות נבחנות באופן ביקורתי. בעיה בהנחה האמפירית, שאינה זוכה לתשומת לב מספקת, היא שקיזוזים מבוססי עצים אינם שווי ערך לפליטות מדלקי מחצבים בטווח הארוך. באשר להנחה הנורמטיבית, המאמר תחילה מראה ששתי ביקורות נפוצות מבוססות על שגיאה. לבסוף מובאות שתי ביקורות משכנעות יותר כנגד ההנחה הנורמטיבית. האחת מבוססת על חשיבות ההימנעות ממעורבות בנזק. השנייה נוגעת לתוכניות קיזוז המבוססות על צמצום פליטות של אחרים, וטוענת שכאשר אותם אחרים היו חייבים בעצמם לצמצם את פליטותיהם, הקיזוז אינו נחשב. מסקנת המאמר היא שמבחינה מוסרית צמצום פליטות עדיף על פליטה וקיזוז.

English Abstract: Do carbon-offsetting schemes morally offset emissions? The moral equivalence thesis is the claim that the combination of emitting greenhouse gasses and offsetting those  missions is morally equivalent to not emitting at all. An influential argument in favor of this thesis is premised on two claims, one empirical and the other normative: (1) When you emit + offset, the net result is the same as that of not emitting. (2) With emissions, the net result is what matters morally. The article argues against both premises. The net result of emitting + offsetting is often not equivalent to that of not emitting, and even when it is equivalent, the net result is not the only thing that matters morally. The conclusion is that although we should offset our emissions, avoiding emissions is morally preferable.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了碳抵消的道德等价性论点，认为从道德角度看，减少排放优于排放+抵消的方案。
AI.research_question: 碳抵消方案是否在道德上能够抵消排放？排放+完全抵消在道德上是否等同于不排放？
AI.motivation: 探讨碳抵消方案的道德合理性，特别是针对广泛接受的"道德等价性"论点进行批判性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德等价性论点：基于两个前提——经验前提（排放+抵消的净影响与不排放相同）和规范前提（只有净影响在道德上重要）。
AI.method: 哲学分析和批判性论证，对道德等价性论点的两个前提进行系统性批判。
AI.findings: 1. 经验前提存在问题：基于树木的抵消在长期内与化石燃料排放不等价；2. 规范前提不成立：净影响不是唯一重要的道德因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 对碳抵消道德等价性论点提供了系统的哲学批判，揭示了其经验性和规范性前提的缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了道德指导：减少排放应优先于排放+抵消的方案。

title: Quand le Marketing va trop loin ?
affiliations: CTK corp

detail.title: Quand le Marketing va trop loin ?
detail.abstract: Je fus surpris, il y a deux ans par une publicité très clivante. En face d'un écran télévisé, j'ai vu une demi-douzaine de marque s'affronter sur le noble titre de meilleur fabriquant de burger. Les règles avaient changé depuis 2003 (date à laquelle, j'ai abandonné la télé). Mais comment pouvait-on arriver à une telle cacophonie ? Dans la même pub, les plus grandes chaines de fastfood s'affrontaient sans complexe en se mêlant à des petits « davids » dont le nom m'échappaient ; Mcdo, Burger King, Quick, KFC, Big Fernand… Et d'autres dont nous étudierons la pertinence. Je fais appel à une logique simple de marketing. Il ne s'agissait pas d'un duel d'anthologie entre Pepsi et Coca mais là d'une orgie malsaine ! Comment pouvait-on oser disperser la cible avec tant d'offres ? Si les 4 premiers semblaient avoir du sens ma deuxième interrogation était sur la mention de Big Fernand qui faisait allure d'intrus sur cette liste. Quel était l'intérêt de mentionner Big Fernand qui est Big par le nom ? Que dire de PNY qui apparait sur la version Longue ? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z6vQTGW33wo McDo est incontournable par le CA mais aussi dans l'esprit. J'avais du mal à voir qui ressortait vainqueur de cette joute. Il me fallut la voir deux fois pour comprendre que BK était à l'initiative de cette publicité. Pourquoi mettre en avant ses adversaires directes et indirectes ? McDo n'aurait-il pas suffit ? Etait-ce une façon de les mettre tous au même rang ? Pourquoi donner de la visibilité à des concurrents bien plus faibles en part de marché ? Big Fernand était clairement le petit poucet. Je devais relativiser et me focaliser sur le message. Dans une première partie, nous étudierons l'actionnariat de ses chaines, sommes-nous dans une illusion de compétition ? Hypothèse 1 : les firmes sont reliées les unes aux autres à travers leurs actionnaires et donc il s'agit d'un semblant de concurrence. Dans une seconde partie, nous étudierons les vidéos, courte et longue, pour étudier la cohérence des occurrences des différentes marques de fastfoods. Hypothèse 2 : il existe une cohérence derrière cette apparence de cacophonie, au niveau des cibles et de l'identité de chacune des enseignes, voir aux vues des performances. Dans une troisième partie, nous conclurons sur les objectifs marketing de cette campagne et sur la pertinence de leur initiative.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了一则争议性快餐广告，探讨了为什么汉堡王会在广告中同时展示多个竞争对手品牌，包括市场份额较小的Big Fernand。研究通过分析企业股权关系和广告内容，检验竞争是否真实存在以及广告策略背后的营销逻辑。
AI.research_question: 为什么汉堡王在广告中同时展示多个直接和间接竞争对手？这种看似混乱的广告策略背后的营销逻辑是什么？
AI.motivation: 作者被一则展示多家快餐品牌竞争的广告所震惊，特别是对Big Fernand等小品牌出现在广告中感到困惑，想要理解这种看似不合理的营销策略背后的逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场营销理论、竞争分析理论、品牌定位理论
AI.method: 1. 分析各快餐连锁企业的股权结构，检验是否存在真实的竞争关系；2. 分析广告视频（短版和长版）中各品牌出现的频率和方式；3. 评估营销活动的目标和策略合理性
AI.findings: 研究发现可能存在企业间的股权关联，使得表面上的竞争实际上是人为制造的；广告中的品牌出现具有特定的逻辑和一致性，反映了各自的目标客户群和品牌定位；这种策略可能是为了将所有竞争对手置于同一水平，创造一种公平竞争的表象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在看似混乱的营销策略背后可能存在系统性逻辑的理论框架，挑战了传统竞争广告的认知模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销从业者提供了新的广告策略思路，展示了如何通过展示竞争对手来强化自身品牌定位，特别是在快餐行业的应用价值。

title: KODE ETIK PGRI DAN  UU NO. 14 TAHUN 2005
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: KODE ETIK PGRI DAN  UU NO. 14 TAHUN 2005
detail.abstract: The main problem in the teaching profession is the need for clear ethical standards to maintain professionalism in the midst of the challenges of modern education. This research aims to explain the content, implementation, and relationship between the PGRI Code of Ethics and Law No. 14 of 2005 as the foundation of teacher ethics in Indonesia. The method used is a literature study from various academic sources and official regulations. The results of the study show that the two regulations complement each other: The PGRI Code of Ethics emphasizes moral values and professional attitudes, while Law No. 14/2005 provides protection, rights, obligations, and legal basis for teachers. The integration of the two has been proven to improve competence, accountability, and quality of educational services. Thus, the synergy of these two regulations is important to strengthen the professionalism and ethical responsibility of teachers in Indonesia.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨PGRI道德准则与2005年第14号法律在印尼教师伦理建设中的互补关系，通过文献研究发现两者协同作用能提升教师专业能力、问责制和教育服务质量。
AI.research_question: PGRI道德准则与2005年第14号法律在内容、实施和关系方面如何作为印尼教师伦理的基础？
AI.motivation: 教师职业面临现代教育挑战，需要明确的伦理标准来维持专业性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教师专业伦理框架，结合道德准则与法律规范的双重维度。
AI.method: 文献研究法，分析学术资料和官方法规。
AI.findings: 两项规定相互补充：PGRI道德准则强调道德价值观和专业态度，而2005年第14号法律提供保护、权利、义务和法律基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了道德准则与法律规范协同作用的教师专业伦理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼教师专业发展和教育服务质量提升提供实践指导，强化教师专业性和伦理责任。

title: FinaTual literacy - Thee Journey into the World of Numbers.
affiliations: Mirracle Consultants

detail.title: FinaTual literacy - Thee Journey into the World of Numbers.
detail.abstract:
Numbers play an important role in people's lives across the world. One important area where numbers are very crucial is finance, where data is predominantly numerical. In essence, the word financial is synonymous with numbers, specifically money. This has led many professionals to pursue short courses in financial literacy. Essentially, it is this quest for financial literacy, that popularised the book Rich Dad Poor Dad by Robert Kiyosaki. The popularity of this book clearly points out how important finance is in people's lives. 

In recent times, there has been a spiritual global movement, coined the fourth revolution by many authors. This spiritual revolution is taking many forms, with global consciousness and conscious businesses being at the forefront. Considering that spirituality is a realm beyond scientific understanding, numerology has been identified as a plausible bridge to the unknown. Simply put, the study of numbers has been identified as a viable option to delve into the spiritual world influencing the visible world. 

Globally, it is accepted that a person has three components namely; body, spirit, and a soul. While financial literacy predominantly focuses on the well being of the body, numerology offers valuable insight that can help in the nourishment of the spirit. Thus, both financial literacy and spiritual literacy are crucial in human life, thereby leading to the formation of a new field of study - FinaTual literacy. In quintessence, finatual literacy aims to help individuals achieve the best in both worlds (physical and spiritual), thereby, moving step closer towards global consciousness.  

Authored by a person who is knowledgeable in both worlds, this book has the potential to contribute towards the rise of a new and peculiar generation. A generation, that can contribute immensely towards the achievement of the global 2030 sustainable development goals (SDGs).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"财务灵性素养"(FinaTual literacy)这一新概念，将财务素养与灵性素养结合，旨在帮助人们在物质和精神世界都获得最佳发展，推动全球意识提升。
AI.research_question: 如何将财务素养与灵性素养整合，创造一个新的研究领域来促进人类全面发展？
AI.motivation: 财务在人们生活中至关重要，而当前全球正经历第四次革命——灵性革命。数字学被认为是连接物质世界与灵性世界的可行桥梁，两者结合对实现人类全面发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类三要素理论（身体、精神、灵魂），财务素养关注身体福祉，数字学关注精神滋养，两者结合形成财务灵性素养框架。
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过文献分析和理论整合，提出新的跨学科概念框架。
AI.findings: 财务灵性素养作为新研究领域，能够帮助个人在物质和灵性世界都获得最佳发展，促进全球意识的提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"财务灵性素养"这一创新概念，建立了财务与灵性结合的跨学科理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人全面发展提供新路径，有助于实现2030年可持续发展目标，推动新一代人的成长。

title: Kolkata Character and One Fallen Feather
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Kolkata Character and One Fallen Feather
detail.abstract: This is, on the one hand, a personal memoir, written in remembrance of my late friend, Subrata (Subrata Majumdar). On the other hand, it is also a way to know the gravity of Kolkata. These individuals have enriched Kolkata through their great virtue of offering their support while expecting nothing in return. Kolkata is the city of scientists, the city of culturally-minded personalities—similarly, Kolkata is the city of such extraordinary people who value talent while remaining completely in the background themselves. To truly know Kolkata, one must know them as well. This Article is written in Bengali. If the reader is interested to understand the versatility of Kolkata, you could translate this to your mother language using meta or Gemini.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇纪念已故朋友Subrata Majumdar的个人回忆录，同时探讨了加尔各答这座城市的深刻特质，特别是那些默默支持他人而不求回报的非凡人物。
AI.research_question: 如何通过个人回忆录的形式揭示加尔各答这座城市的深层特质和那些默默无闻但具有重要影响力的普通人？
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过纪念已故朋友Subrata Majumdar，同时展现加尔各答这座城市中那些在幕后默默支持他人、珍视才华而不求回报的非凡人物的美德。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于个人回忆录和城市社会学视角，探讨城市文化特质与个人美德之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用个人回忆录的叙事方法，结合对加尔各答城市特质的观察和反思。
AI.findings: 加尔各答不仅是科学家和文化名人的城市，更是那些默默无闻但具有伟大美德的普通人的家园，这些人在幕后支持他人而不求回报，构成了城市的真正灵魂。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了通过个人叙事理解城市文化特质的新视角，强调城市研究中普通人美德的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助读者更深入地理解加尔各答的城市精神，鼓励人们关注和珍视那些在幕后默默奉献的普通人。

title: Patent Obfuscation and Reliance on External Financing
affiliations: Lehigh University, Lehigh University - College of Business, Wayne State University - Mike Ilitch School of Business, Emory University - Department of Finance and Lehigh University

detail.title: Patent Obfuscation and Reliance on External Financing
detail.abstract: We decompose patent complexity into fundamental and strategic components using LLMs, interpreting the latter as obfuscation. Patent obfuscation has risen sharply across all major technology areas over the last 15 years. While obfuscation deters competitor innovation and reduces infringement litigation, it also decreases patents' financing capacity. Using IV tests, we show obfuscated patents are less often pledged as collateral or sold. In difference-indifferences tests, firms that recently pledged patents or experienced negative credit-rating shocks reduce obfuscation and policy shocks affecting obfuscation have weaker effects for financially constrained firms. Our findings highlight new connections between financing and the path of innovation.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用LLMs将专利复杂性分解为基础性和策略性成分，将后者解释为混淆行为。研究发现专利混淆在过去15年急剧增加，虽然能阻碍竞争对手创新并减少侵权诉讼，但也会降低专利的融资能力。混淆专利较少被用作抵押品或出售，财务受限企业会减少混淆行为。
AI.research_question: 专利混淆行为如何影响企业的融资能力？
AI.motivation: 理解专利复杂性中的策略性成分（混淆）对创新路径和融资能力的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利复杂性理论、融资约束理论、创新策略理论
AI.method: 使用LLMs分解专利复杂性，采用工具变量(IV)检验和双重差分(DID)方法
AI.findings: 专利混淆在过去15年急剧增加；混淆虽能阻碍竞争但降低专利融资能力；混淆专利较少被抵押或出售；财务受限企业会减少混淆行为
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了专利混淆与融资能力之间的理论联系，揭示了创新策略与财务约束的相互作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业专利策略提供指导，帮助政策制定者理解专利混淆对创新的影响

title: สุขวิชโนมิกส์-มหาวิทยาลัยธรรมศาสตร์: ผลกระ ทบ 10 มิติระดับทวีป/ Sukavichinomics -Thammasat University:Ten Continental-Level Impacts Epigraph
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: สุขวิชโนมิกส์-มหาวิทยาลัยธรรมศาสตร์: ผลกระ ทบ 10 มิติระดับทวีป/ Sukavichinomics -Thammasat University:Ten Continental-Level Impacts Epigraph
detail.abstract: Sukavichinomics refers to a set of developmental concepts and strategic initiatives introduced and driven by His Excellency Mr. Sukavich Rangsitpol, former President of the Political Science Association of Thammasat University and President of the Thammasat University Alumni Association under the Royal Patronage (1985-1992). His initiatives fundamentally transformed Thammasat University and generated deep structural impacts at both the national and continental levels across Asia. This article analyzes the outcomes of Sukavichinomics across ten continental dimensions, spanning sports infrastructure, healthcare, education, transportation, urban development, research systems, and human capital formation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Sukavichinomics（素卡维经济学）在亚洲大陆层面的十个维度上的影响，包括体育基础设施、医疗保健、教育、交通、城市发展、研究系统和人力资本形成等领域。
AI.research_question: Sukavichinomics在亚洲大陆层面的十个维度上产生了什么样的影响和结果？
AI.motivation: 素卡维·朗西波尔先生提出的发展理念和战略举措从根本上改变了法政大学，并在亚洲国家和大陆层面产生了深远的结构性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Sukavichinomics发展理念框架，涵盖多维度发展理论。
AI.method: 对Sukavichinomics在十个大陆维度上的成果进行分析。
AI.findings: Sukavichinomics在体育基础设施、医疗保健、教育、交通、城市发展、研究系统和人力资本形成等多个领域产生了显著的结构性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了发展经济学理论，提出了多维度、跨领域的发展框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为亚洲地区的发展提供了可借鉴的战略模式，展示了高等教育机构在推动区域发展中的重要作用。

title: Financial Inclusion in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Progress, Constraints, and an Institutional Roadmap

detail.title: Financial Inclusion in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Progress, Constraints, and an Institutional Roadmap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The views expressed are solely those of the author and do not necessarily represent those of any other institution with which the author is affiliated.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data collection. All data used were drawn from publicly available institutional and international sources (World Bank Global Findex 2025, GSMA 2025, IMF 2023, Banque Centrale du Congo 2023). Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently as part of the author’s academic and professional research activities.

detail.abstract: This article examines the current state of financial inclusion in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), leveraging newly published data from the World Bank's Global Findex 2025 and the GSMA's 2025 mobile money industry report. While global account ownership now reaches 79% of adults and Sub-Saharan Africa manages nearly three-quarters of global mobile money transaction volume, the DRC continues to fall behind with just under 40% of adults holding formal accounts as of 2022. The analysis situates the Congolese case within institutional and development economics frameworks, identifying structural barriers such as infrastructure deficits, weak trust, limited financial literacy, and regulatory fragmentation. Evidence from the expansion of mobile money suggests that digital finance can accelerate inclusion, but sustainable gains depend on credible institutions, robust connectivity, and consumer protection. The paper argues that the DRC's path toward financial inclusion must integrate improvements in digital infrastructure, human capital, and institutional governance. It concludes with a policy roadmap and recommendations for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了刚果民主共和国金融包容性现状，基于世界银行全球金融包容性数据库和GSMA移动货币行业报告数据。尽管全球账户拥有率达79%，撒哈拉以南非洲占全球移动货币交易量近四分之三，但刚果仅有不到40%成年人拥有正规账户。研究识别了基础设施不足、信任缺失、金融知识匮乏和监管分散等结构性障碍，指出数字金融可加速包容性，但可持续进展需要可信机构、强大连接性和消费者保护。
AI.research_question: 刚果民主共和国金融包容性的现状如何？哪些结构性障碍阻碍了其发展？数字金融如何促进金融包容性？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球金融包容性取得进展，刚果民主共和国仍严重落后，需要深入分析其独特挑战和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学和发展经济学框架，分析结构性障碍和制度因素对金融包容性的影响。
AI.method: 基于世界银行Global Findex 2025和GSMA 2025移动货币行业报告数据的实证分析。
AI.findings: 刚果仅有不到40%成年人拥有正规账户，远低于全球79%水平；基础设施不足、信任缺失、金融知识匮乏和监管分散是主要障碍；移动货币扩张显示数字金融可加速包容性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度经济学框架应用于刚果金融包容性分析，强调制度质量对数字金融可持续性的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了整合数字基础设施、人力资本和制度治理的政策路线图，为刚果金融包容性发展提供具体建议。

detail.abstract: The following manuscript is a book review of J.D. Farmer's Making Sense of Chaos: A Better Economics for a Better World (2024). The review focuses on the importance of Farmer's work and its meaning in the ongoing discussion on the crisis of economics. Special attention is paid to a popular science aspect of the book and its ambitions connected to modern global challenges-the overgrowth of the financial system and climate change.

AI.tldr: 这篇手稿是对J.D. Farmer《理解混沌：为了更好世界的更好经济学》（2024）的书评，重点讨论了该书在经济学危机讨论中的重要性，特别关注其科普性质和对现代全球挑战（金融体系过度增长和气候变化）的雄心。
AI.research_question: Farmer的著作《理解混沌》在经济学危机讨论中具有什么重要性？该书如何应对现代全球挑战？
AI.motivation: 当前经济学面临危机，需要新的理论框架来应对金融体系过度增长和气候变化等全球性挑战。Farmer的著作为这一讨论提供了重要贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混沌理论在经济学中的应用，复杂系统理论，以及对传统经济学范式的批判。
AI.method: 书评分析方法，通过对Farmer著作内容的系统梳理和批判性评价。
AI.findings: Farmer的著作在经济学危机讨论中具有重要地位，其科普性质使复杂理论更易理解，对金融体系过度增长和气候变化等现代挑战提供了有价值的见解。

title: Why Eco-Friendly Products Attract Future Consumers: A Study on Changing Buying Behavior

detail.title: Why Eco-Friendly Products Attract Future Consumers: A Study on Changing Buying Behavior
detail.abstract: This paper explores why eco-friendly products are increasingly attracting future consumers, particularly from Generation Z and Generation Alpha. It examines consumer attitudes, motivations, and willingness to support sustainable brands. Data was collected through a short survey among young consumers to understand key drivers such as environmental awareness, health consciousness, and brand trust. The findings indicate that eco-conscious behavior will strongly influence future markets, and businesses must adapt their strategies to stay relevant.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了环保产品为何越来越吸引Z世代和Alpha世代等未来消费者，分析了他们的态度、动机和支持可持续品牌的意愿。研究发现环保意识行为将强烈影响未来市场，企业需要调整策略以保持相关性。
AI.research_question: 为什么环保产品越来越吸引Z世代和Alpha世代等未来消费者？
AI.motivation: 随着环境问题日益严峻，年轻一代消费者的环保意识不断增强，了解他们的消费动机对企业制定可持续发展战略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论、环境心理学、可持续消费理论
AI.method: 通过对年轻消费者进行简短问卷调查收集数据
AI.findings: 环保意识、健康意识和品牌信任是推动年轻消费者选择环保产品的主要驱动力，环保意识行为将强烈影响未来市场格局
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对年轻一代可持续消费行为的理解，丰富了环境心理学和消费者行为理论在代际差异方面的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了针对Z世代和Alpha世代的营销策略建议，帮助企业在可持续发展趋势中保持竞争力

title: Cultural Analysis of the Legend of the Mountain Leaflet
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Cultural Analysis of the Legend of the Mountain Leaflet
detail.abstract: This study examines the legend of El Hojarasquín del Monte in Colombia as a cultural, emotional, and economic symbol that intertwines fear, respect, and nostalgia. Drawing on Robert Plutchik’s theory of emotions, it explores how the myth functions as a collective catharsis and a mechanism of cultural cohesion. It also evaluates its transformation into an object of economic and touristic value through the commodification of folklore. The legend thus operates between emotion, identity, and capital, expressing the complex relationship between culture and market in Colombian society.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了哥伦比亚传说《El Hojarasquín del Monte》作为文化、情感和经济象征的多重功能，探讨了其在情感表达、文化凝聚和经济商品化之间的复杂关系。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚传说《El Hojarasquín del Monte》如何作为文化、情感和经济象征运作，并体现文化与社会市场之间的复杂关系？
AI.motivation: 探索民间传说在现代社会中的多重功能，特别是其作为情感表达、文化认同和经济商品化的载体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Robert Plutchik的情感理论，分析传说作为集体宣泄和文化凝聚机制的功能。
AI.method: 未明确说明具体研究方法，但从内容推断可能采用文化分析、符号学分析和案例研究方法。
AI.findings: 该传说在哥伦比亚社会中同时发挥着情感宣泄、文化认同和经济商品化的多重功能，体现了文化传统与市场经济的复杂互动。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了情感理论在文化研究中的应用，深化了对民间传说作为社会心理机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为文化遗产保护、文化旅游开发和地方经济发展提供了理论指导和实践启示。

title: Risk Creep: Learning Under High Uncertainty Leads to a Creeping Tolerance for Risk
affiliations: Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business, Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business and Georgetown University - Department of Psychology

detail.title: Risk Creep: Learning Under High Uncertainty Leads to a Creeping Tolerance for Risk

publicationDetails.detailsText: Georgetown McDonough School of Business Research Paper No. 4219931
publicationDetails.journalName: Georgetown University McDonough School of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Can people learn in highly uncertain environments?  Although highly uncertain environments are common in organizational contexts (recessions, technological revolutions), classic learning theory cannot predict behavior in contexts of high uncertainty.  Both reinforcement learning (associating outcomes with behaviors) and social learning (inferring cues from others’ behavior) require assumptions that do not hold under high uncertainty.  We tracked behavior at the height of uncertainty during the COVID-19 pandemic, post-lockdown and pre-vaccine.  Our results suggest that people are capable of learning, absent reinforcement of behavior and prior to norm emergence.  1) Despite the absence of definitive outcomes from past behaviors, people were capable of using their perceptions of risk from their own past behaviors to guide behavior.  We call this new phenomenon minimal experiential learning.  2) Even in the conspicuous absence of norms, people were capable of incorporating sparse signals from infrequently observed behavior to guide behavior.  We call this new phenomenon minimal signal learning.  We additionally discover that 3) people simultaneously learned via these two channels, 4) leading to a gradual increase in precarious activity that puts people at risk of negative consequences.  We call this risk creep and suspect that it is a common by-product of learning in highly uncertain environments.

AI.tldr: 本文发现在高度不确定环境中，人们能够通过两种新机制进行学习：最小经验学习（基于对过去行为风险的感知）和最小信号学习（基于稀疏的他人行为信号），这两种学习同时发生并导致风险逐渐增加的"风险蔓延"现象。
AI.research_question: 人们能否在高度不确定环境中学习？
AI.motivation: 经典学习理论无法预测高度不确定环境中的行为，而这类环境在组织情境中很常见（如经济衰退、技术革命）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强化学习理论和社会学习理论，但这些理论在高度不确定性下的假设不成立。
AI.method: 在COVID-19疫情期间（封锁后、疫苗前）追踪行为数据，这是高度不确定性的典型情境。
AI.findings: 1) 人们能够通过最小经验学习使用过去行为的风险感知来指导行为；2) 人们能够通过最小信号学习从稀疏的他人行为信号中学习；3) 这两种学习同时发生；4) 导致风险活动逐渐增加的"风险蔓延"现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了两种新的学习机制（最小经验学习和最小信号学习）以及风险蔓延概念，扩展了经典学习理论在高度不确定环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在高度不确定环境中理解员工行为提供了新视角，有助于设计更有效的管理策略来应对风险蔓延问题。

title: Deepfakes and the Limits of Law: Comparative Regulatory Approaches in the U.S., EU, and China

detail.title: Deepfakes and the Limits of Law: Comparative Regulatory Approaches in the U.S., EU, and China
detail.abstract: This paper examines the limitations of current legal frameworks in regulating deepfake technology across the US, the European Union and China. It explores how different approaches—balancing free speech protections, risk-based regulation, and provider liability—shape inconsistent cross-jurisdictional framework. Grounded in comparative legal analysis and cultural perspectives, the article positions deepfakes as a paradigmatic case for examining the effectiveness and adaptability of emerging AI regulatory frameworks across jurisdictions It argues that deepfakes reveal three legal challenges: (i) constitutional constraints on regulating synthetic speech, (ii) definitional ambiguities and a harm-scale design in the EU and (iii) provider-centric obligations in China. The analysis underscores the necessity of an integrated, cross-border regulatory model that reconciles normative diversity across jurisdictions while ensuring that innovation remains aligned with ethical and human rights standards.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国、欧盟和中国在监管深度伪造技术方面的法律框架局限性，探讨了不同监管方法导致的跨境监管不一致问题，并提出了需要整合跨境监管模式的必要性。
AI.research_question: 当前法律框架在监管深度伪造技术方面存在哪些局限性？不同司法管辖区的监管方法如何影响跨境监管框架的一致性？
AI.motivation: 深度伪造技术作为新兴AI技术的典型案例，揭示了不同司法管辖区AI监管框架的有效性和适应性差异，需要探索整合的跨境监管解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法律分析、文化视角、AI监管理论、跨境监管协调理论
AI.method: 比较法律分析，通过对美国、欧盟和中国三个司法管辖区的深度伪造监管框架进行系统比较研究
AI.findings: 深度伪造揭示了三个法律挑战：(1)宪法对合成言论监管的限制；(2)欧盟的定义模糊性和危害等级设计；(3)中国以提供商为中心的义务。不同监管方法导致跨境监管框架不一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI监管理论提供了深度伪造作为典型案例的分析，发展了跨境监管协调理论，提出了整合监管模型的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改进深度伪造监管框架的具体建议，提出了协调不同司法管辖区监管差异的实践方案，有助于确保技术创新与伦理和人权标准保持一致。

title: Gold Silver Pair Trading -Mean Reversion Strategy Using Machine Learning
affiliations: Global Supply Chain and Independent author

detail.title: Gold Silver Pair Trading -Mean Reversion Strategy Using Machine Learning
detail.abstract:
The gold-silver relationship has long served as a benchmark for relative-value and meanreversion trading in commodity markets. This study develops a quantitative framework that integrates classical cointegration analysis with modern machine learning (ML) techniques to enhance trading performance in the gold-silver spread. Using futures and ETF data (COMEX GC-SI, GLD-SLV) from 2015-2025, the paper first confirms long-term cointegration and then applies dynamic hedge estimation via Kalman filtering. Mean reversion signals are standardized through z-score normalization and augmented with ML-based regime filters (Gradient Boosting, Support Vector Machine) trained on volatility, macro, and sentiment features to distinguish stable versus unstable spread conditions. Backtests reveal that ML-filtered mean reversion trades outperform static statistical arbitrage by improving entry precision and reducing drawdowns, particularly during high-volatility regimes such as the 2020 COVID crisis, the 2022 inflation spike, and the 2024 commodity rally. The proposed hybrid framework demonstrates that integrating adaptive learning models into classical econometric approaches significantly enhances profitability and risk control for commodity pair trading. Highlights  Presents a hybrid gold-silver mean reversion framework integrating cointegration, Kalman filtering, and machine learning classifiers.  Demonstrates dynamic hedge ratio estimation using state-space modeling for adaptive spread tracking.  Incorporates machine learning regime filters (Gradient Boosting, SVM) to enhance trade timing and reduce drawdowns.  Backtests across 2015-2025 show superior Sharpe ratios and lower volatility than static statistical arbitrage models.  Extends event-driven and volatility-forecasting methods (Mittal, 2025) to commodity spread trading with risk-controlled execution.

The full dataset and visualizations supporting this paper are publicly available on Zenodo:
Mittal, V. K. (2025). Gold–Silver Pair Trading – Mean Reversion Strategy Using Machine Learning (Version 1.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17537028

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个结合经典协整分析和现代机器学习技术的混合框架，用于提升金银价差交易的性能。通过动态对冲比率估计和基于机器学习的制度过滤器，该策略在2015-2025年回测中显示出优于传统统计套利方法的夏普比率和风险控制能力。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合机器学习技术与经典计量经济学方法来提升金银价差均值回归交易的性能？
AI.motivation: 金银关系长期以来作为商品市场相对价值和均值回归交易的基准，但传统统计套利方法在高波动时期表现不佳，需要更智能的交易时机识别机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协整理论、状态空间模型（卡尔曼滤波）、均值回归理论、机器学习分类理论（梯度提升、支持向量机）
AI.method: 使用COMEX期货和ETF数据（2015-2025年），首先进行协整分析确认长期关系，然后通过卡尔曼滤波进行动态对冲比率估计，最后应用基于波动率、宏观和情绪特征的机器学习制度过滤器来优化交易时机。
AI.findings: 机器学习过滤的均值回归交易在回测中优于静态统计套利，特别是在2020年COVID危机、2022年通胀飙升和2024年商品反弹等高波动时期，改善了入场精度并减少了回撤。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自适应学习模型整合到经典计量经济学方法中，为商品配对交易提供了理论框架，证明了混合方法在盈利能力和风险控制方面的优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商品交易者提供了一个实用的交易框架，能够动态调整对冲比率并智能识别交易时机，在真实市场条件下实现更好的风险调整后收益。

title: Remanufacture or Salvage? Reverse Logistics Optimization for Wind Turbines with Imperfect Sorting
affiliations: , University of Missouri and Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy

detail.title: Remanufacture or Salvage? Reverse Logistics Optimization for Wind Turbines with Imperfect Sorting
detail.abstract: As wind power deployment expands and the existing infrastructure matures, reverse logistics associated with wind turbine decommissioning is becoming increasingly critical. The common practice of salvaging turbines is to recycle the metal material and landfill the blades, the latter being highly controversial and wasteful. Remanufacturing is regarded as a more sustainable approach to address this problem. However, it faces multiple challenges, including expensive and complex transportation of large turbine components and imperfect on-site sorting (i.e., preliminary checking that decides turbine's remanufacturability with less than 100% accuracy). Sending non-remanufacturable turbines to remanufacturing wastes transportation resources in particular, along with other associated costs, whereas salvaging remanufacturable turbines forfeits valuable opportunities. This paper studies a two-tier reverse logistics system of wind turbines and presents an optimization model to make the decision between remanufacturing and salvaging considering imperfect on-site sorting. Based on confusion matrix properties, optimality conditions, and closed-form solutions from the mathematical model, we explore and explain the system's behavior under various conditions. We find that sorting accuracy can have significant impact on the total profit (30+%), and the value of sorting accuracy strongly depends on factors such as yield (fraction of remanufacturable), remanufacturing profit, and transportation cost, among others. There are two cases in which imporving sorting accuracy is particularly important: (1) when yield is relatively low and remanufacturing profit is at medium to high level, and (2) when yield is at medium level while transportation cost is high. Comprehensive numerical experiments are conducted with results and managerial insights discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究风力涡轮机退役的两级逆向物流系统，考虑现场分类不完美的情况，建立优化模型在再制造和回收之间进行决策。研究发现分类准确性对总利润影响显著（30%以上），其价值取决于产量、再制造利润和运输成本等因素。
AI.research_question: 在考虑现场分类不完美的情况下，如何优化风力涡轮机退役的逆向物流系统，在再制造和回收之间做出最优决策？
AI.motivation: 随着风电部署扩大和基础设施老化，风力涡轮机退役的逆向物流日益重要。目前常见的做法是回收金属材料而填埋叶片，这种做法存在争议且浪费。再制造被认为是更可持续的方法，但面临运输成本高和现场分类不准确等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于混淆矩阵特性、最优性条件和数学模型的闭式解，分析系统在不同条件下的行为。
AI.method: 建立两级逆向物流系统的优化模型，考虑不完美的现场分类，进行全面的数值实验。
AI.findings: 分类准确性对总利润有显著影响（30%以上），分类准确性的价值强烈依赖于产量、再制造利润和运输成本等因素。在两种情况下提高分类准确性特别重要：（1）产量相对较低且再制造利润处于中高水平时；（2）产量处于中等水平而运输成本较高时。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考虑不完美分类的风力涡轮机逆向物流优化模型，揭示了分类准确性对系统性能的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风力涡轮机退役管理提供了决策支持，帮助企业在再制造和回收之间做出更优选择，提高资源利用效率和经济效益。

title: Single-Family REITs and Local Housing Markets
affiliations: University of Notre Dame - Mendoza College of Business, Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia and Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: Single-Family REITs and Local Housing Markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-37
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the rise of single-family real estate investment trusts (SF-REITs) using a novel property-level dataset. SF-REITs tend to buy homes in neighborhoods near city centers, where housing supply is relatively elastic and residents are on the lower rungs of the homeownership ladder. Exploiting spatial differences, we find that SF-REIT growth modestly raises prices and increases overall housing supply, with individual ownership rising at a similar rate. However, we find no evidence that SF-REITs reduce house purchase financing accessibility—mortgage approval rates and borrower credit profiles remain unchanged. Overall, institutional landlords have had a limited impact on access to homeownership.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了单户住宅房地产投资信托基金（SF-REITs）的兴起，发现它们倾向于在市中心附近购买房屋，对房价有轻微提升作用并增加了住房供应，但对购房融资可及性没有负面影响。
AI.research_question: SF-REITs对住房市场和购房可及性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究机构房东在单户住宅市场中的兴起及其对住房市场和购房机会的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于房地产投资信托理论和住房市场弹性理论，分析机构投资者在住房市场中的行为。
AI.method: 使用新颖的物业级数据集，利用空间差异进行实证分析。
AI.findings: SF-REITs倾向于在市中心附近购买房屋，轻微提升房价并增加住房供应，但未降低购房融资可及性。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对机构投资者在住房市场中作用的理解，挑战了机构房东会减少购房机会的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于SF-REITs实际影响的实证证据，表明其对购房可及性的影响有限。

title: The Impact of State Paid Sick Leave Mandates on Medicaid-financed Prescription Medications
affiliations: Indiana University, Indianapolis, George Mason University, University of Virginia - Frank Batten School of Leadership and Public Policy and Indiana University

detail.title: The Impact of State Paid Sick Leave Mandates on Medicaid-financed Prescription Medications
detail.abstract: The United States lacks a federal paid sick leave policy. However, 18 states and the District of Columbia have adopted or announced paid sick leave employer mandates to increase access to this benefit, creating a quasi-experimental setting to study whether paid sick leave affects healthcare use. People enrolled in Medicaid are an important population to study in terms of state paid sick leave policies as the majority of non-disabled enrollees are employed, but frequently work in jobs without paid sick leave. Given enrollees’ lower incomes, losing earnings to receive healthcare may be a significant barrier to care. In this study, we examine the effect of state paid sick leave policies on Medicaid-financed dispensed prescription medications. Using difference-in-differences methods that are robust to bias associated with a staggered treatment rollout, we show that  Medicaid-financed dispensed prescription medications increase by 6.7% following adoption of a state paid sick leave policy. These findings suggest that state paid sick leave policies promote engagement with the healthcare system and use of healthcare services among financially constrained populations.

AI.tldr: 美国州级带薪病假政策使医疗补助计划资助的处方药配发量增加6.7%，表明这些政策促进了经济困难人群的医疗服务使用。
AI.research_question: 州级带薪病假政策对医疗补助计划资助的处方药配发有何影响？
AI.motivation: 美国缺乏联邦带薪病假政策，但18个州和哥伦比亚特区已实施雇主带薪病假规定，为研究带薪病假对医疗服务使用的影响提供了准实验环境。医疗补助计划参保者多数就业但常无带薪病假，低收入使他们因就医损失收入成为重要障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 准实验设计，利用州级政策差异作为自然实验
AI.method: 采用对交错治疗推出相关偏差具有稳健性的双重差分方法
AI.findings: 州级带薪病假政策采用后，医疗补助计划资助的处方药配发量增加6.7%
AI.theory_contributions: 证实带薪病假政策能促进经济困难人群的医疗服务系统参与和医疗服务使用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据，支持带薪病假政策在改善低收入人群医疗服务可及性方面的作用
